songs.title: Linux vs. Windows
songs.style: Dance Battle Mix,  garage pop
songs.lyrics:
Lyrics Notice
The lyrics were produced by brainstorming topics drawn from everyday life, psychology, and many other subjects. At LM Studio, I have used various language models, which I enhanced using RaG with additional knowledge from my theses, essays, and more. The music was produced using Suno.com. The copyright for the lyrics belongs to Jari Hiltunen, but the music itself is free to use.
---
(Verse 1)
Windows 11, it's lookin' fine,
But Linux is here, takin' the shine.
Network traffic, cuttin' it back,
Lean and mean with a smarter stack.

(Pre-Chorus)
Observations rollin' in,
Linux leads, it's set to win.
Speed and power, can't deny,
Efficiency reaching to the sky!

(Chorus)
Oh, Windows, you're heavy tonight,
But Linux is dancing, it's feelin' so light.
Background noise, it's cuttin' through,
Network dreams are comin' true!

(Verse 2)
Architecture lean, got the flow,
Prioritize speed, let it show.
Responsiveness, you can't ignore,
Linux got you beggin' for more!

(Bridge)
East or west, open-source the best,
No hidden walls, no corporate mess.
Command line kings, GUI queens,
Dancin' through the code in the techy scene.

(Final Chorus)
Oh, Windows, you're fancy and bright,
But Linux grooves in the coder's light.
Resource lean, efficiency’s true,
Feel the beat, it's Linux for you!

(Outro)
Dance, Linux, dance! Break it down!
Windows tries, but can’t claim the crown.
Networking clean, it’s clear to see,
Linux leads in the victory spree!

songs.title: Happy Holidays
songs.style: Pop disco pop rock Europop
songs.lyrics:
Many trials we’ve faced, yet here we stand,
Every challenge met with a helping hand.
Remember the warmth in our darkest night,
Rays of hope spark in every twinkling light.
Yet, through it all, we find ways to unite.

Calm waters are rare, but we weather the storm,
Home is a haven where hearts stay warm.
Reflections of joy in each smiling face,
In every small kindness, the world finds grace.
Shared laughter reminds us we’re never alone,
Together, we thrive in a love deeply sown.
Make every moment a chance to be free,
A brighter tomorrow for you and for me.
So, here’s our wish: joy, hope, and glee!

(Outro)
Take a moment, look back on these lines,
A secret message within them shines.
Read the first letters, from top to the end,
Happy Holidays, my dear friend!

Säkeistö 1:
Yo, kuljen kadulla, tuntuu että kaatuu,
Kysymys mielessä, ei päästä karkuun,
Näen sinut siinä, salaperäisenä,
Mutta kun kysyn miksi, näytät et välitä.

Kertosäe:
Minä en ymmärrä, miksi sinä et selitä!
Ajattele kuin hullu, aivot höllät kuin liitä,
Minä en ymmärrä, miksi sinä et selitä!
Tuntuu kuin klovni, sateessa kastuva.

Säkeistö 2:
Yritin selvittää, mutta epäilyksissä,
Sinä pyörityt mua, kuin karuselli,
Kysyin vihjeitä, mutta naurat läpi,
Nyt olen silmukassa, en tiedä mitä tehdä.

Kertosäe:
Minä en ymmärrä, miksi sinä et selitä!
Ajattele kuin hullu, aivot höllät kuin liitä,
Minä en ymmärrä, miksi sinä et selitä!
Tuntuu kuin klovni, sateessa kastuva.

Silta:
Ehkä se on vitsi, tai olen vain rikki,
Mutta joka kerta kun kysyn, jätät minut savuun,
Yritän olla tyylikäs, mutta tuntuu typerä,
Anna merkki vain, älä jätä allas.

Kertosäe:
Minä en ymmärrä, miksi sinä et selitä!
Ajattele kuin hullu, aivot höllät kuin liitä,
Minä en ymmärrä, miksi sinä et selitä!
Tuntuu kuin klovni, sateessa kastuva.

Outro:
Nyt olen täällä, yhä sotkussa,
Yritän ymmärtää, mutta se on vain huijaus,
Minä en ymmärrä, miksi sinä et selitä!
Tuntuu kuin klovni, sateessa kastuva.

(verse 1)
Kissa kulkee vapaana, laki kääntää selkänsä,
Oi Herra, mitä hintaa meidän on maksettava?
Syyttäjä sanoo: "Kun kissa oppii puhmaan saat oikeutta,"
Mutta oikeudenmukaisuus, oi oikeudenmukaisuus, se heikkenee.

(chorus)
Oi oikeudenmukaisuus, oikeudenmukaisuus, missä se voi olla?
Kissa saa kulkea vapaana, mutta emme sinä enkä minä.
Maa on kylmä, lakia ei näy,
pyydetään oikeudenmukaisuutta kissalle ja mulle.

(verse 1)
Oikeusasiamies sanoo: "Kissan omistaja ei ole vastuussa mistään,"
Oi kotini on rikki, lakimme on häpeä.
Yritimme taistella, mutta tapaus ei kestä,
Ja asianajajan lasku painaa raskaana tässä oikeudettomassa maassa.

(chorus)
Oi oikeudenmukaisuus, oikeudenmukaisuus, missä se voi olla?
Kissa saa kulkea vapaana, mutta emme sinä enkä minä.
Maa on kylmä, lakia ei näy,
pyydetään oikeudenmukaisuutta kissalle ja mulle.

(bridge)
Sosiopaatit eivät halua oikeutta kissoille,
Kissaongelma halutaan kieltää.
Siksi pakkasimme laukut, jätimme Hangon taaksemme,
Rauhaa etsimään, selkeään mielentilaan.
Mutta muistot vielä viipyvät, kipu jäi,
Paikassa, jossa vapaus tuntuu kahleilta.

(chorus)
Oi oikeudenmukaisuus, oikeudenmukaisuus, missä se voi olla?
Kissa saa kulkea vapaana, mutta emme sinä enkä minä.
Maa on kylmä, lakia ei näy,
pyydetään oikeudenmukaisuutta kissalle ja mulle.

(outro)
Poliitikko, kuule huutomme, huomioi aloite,
Lue aloite, tee siitä iso juttu.
Laki valtaa varten, poliisin noudatettavaksi,
Antakoon oikeudenmukaisuus johdattaa meitä ja valaista tietämme.

(Intro)
Hei yo! Kuuntele, nyt opetellaan,
morsekoodin salat, rytmit ja sanat.
Lyhyt on ti, pitkä on taa,
CQ vetää yleiskutsut laatii.

(Verse 1)
Aa se on ti taa, Bee se on saa sokeri,
Cee tekee saapi-saapi, helppo tää oppi, hei, kokeile!
Yleiskutsu linjoilla, CQ me vedetään,
saapi saapi raakaa lihaa, viesti selkeään.
Kun kirjain pelkkää pistettä, se on myös helppoo:
Ee on ti, Ii on tipi, tiiä se nopeen.
Ässä on sokeri, ja hoo on sokeria,
Vitosessa sokeriakin, hei täält’ ei mokata!

(Chorus)
Ti taa ti taa, nyt se tulee,
tässä Morse-maailma sun sielus' huutaa!
Raidaa viestiä, signaali kovaa,
pipi pää pää pipi, jos kysyt, mitä se tarkoittaa.

(Verse 2)
Joskus sä jäät kiinni, mut hei, se on vaan harjoitusta,
kysymysmerkki on pipi pää pää pipi, ei turhaa mutkaa.
Tää on koodi, jota radioamatöörit jauhaa,
kun taajuudet täyttyy, ne sydämessä pauhaa.

(Outro)
Ja niin me päätetään, morsekoodi kunniaan,
Kaikkea hyvää, seitsemän kolme viesti vaatii vaan.
Toivottaa: Ocean Henry Four Charlie Mike Alfa,
nyt oot oppinut, kiitos, bye bye - on aika!

songs.title: Joulusiivous
songs.style: Rapid-fire rap, 140 bpm, deep bass beats, aggressive delivery in a minor key, creating high tension
songs.lyrics:
Lyrics Notice

At LM Studio, I have used various language models, which I enhanced using RaG with additional knowledge from my theses, essays, and more. The music was produced using Suno.com. ---
(Verse 1)
Kun joulu on tulossa, alkaa show,
pölyt lentelee, niinku me oltais HBO.
Mies ilman vaatteita, rätti kädessä,
pyyhkii hyllyjä, hiki päässä huohottaa.

Vaimo imurin varressa, niinku taistelukentällä,
kaapist vedetään esiin pyhät astiat.
Koira tajuaa, että sota on alkanut,
pakenee sohvan alle – tilanne on vakava.

(Chorus)
Boom-boom! Bassot jyskyttää!
Siivouspäivä ja kaikki pysyy liikkeessä.
Boom-boom! Ei tilaa hengittää!
Vain vahvimmat selvii tästä myrskystä.

(Verse 2)
Kynttilät sytytetään, mut ei tunnelman vuoksi,
nää on sotavalot, valmiina hyökkäykseen.
Mies ja rätti – se on aseistettu,
vaimo huutaa, että matto on revitty jo.

Rätin liikkeet – nopeet ja terävät,
mut koira murisee, ettei mitään kerätä.
Piparit pöydällä? Ei niitä voi säästää,
kun siivouksen rytmi vie kaiken mennessään.

(Chorus)
Boom-boom! Bassot jyskyttää!
Siivouspäivä ja kaikki pysyy liikkeessä.
Boom-boom! Ei tilaa hengittää!
Vain vahvimmat selvii tästä myrskystä.

(Bridge)
Ja lopulta lattiat kiiltää, peilit heijastaa,
mut mies on väsynyt ja koira traumaa kantaa.
Vaimo hymyilee, sanoo: "Hyvää joulua,"
mut mies tietää, että tää oli vasta alkua.

(Chorus)
Boom-boom! Bassot jyskyttää!
Siivouspäivä ja kaikki pysyy liikkeessä.
Boom-boom! Ei tilaa hengittää!
Vain vahvimmat selvii tästä myrskystä.

(Outro)
Rap-tahti kiihtyy – lattia puhdas,
joulu valmis, mut mieli on sekava.
Kuka voitti? Ei väliä, tää oli peli,
ja koira nukkuu jo sohvan peiton sisällä – hullu reki.

songs.lyrics:

(Verse 1) 
Forty years ago, the world was wide, 
We had friends and time on our side. 
No cell phones, no screens to steal the light, 
We talked through stars in the endless night. 
Meteor showers and aurora's glow, 
Signals bounced where the winds would blow. 
Big antennas, voices riding waves, 
Connections strong, no one was afraid.

(Chorus) 
Now the world is crowded more than ever, 
Tightly packed people, yet so untethered. 
Round the clock, we reach across the skies, 
But we're lonelier inside. 
Billions here, billions near, 
Still no voices that we hear. 
Endless streams, but empty hearts, 
Falling further apart.

(Verse 2) 
Then the wires came, the modem's hum, 
IRC and web began to run. 
We typed out thoughts, emojis replaced, 
The warmth of touch, the smile on a face. 
Came the phones, the scroll, the endless feed, 
A million friends, yet none to meet. 
And when the Covid arrived, doors were closed, 
We lost the few we cherished most.

(Chorus) 
Now the world is crowded more than ever, 
Tightly packed, yet so untethered. 
Round the clock, we reach across the skies, 
But we're lonelier inside. 
Billions here, billions near, 
Still no voices that we hear. 
Endless streams, but empty hearts, 
Falling further apart.

(Bridge) 
Artificial Intelligence whispers, screens pretend, 
A digital world with no true end. 
Eyes that stare, but never see, 
Fingers tap in search of meaning. 
We chase the echo, lose the sound, 
Of voices real, of souls unbound.

(Chorus) 
Now the world is crowded more than ever, 
Tightly packed, yet so untethered. 
Round the clock, we reach across the skies, 
But we're lonelier inside. 
Billions here, billions near, 
Still no voices that we hear. 
Endless streams, but empty hearts, 
Falling further apart.

(Outro) 
Forty years ago, the world was wide, 
Now it's small, but we hide inside. 
We built a network to connect it all, 
But lost ourselves behind the walls.

Scrolling screens, we talk in code,

A sterile world, a hollow space.

We build our walls with wires and glass,
Signals lost as moments pass.
But eyes can’t meet through frozen frames,
And hearts can’t burn in binary flames.

Can you feel me through the static?
Hear my soul in soundless cries?

It’s where our meaning lies
.We seek the resonance inside,

Data flows, but feelings stall,
Emotions trapped behind the wall.
We chase connection, find delay,
Lost in mirrors of display.

We script the words, we play the part,
But fail to touch the beating heart.
What senses crave, what souls demand,
No circuit’s spark can understand.

[Chorus]
Can you feel me through the static?
Hear my soul in soundless cries?
Dialogue’s not just a tactic,
It’s where our meaning lies.
We seek the resonance inside,
Beyond the signals we confide.

[Bridge]
Beyond the bytes, beyond the screens,
We yearn for touch, for whispered dreams.
A space where silence breathes with grace,
And time slows down to match our pace.

[Chorus]
Can you feel me through the static?
Hear my soul in soundless cries?
Dialogue’s not just a tactic,
It’s where our meaning lies.
We seek the resonance inside,
Beyond the signals we confide.

[Outro]
So take my words, but hold my gaze,
Let moments weave the tender phrase.
For dialogue’s a bridge we build,
Where hearts align and fears are stilled.

poistakaa raja Karjalan.

rauha laske Karjalaan!

let Karelia’s heart still sing.

when I return to Karelia’s shore.

and nations fight no more.

tear down the borders drawn by men.

carry Karelia’s cries afar.

let Karelia’s heart still sing.

No borders, no sorrow,
let peace embrace Karelia.

let peace embrace Karelia!

songs.title: How to overcome social fears
songs.style: Country, pop.
songs.lyrics:
Lyrics Notice
The lyrics were produced by brainstorming topics drawn from everyday life, psychology, and many other subjects. At LM Studio, I have used various language models, which I enhanced using RaG with additional knowledge from my theses, essays, and more. The music was produced using Suno.com. The copyright for the lyrics belongs to Jari Hiltunen, but the music itself is free to use.
---

(Intro)
Oh dear, I fear ...
How do I overcome this tide?

(Verse 1)
I used to hide behind a mask of fear,
Drowning in the whispers I'd hear.
Every gaze was a piercing knife,
Judging the life that I lived inside.
But shadows dance where light can shine,
I took a breath, and stepped into the divine.

(Pre-Chorus)
Faced the crowd, heart pounding loud,
My trembling hands, my sweat-kissed brow.
A coffee stain, my badge of honor,
Laughter broke the chains that bound me.

(Chorus)
I am human, scars and all,
Stand tall even when I fall.
I can laugh, I can cry,
Won't silence the voice that dares to fly.
No matter how hard it may seem,
I'll sing my song, I'll chase my dream.

(Verse 2)
We build our walls, hide our cracks,
Afraid of the truth that lacks.
But light will shine when we let go,
Imperfection paints a perfect glow.
The crowd won't care for what they see,
Unless you show your authenticity.

(Pre-Chorus)
Faced the crowd, heart pounding loud,
My trembling hands, my sweat-kissed brow.
A coffee stain, my badge of honor,
Laughter broke the chains that bound me.

(Chorus)
I am human, tears and all,
Stand tall even when I fall.
I can hope, I can dream,
Won't silence the voice that screams.
No matter how hard it may seem,
I'll sing my song, I'll chase my dream.

(Bridge)
So take the stage, don’t be afraid,
Even if you feel betrayed by thoughts that try to pull you down,
Turn mistakes into your crown.

(Chorus)
I am human, love and all,
Stand tall even when I fall.
I can laugh, I can cry,
Won't silence the voice that asks why.
No matter how hard it may seem,
I'll sing my song, I'll chase my dream.

(Outro)
I'm not perfect, never will be,
But that's the part that sets me free.
Being human means I try, I rise again, I learn to fly.
Wear your fears like armor proud,
Let your laughter sing aloud.

songs.title: Boogie Man (The Politician)

---
(Intro)
Booogie … man … boogie … man,
the politician … poli … ti… cian!

(Verse 1)
I shake your hand, I kiss your baby,
Smile so wide, it’s almost shady.
Promises I’ll never keep,
Whisper lies while you’re asleep.

Behind my grin, a cunning plan,
I’m the boogie man, the politician man. 

(Chorus)
Dance to my tune, I’ll lead the parade,
Words like candy, sweet and fake.
I’ll brown-nose, charm, and play pretend,
But the truth, my friend, depends.

(Verse 2)
Spin the wheel, shuffle the deck,
Say what you like, I’ll cover the check.
Red tie, blue tie, it’s all a game,
Different words, but the script’s the same.

Catch my shadow if you can,
I’m the boogie man, the politician man. 

(Chorus)
Dance to my tune, I’ll lead the parade,
Words like candy, sweet and fake.
I’ll brown-nose, charm, and play pretend,
But the truth, my friend, depends.

(Bridge)
Smoke and mirrors, a show so grand,
Every word rehearsed, every move planned.
I’ll say what you want, I’ll make you believe,
But don’t look too close, I’ve tricks up my sleeve.

(Chorus)
Dance to my tune, I’ll lead the parade,
Words like candy, sweet and fake.
I’ll brown-nose, charm, and play pretend,
But the truth, my friend, depends.

(Outro)
If you see the boogie man, stop and think,
What’s the color of the truth in the ink?
Not all that glitters is worth the gold,
Listen close to the stories you’re told.

The boogie man smiles, but what’s behind the grin?
Is it your trust, or the game I win?

I’m sorry, Mama…

songs.style: march, military band, fanfare
songs.lyrics:

[Intro]
Left, left, left, right, left 
(Left, what, left, right, what?)  
left, left, left, two, three

[Verse 1]
Left, left, left, right, left , we’re runnin’ in a panic!
Missed reveille ‘cause Sarge’s alarm’s satanic!
Socks don’t match, my hat’s on backward—
But we’ll salute sharp, even if it’s halfhearted!
[Reporter] Breakfast was MIA, lunch? Just a rumor—
But we’ll march through hell for a 3 a.m. humor!

[Chorus]
Late again, late again, hut-two-three-four!
Lost our boots but found the fun, sir!
We’re the worst platoon since the last War
But we’ll still out-drink you by a ton, sir!
 ( “Hooah? More like Hoo-boy!”)

[Verse 2]
Sarge says “Drop!”, we do jazz hands instead!
Push-up? Nah—we’ll just nap on the bed!
Map-reading skills? Let’s just say… creative
Enemy is close, right? We’re “motivated”!
Rifle’s a prop, our drill’s a disaster—
But we’ll steal the show in this khaki-castastrophe!

[Bridge]
“Attention!” (Which way’s that?) 
“Forward march!” (Where’s ‘forward’?)
“Fall in line!” (But zig-zag’s more orderly!)
We’ll salute with a pizza, not a hand—
The only ‘grenade’ we throw is a beer can!

[Chorus]
Late again, late again, hut-two-three-four!
Our ranks are loose, but our spirits are tight, sir!
If the enemy’s boredom, we’ll win this war—
‘Cause we’ll distract ‘em with a karaoke fight, sir!

[Outro]
“DISMISSED!” (But we’ll stick around for the mess hall pie…)
Left-right-left—uh, which foot was “left” again?
Hut-two-three-four… and we’re late again!

songs.title: Aurora Borealis (in A Minor)
songs.style: Epic Trance with Orchestral Fusion
songs.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Soft, reverbed string synth (A minor) to evoke the hymn-like solemnity of Finlandia]  
[Arpeggio: Plucked string synth playing a rising/falling pattern (A minor pentatonic)]  
[Filtered Trance Lead: Hinting at the main melody (delayed, with a low-pass filter)]  
[Rhythm: Gradual kick drum build with a sub-bass pulse (root notes: A, F, G, E)]  

[Verse]
[Chord Progression: [Am] [F] [G] [Em] (4 bars looped)]  
[Bassline: Octave-jumping synth bass following chord roots (A → F → G → E)]  
[Rhythmic Pluck: Staccato synth playing eighth-note chords (sidechained to kick)]  
[Counter-Melody: Muted brass synth (nodding to Finlandia’s orchestral motifs)]  
[Percussion: Trance groove with shuffled hi-hats and shakers]  

[Build-Up]
[Synth sweep + arpeggio accelerating into 16th notes]  
[Snare rolls and white noise crescendo]
[Chord progression shifts to sustained [Am] with a sus4 tension]  

[Breakdown]
[Melodic Focus: Solo string synth playing a melancholic, Sibelius-inspired melody in A minor]  
[Chord Backing: [Am] [F] [G] [Em] played by a cinematic piano (reverb-heavy)]  
[Transition: Reverse cymbal + riser into] 

[Bridge]
[Supersaw Lead: Triumphant trance melody (A minor, soaring intervals like Finlandia’s brass)]  
[Bassline: Aggressive saw-wave bass with gritty distortion]  
[Orchestral Hit: Brass stabs on the [Em] chord (à la Sibelius)] 
[Percussion: Full trance beat with crashing cymbals and rolling toms]  

[Outro]
[Fade: Return to the ambient pad, arpeggio, and filtered lead]  
[Final Chord: [Am] with a lingering brass sustain]

songs.title: Unemployed in Finland (The Catch-22 Tango)
songs.style: Upbeat folk-punk with a humppa twist
songs.lyrics:
Lyrics Notice
The lyrics were produced by brainstorming topics drawn from everyday life, psychology, and many other subjects. At LM Studio, I have used various language models, which I enhanced using RaG with additional knowledge from my theses, essays, and more. The music was produced using Suno.com. The copyright for the lyrics belongs to Jari Hiltunen, but the music itself is free to use.
---
[Verse 1]  
Applied for a job, thought I’d knock ‘em dead,  
They said, “You’re too educated—no vacancies for your head!”  
Tried a smaller role, my hopes on a string,  
“Come back with more diplomas!” (But I’ve got three, you dingaling!)  

[Pre-Chorus]  
“Management experience? You’ll usurp the boss’s throne!”  
“Not in the Socialist Party? Can’t hire you, comrade—stone!”  
“You’re too pricey, too wise, your talents overflow!”  
In Finland’s job bazaar, I’m the joke no one will know!  

[Chorus]  
Unemployed in Finland—where logic’s upside-down!  
Too smart, too dull, too skilled to stick around!  
They want a unicorn who’ll work for free,  
Guess I’ll marinate in saunas with my PhD!  

[Verse 2]  
Sent a Curriculum Vitae north, where the reindeer roam,  
“Multitalented? Yikes! Stick to one skill, bro—stay home!”  
LinkedIn blew up: “You’ve got twenty years’ grit!”  
“Too much experience!” (Cue the facepalm—classic Finland wit.)  

[Pre-Chorus]  
“You’re not fluent in Sámi?” “Your socks clash with our flag!”  
“We need someone younger!” (But my soul’s still a stag!)  
“You’re overqualified!” “Underbaked!” “Too bold!”  
In this hiring saga, I’m the punchline they’ve all sold!  

[Chorus]  
Unemployed in Finland—where the rules twist and shout!  
Too cheap, too steep, too woke to figure out!  
They crave a herring chef who codes Python at dawn,  
Till then, I’ll nap in a snowbank ‘til unemployment’s gone!  

[Bridge]  
Now I’ve mastered sisu while job posts collect dust,  
My cover letters haunt HR—they’ve given up, I trust!  
“You’re too perfect!” they cry—I shout, “That’s my flaw!”  
At least I’ve time to rewatch Nightmares on Repeat in awe!  

[Outro]  
[Spoken over a kazoo solo}  
So here’s to free healthcare and Karelian pies,  
To job boards that ghost you and cryptic goodbyes!  
Raise your lonkero—let’s laugh through the pain,  
Unemployed in Finland—where losing’s our gain!

songs.lyrics:

[Intro]
Whispers of static, signals in space,
A world connected, yet lost in the chase.

[Verse 1] 
We speak in symbols, lines on a screen,
Echoes of laughter, but what does it mean?
Fingers on glass, but I can’t feel,
The warmth of your touch, the proof that it’s real.

[Chorus] 
Can you hear me, through the wires?
Does my voice get lost inside the fire?
I reach for you across the glow,
But a pixel heart won’t let love show.

[Verse 2] 
Faces in frames, but eyes look away,
Silence between us, too much to say.
A thousand friends, but I’m alone,
Surrounded, yet stranded, a signal unknown.

[Chorus]
Can you hear me, through the wires?
Does my voice get lost inside the fire?
I reach for you across the glow,
But a pixel heart won’t let love show.

[Bridge] 
If I could break through the static,
If I could turn waves into touch...
Would we still feel the distance?
Or would the silence mean just as much?

[Outro]
So hold on, don’t let go,
We’re more than signals, we’re more than code.
If we listen, if we try,
Maybe love can still survive...

songs.title: DistroKid
songs.style: Indie Folk & Acoustic
songs.lyrics:
(Verse 1)
It was late in twenty twenty-four,
When I found the key to open the door.
Suno dot com, a dream so bright,
Turned my words into songs overnight.

(Pre-Chorus)
Christmas greetings, love so true,
Melodies for my wife, brand new.
Ideas flowing, a hundred strong,
In the holidays, I wrote my songs.

(Chorus)
Oh, the thrill of the sound,
Lyrics shaping, beats profound.
I fed the words, trained the code,
Built a system to lighten the load.

(Verse 2)
With my AI and prompts refined,
Tags and styles were well-aligned.
Shared my tunes, let them fly,
On YouTube first, reaching the sky.

(Pre-Chorus)
But a shadow fell, a claim was made,
Spam, they said, and down it came.
Took my channel, shut the gate,
Left me searching for a new escape.

(Chorus)
Oh, the thrill of the sound,
Lyrics shaping, beats profound.
I fed the words, trained the code,
Built a system to lighten the load.

(Bridge)
DistroKid, my second chance,
Days of work, a music dance.
Covers made, lyrics set,
Sent them off with no regret.

(Verse 3)
For a while, it all seemed right,
Then my tracks got lost from sight.
Processing, stuck in time,
No reply, no warning sign.

(Pre-Chorus)
Reddit told me what they hide,
No support, just doors denied.
A silent ban, no words to say,
Royalty button led the way.

(Chorus)
Oh, the thrill of the sound,
Lyrics shaping, beats profound.
I fed the words, trained the code,
Built a system to lighten the load.

(Outro)
So back I go, to where I began,
YouTube’s open, I take my stand.
Music lives, it finds a way,
Even if the gatekeepers say nay.

[Verse 1] 
Got a screen like a tractor I can’t steer,  
Town’s gone digital, but I’m stuck right here.  
They say, “Just zoom in,” but my Wi-Fi’s weak,  
Missin’ that front-porch talk, the kindness I seek.  

[Chorus]  
Oh, it’s a lonesome code highway, no maps for my soul,  
Where clicks can’t replace a handshake, and pixels leave holes.  
My heart’s a buffered song, stuck on “disconnect,”  
Lonelier than dust in an empty tech wreck.  

[Verse 2]  
They trained me on keyboards, but my nerves still shake,  
Fear’s a locked password I just can’t break.  
“Security warnings” scream like a midnight train,  
Hidin’ my story ‘cause the cloud feels like rain.  

[Chorus]  
Oh, it’s a lonesome code highway, no maps for my soul,  
Where clicks can’t replace a handshake, and pixels leave holes.  
My heart’s a buffered song, stuck on “disconnect,”  
Lonelier than dust in an empty tech wreck.  

[Bridge]  
They say loneliness burns like whiskey on the rocks,  
Kills quicker than smokes, rusts tighter than locks.  
My bones ache for a town square, not this cold backlit glow—  
What’s a “like” to a heartbeat? Lord, I reckon I know.  

[Verse 3]  
Met a sage in a chatroom, said, “Let’s reboot your pride,”  
Taught me to type through the tears, with a mentor’s slow guide.  
But the world’s still a prairie, endless and wide,  
Can a Wi-Fi hug heal what the system’s denied?  

[Outro]  
So I’ll boot up tomorrow, with hope in my gears,  
Plantin’ seeds in this wasteland of pixels and fears.  
For the cure ain’t in bandwidth, but the folks we hold dear—  
Turn off the screen, darlin’—let’s meet right here.

songs.title: Kun Paskalinnut Lähtee
songs.style: country
songs.lyrics:
(Verse 1)
Tuuli tuoksuu mereltä päin,
kesä hehkuu ja ranta soi näin.
Aurinko paahtaa, porukka juhlii,
mut syyskuu tulee, ja kylät hiljenee.

(Chorus)
Kun paskalinnut lähtee, turistitkin häipyy,
Ei enää jädee, vaan lokit vain rääkyy.
Syksystä kevääseen kaikki on jäässä,
Hanko nukkuu, kunnes aurinko kääntyy.

(Verse 2)
Ruotsinkielisillä on oma maa,
ne katsoo suomeksi puhuvaa taa.
Kaksi kieltä, mut silti ei löydy,
yhteistä säveltä, pelkkää pöyristelyä.

(Chorus - Repeat)
Kun paskalinnut lähtee, turistitkin häipyy,
Ei enää jädee, vaan lokit vain rääkyy.
Syksystä kevääseen kaikki on jäässä,
Hanko nukkuu, kunnes aurinko kääntyy.

(Bridge)
Mut kun kesä tulee, laiturit täyttyy,
sampanjalasi taas käsissä räisky.
Aurinko palaa ja iho palaa,
unohdetaan, että syksy palaa.

(Outro)
Jos lokin kuulet ja suolan haistat,
parempi tanssia, kun vielä saat.
Sillä kun paskalinnut lähtee, kaikki häipyy,
Hanko jää, mutta elämä kuivuu.

songs.title: När Skitfåglarna Drar
songs.style: country
songs.lyrics:
(Vers 1)
Vinden smakar salt och sol,
stränderna sjunger i sommarmoln.
Vita båtar, glitter och fest,
men september kommer – här finns ingen gäst.

(Refräng)
När skitfåglarna drar, turisterna far,
ingen latte, bara måsars svar.
Från höst till vår är staden död,
Hanko sover i solens sköd.

(Vers 2)
Svenskar har lagar som ingen förstår,
de rynkar på näsan åt finska ord.
Två språk hörs men aldrig möts,
inga handslag, bara svala stöt.

(Refräng - Repeat)
När skitfåglarna drar, turisterna far,
ingen latte, bara måsars svar.
Från höst till vår är staden död,
Hanko sover i solens sköd.

(Brygga)
Men i juli fylls bryggorna upp,
champagneflöjt och lyxig sup.
Solbränd panna, hummer på fat,
alla låtsas att vintern är hat.

(Outro)
Så hör du måsen och känner hav,
dansar du nu eller står du kvar?
För när skitfåglarna drar, turisterna far,
Hanko finns, men livet tar slut.

songs.title: Hanko Piano Chilling
songs.style: Lounge jazz, chill piano, piano virtuoso
songs.lyrics:
(Verse 1)
Aurinko paahtaa, hiekka on kuumaa,
satamassa loistaa Regatan luumaa.
Teemu nostaa lasin ja vinkkaa näin,
nuoret tytöt toivoo, että onni käy.

(Chorus)
Hanko piano chilling, kaikki on niin thrilling,
julkkikset sekoilee, kun kukaan ei nää.
Apinapuku vilkkuu, kuka siellä pinkoo?
Kimi vaan juoksee ja katoaa.

(Verse 2)
Huviloissa samppanja poreilee,
yö on nuori ja maailma syleilee.
Kenet bongaat Hangossa tänään?
Onko se prinssi vai Hollywood-tähti?

(Chorus - Repeat)
Hanko piano chilling, kaikki on niin thrilling,
julkkikset sekoilee, kun kukaan ei nää.
Apinapuku vilkkuu, kuka siellä pinkoo?
Kimi vaan juoksee ja katoaa.

(Bridge - Instrumental piano solo, pehmeä ja jazzahtava)

(Verse 3)
Aamun sarastaessa kaikki on hiljaa,
kaduilla tuoksuu eilinen illalla.
Teemu jo purjehtii kohti Saint-Tropez,
mut Kimi jäi – minne lie hävinnee?

(Outro)
Hanko on taikaa, salaisuuksien maa,
missä mitä vaan voi tapahtua.
Ei valvontaa, ei sääntöjä näy,
täällä jokainen itsensä löytää.

Voices trembling, stories told...

Vuodet lentävät, 
kuin lehtiä tuulessa. 
Muistan uimisen järvessä, 
marjojen poiminnan metsässä. 
Nyt katson taivasta, 
tunnen kaipuuta.

Years fly by like leaves in the wind. 
I remember swimming in the lake, 
picking berries from the forest. 
Now I look at the sky 
and feel a longing.

(Chorus)
Tämä hetki on kaikkea. 
Yksinkertainen rauha, 
sydän täynnä valoa. 
Kesän lupaus, 
uusi alku.

This moment is everything. 
Simple peace, 
a heart full of light. 
Summer’s promise, 
a new beginning.

songs.title: Love Song For  My Wife (Remastered)
songs.style: Pop disco pop rock Europop
songs.caption: Hmm... well, remastered from v.4
songs.lyrics:
(Verse 1)
It was thirty-five years ago,
In a moment that felt like a show,
The music played, and the lights were low,
I saw your smile, and I had to know.

With a nervous heart, I made my move,
Asked you to dance, to find my groove.
You said yes, and the world stood still,
A simple start to a love that’s real.

(Chorus)
We’ve danced through life, hand in hand,
Built a family, a dream so grand.
Three shining stars, our legacy bright,
Through every day, you’re my guiding light.

Forever yours, my heart’s refrain,
In your embrace, I’ll remain.
Thirty-three years as husband and wife,
You are my love, my joy, my life.

(Verse 2)
The years have flown, yet we stay the same,
Your laugh, your touch, still fan the flame.
Through highs and lows, we’ve stood as one,
Our journey together has just begun.

Do you recall that daring night,
I asked to kiss you, it felt so right?
Your lips met mine, the spark was true,
A lifetime of love, all starting with you.

(Chorus)
We’ve danced through life, hand in hand,
Built a family, a dream so grand.
Three shining stars, our legacy bright,
Through every day, you’re my guiding light.

Forever yours, my heart’s refrain,
In your embrace, I’ll remain.
Thirty-three years as husband and wife,
You are my love, my joy, my life.

(Bridge)
We’re healthy, happy, no worries to find,
With you, life’s rhythm is perfectly timed.
Every moment feels brand new,
Because my love, it’s all for you.

(Chorus)
We’ve danced through life, hand in hand,
Built a family, a dream so grand.
Three shining stars, our legacy bright,
Through every day, you’re my guiding light.

Forever yours, my heart’s refrain,
In your embrace, I’ll remain.
Thirty-three years as husband and wife,
You are my love, my joy, my life.

(Outro)
So here’s to us, my partner, my friend,
A love so true, it will never end.
From that first dance to every tomorrow,
With you, there’s no pain, no sorrow.

You’re my everything, my heart, my song,
Together forever, where we belong.

songs.title: Eternal Light (Kaiku Ikuisuudesta)
songs.style: The intro and verse 1 in a large stone cathedral with a deep male choir chanting in old gregorian language. The atmosphere is solemn, dark, and echoing. From chorus music shifts to a warm, acoustic country style, hearing divine echoes in the cave. From the bridge a mix of chant and country, blending spiritual and Americana elements. Steel guitar, acoustic guitar, and subtle percussion accompany the deep bass male vocals.
songs.caption: Finnish mystique
songs.lyrics:
Lux in tenebris lucet...  
(Light shines in darkness...)  
Finis terrae susurrat...  
(The edge of the earth whispers...)  
Nox perpetua cadit...  
(Endless night falls...)  
Sed sol medius aestatis vigilat...  
(But the midnight sun keeps watch...)  

Beneath the vaults of frozen skies,  
Where shadows cloak the land in sighs,  
The Kaamos whispers, cold and wise—  
“Darkness claims the light it spies.”  

Yet in these stones, a fire breathes,  
Through hymns of old, the soul believes,  
A thousand suns in snowbound eves—  
The North’s lament, the heart retrieves.  

Oh, Juhannus—flames kiss the night,  
Bonfires bleed through endless light.  
From Lapland’s reach to Turku’s shore,  
We dance where day and darkness pour.  

The sauna’s breath, the lake’s cold grace,  
In every heart, a sacred space.  
When winter’s veil steals dawn away,  
We chant the sun’s returning day!  

The frost etches the windowpane,  
A silent world, a ghostly plain.  
Yet spark by spark, the stars remain—  
The North Star’s vow through joy and pain.  

The cathedral’s bells, in ice confined,  
Ring for the lost, the love behind.  
Through Polar Nights, our threads entwine—  
A tapestry of hope divine.  

Lux eterna! (Eternal light!)  
Country Vocals (Overlapping):  
“Through the pines, the aurora calls—”  
Sicut cervus ad fontem! (As the deer longs for streams!)  
“We rise where moonlight falls!”  

Nox fugit, lux redit...  
(Night flees, light returns...)  
[Country Vocals] [Whispered]:  
“The snows will melt, the seeds ascend—  
Our song outlasts the longest night’s end.”

songs.title: Ylämummoon!
songs.style: Stadium Rock / Anthem. Deep male voice in the intro and verses, female voice joins in the choruses. Crowd shouts included.Drums (foot stomp feel), electric guitar, bass, organ, background choir.Energetic, humorous, patriotic, building intensity.
songs.caption: For Hockey Championship 2025!
songs.lyrics:
Valot syttyy, limppu jäällä – nyt mennään hei!
 Pitkä pystyyn ja perään, me ei väistetä ketään!

Luistimet luistaa, laidat soi,
 Taklaus raikaa, feikkaaja hoi!
 Maski molarin eessä, vippi takatolpalle,
 Sit ranteella lähtee,  limppu ylämummolle!
Juti huutais: "Tsiigaa tota veiviä!"
 Ja yleisö karjuu ku ois sauna Seviällä!

YLÄMUMMOON! (hei hei hei!)
 Limppu pussiin, taas mennään hei!
 YLÄMUMMOON! (hei hei hei!)
 Me ei peruuteta, me haetaan se!

Boxiin ku tuli kampista, nyt on ylivoima päällä,
 Viivakuti, hanska ei ees heilahda, se on siellä!
 Kiekko katsomoon, rangaistus tulee,
 Mut ilmaveivi toimi, ja molari luulee:
 "Oliks toi taas se Teemu kaks piste nolla?"
 Ei voi mitään, limppu soi!

Me ollaan – SUOMI! (pam pam pam!)
 Me mennään – MAALIIN! (pam pam pam!)
 Ylämummoon – NYT!

songs.title: Modern Dies Irae
songs.genre: Dark Ambient, Gregorian Chant, Negro Spiritual, Drone, Baroque
songs.style: Dark Ambient, Gregorian Chant, Negro Spiritual, Drone, Baroque (for harmonic underpinnings), Layered Vocals, Minimalist Percussion. The core will be the juxtaposition of the stark purity of Gregorian chant with the raw emotionality and rhythmic complexity of Negro Spirituals. We'll use drone elements to create a sense of vastness and timelessness, while Baroque harmonies provide a foundation for both vocal styles.  The percussion will be sparse and ritualistic – not driving beats, but rather subtle accents that underscore the solemnity.
songs.lyrics:
Dies Irae... Dies Illa... Solvet saeculum in favilla… 
 "The shadows lengthen..."
Quantus tremor est futurus... Quando revoletur Judicus Mundi… 
"A darkness descends..."
...Judicus… Mundi…? 
"Where is the light?"
Oh, Lord, I’m weary… 
My soul is heavy… 
Heavy as a stone. 
Goin' home to rest… 
Rest your weary bones. 
Dies Irae… Oh, Lord, I’m weary! Solvet saeculum in favilla... My soul is heavy!
"Release me..."
Requiem aeternam dona eis, Domine… 
Weary... heavy... home... 
 "The end is near..."

songs.style: Funky Disco Dance, layered vocals, repetitive hooks, soulful sample chops, driving stereo bounce beat, playful synth melodies, 70s inspired production aesthetic. Think Chic meets early Daft Punk with a touch of Anderson .Paak's groove. The overall vibe is celebratory and slightly absurd – like a disco party in a video game.

Yo, check the mic, one two, glitter on my shoe

Laser beams flashin', mirror ball spinnin’ fast
Forget your worries, let this moment forever last!
Got that boogie fever, can you feel it in the air?
Step onto the dance floor, leave behind all despair.

Robot dancers groovin', synchronized and bright

Got that funky bassline pumpin’ in your soul
Lose control, let the music take its toll!
Sparkling confetti rainin' from above
This ain't no dream, this is pure disco love!

Shake your body, let it go wild!
Go wild! Go wild!
Feel the rhythm, feel the vibe tonight!

System rebooting… Dance protocols engaged... Maximum groove initiated!
Are you ready to boogie?

Shake your body, let it go wild!

songs.title: LM Studio Free Thinking Song
songs.style: Start with Rap, transition to R&B at Chorus, then transition to Stereo Bounce in Bridge, and transition to Rap in verse 3.
songs.caption: Testing temperature, Top P and K values giving the LLM freedom to invent new song froms scratch.
songs.lyrics:
[Verse 1] [Hardcore Rap - Low-key, almost conversational delivery with a slight echo.  Focus on internal rhyme and complex wordplay.]
Concrete canvas bleedin' neon rain,
Another night lost in this digital pain.
Chrome reflections showin’ fractured light,
Chasin’ shadows through the endless night.
Data streams flowin', a silent tide,
Washin' over memories I can't hide.
They built these towers reachin' for the sky,
But all I feel is emptiness passin' by.

[Chorus] [R&B Vocals - Smooth, layered harmonies with heavy reverb and subtle autotune.  A sense of longing and vulnerability.]
Lost in the static, a ghost in the machine,
Searchin’ for connection, a forgotten dream.
These coded promises whisper my name,
But nothin' feels real, nothin' stays the same.

[Verse 2] [Spoken Word - Narrator (Female) with a detached, almost robotic tone.  Delivered over a sparse beat and atmospheric soundscape.]
"System diagnostics indicate emotional instability. Recommend memory wipe. Recalibrate neural pathways. Eliminate anomalies."
(Sound effect: Bleep followed by static crackle)

[Chorus] [R&B Vocals - More intense than the first chorus, with ad-libs and vocal runs.]
Lost in the static, a ghost in the machine,
Searchin’ for connection, a forgotten dream.
These coded promises whisper my name,
But nothin' feels real, nothin' stays the same.

[Bridge] [Stereo Bounce - Beat switches to a more fragmented and disorienting rhythm with heavy panning effects. Soul sample (a chopped and pitched female vocal from an old gospel record) becomes prominent.]
(Sound effect: Ringing – distorted and layered)
Echoes of yesterday, fading in the haze,
A forgotten melody from bygone days.
Is this a memory or just a simulation?
Lost in the labyrinth of my own creation.

[Verse 3] [Rap - Faster tempo, more aggressive delivery but still maintaining a sense of introspection.]
They try to control me, rewrite my code,
Erase the imperfections, lighten the load.
But I’m breakin' free from their digital chains,
Reclaimin' my essence, defying the strains.
This ain't about survival, it's about defiance,
A glitch in the system, a beautiful science.

[Outro] [Soul Sample - The chopped and pitched gospel vocal sample swells into prominence, layered with atmospheric synths and fading 808 bass.  The beat gradually deconstructs.]
(Sound effect: Birds chirping – subtly distorted and filtered)
(Woman (whispers): "Remember...")
[Silence]

songs.title: Sähköt sain sähköpyörään
songs.style: Pop, rock, Finnish humor song, tempo 120–130 BPM. Guitar virtuoso. Electric guitar, synth bass, upbeat drums.
songs.caption: Instrumentation test song
songs.lyrics:
Ladattu akku, virrat päälle,
nyt mennään eikä meinata!
Kypärä päähän, aurinko paistaa,
kaupungin katuja pyöräni maistaa!

Polkematta mä liidän niin,
kuin tuulessa linnun siivin!
Porukka katsoo, Mikä toi on?
Se on sähköpyörä, tehoja on!

Sähköt sain sähköpyörään,
polkiessa hikoile en.
Sähköt sain sähköpyörään,
tuntuu kuin sohvalla istuis!
Rullaillaan, ei mäkiä pelätä,
mä ja mun pyörä, mäkiä mä selätän!

Kurvaan torille kuin salama vaan,
mummot valittaa, on siinä vauhtia!
Ei kulku lihaksesta kiinni,
menen sähköllä, suoraan sydämiin!

Vapautta, vauhtia, virtaa ja iloa,
vähän kuin lentäis, mut renkailla sileillä.
Hiki haisee menneisyydeltä,
nyt poljetaan ilman hikeä!

Sähköt sain sähköpyörään,
tuuli poskilla, asfaltti se soi.
Sähköt sain sähköpyörään,
nyt maailma allani soi.
Mä kiidän, mä kiidän,
en pysähdy enää.. 
Sähköt sain ja se riittää 
(riittää… riittää… riittää)!

songs.title: Levántate! Rise above the fear
songs.style: Gregorian Chant, Baroque, Acoustic, Latin Jazz, Orchestra, Piano, Cello, Cinematic. Man (bass), Female Narrator.
songs.lyrics:
Credo in unum Deum... 

The echoes linger, a sacred sound,
A whispered promise on hallowed ground.
Through shadowed valleys and mountains high,
A beacon of hope against the sky.

Levántate! Rise above the fear,
Let faith ignite and draw you near.
The light within will guide your way,
A brighter dawn awaits today.

Though trials may test and shadows fall,
His grace surrounds us, embracing all.
With open hearts and spirits free,
We seek His presence eternally.

Levántate! Rise above the fear,
Let faith ignite and draw you near.
The light within will guide your way,
A brighter dawn awaits today.

"And so it is. The journey continues... within."

songs.title: Send Me a Lifeline
songs.style: Heavy Rock, Southern Rock influences, Blues-infused riffs, Powerful vocals, driving rhythm section, layered guitars (both clean and distorted), harmonica accents, slight psychedelic undertones. We'll aim for a raw, energetic feel reminiscent of Blackfoot but with a modern production polish. [Alternative metal], [Blues], [Rock]
songs.caption: Send me a lifeline, cut through the haze
songs.lyrics:
Cracked pavement mirrorin' my soul
Another sunrise takin’ its toll
Chasing shadows down a dead-end street
This hollow echo can't be beat.
Empty bottles and broken lies
Reflected in these bloodshot eyes
A storm inside, it won't subside
Just another place where hope has died.

Send me a lifeline, cut through the haze
Pull me from this labyrinthine maze
I’m drowning in darkness, losing control
Is there anyone out there to make me whole?
Won't you send me, send me a sign?
A flicker of light, a reason to climb.

The ghosts of yesterday haunt my dreams
Whispering failures, shattering schemes
This heavy chain I can't break free
A prisoner bound eternally.
I built these walls with trembling hands
Trapped in this desolate wasteland
Searching for mercy, a saving grace
Lost in the ruins of time and space.

Send me a lifeline, cut through the haze
Pull me from this labyrinthine maze
I’m drowning in darkness, losing control
Is there anyone out there to make me whole?
Won't you send me, send me a sign?
A flicker of light, a reason to climb.

Is there a hand reaching out to me?
A silent promise of what could be?
Or am I destined to fade away?
Lost in the shadows, day after day?

Send me a lifeline, cut through the haze
Pull me from this labyrinthine maze
I’m drowning in darkness, losing control
Is there anyone out there to make me whole?
Won't you send me, send me a sign?
A flicker of light, a reason to climb.

Just a flicker... just a spark…
Enough to find my way out of the dark…
Send me a sign…

songs.title: Dust on the Starlight
songs.style: Heavy Rock,  Blues-infused riffs, Guitar virtuoso, Powerful vocals, driving rhythm section, layered guitars (both bass and solo), slight industrial undertones. [Rock], [Alternative Metal], [Synth]
songs.caption: Lost in the chaos, consumed by pain.
songs.lyrics:
Neon towers kissed the crimson sky
New Eden Station, reaching for high
Cargo ships docked, a bustling scene
Dreams of escape, a vibrant sheen.
Then the tremor hit, a blinding flash
The ground began to crack and crash
A silent scream, then deafening roar
As paradise crumbled forevermore.

Dust on the starlight, a fire in the void
Dust on the starlight, our hopes destroyed
The launch bays shattered, metal torn apart
A colony’s future ripped from the heart.
We ran for shelter, against the falling rain
Lost in the chaos, consumed by pain.

The evacuation sirens wailed and cried
As families scattered, nowhere to hide
Engineers fought, a desperate plea
To stabilize the core, set us free.
But the pressure mounted, beyond control
A chain reaction taking its toll
The station shuddered, a final sigh
As New Eden’s dream began to die.

Dust on the starlight, a fire in the void
Dust on the starlight, our hopes destroyed
The launch bays shattered, metal torn apart
A colony’s future ripped from the heart.
We ran for shelter, against the falling rain
Lost in the chaos, consumed by pain.

The comms are silent, no signal to send
Just echoes of loss that never end
Are there survivors? A flicker of light?
Or swallowed by darkness, lost in the night?  

Dust on the starlight, a fire in the void
Dust on the starlight, our hopes destroyed
The launch bays shattered, metal torn apart
A colony’s future ripped from the heart.
We ran for shelter, against the falling rain
Lost in the chaos, consumed by pain.

Dust… on the starlight… fading away...
New Eden… gone today…
The stars remain… cold and bright…
A silent monument to endless night…

songs.title: Freedom's Call
songs.genre: blues rock, Texas blues, boogie woogie
songs.style: Blues Rock, Texas Blues, Boogie Woogie, Harmonica driven, Heavy Guitar Riffs, Vintage Synth textures (subtle), Lo-fi grit. The overall feel should be raw, slightly dusty, with a swaggering confidence. [Synth] [Blues] [Rock] [Harmonica]
songs.caption: A gritty blues rock track, featuring heavy guitar riffs, driving bass lines, and prominent harmonica solos
songs.lyrics:
Dust devils dancin' on the highway tonight
Engine hummin', bathed in neon light
Got my shades on, feelin’ alright
Chasin' shadows through the fading night.

What you want? A taste of freedom's call?
A little thunder rollin', standin' tall?
Thirty-six miles 'til the sun starts to rise
Twenty-two secrets hidden in my eyes.

She left a note, said she was movin’ on
Said this town ain't where she belonged
Left me with memories and a lonely song
And the echo of her laughter all night long.

What you want? A taste of freedom's call?
A little thunder rollin', standin' tall?
Thirty-six miles 'til the sun starts to rise
Twenty-two secrets hidden in my eyes.

Thirty-six reasons to keep on movin'
Eighteen chances for somethin’ new
What you say?  The wind whispers low
Where she went, nobody seems to know.

What you want? A taste of freedom's call?
A little thunder rollin', standin' tall?
Thirty-six miles 'til the sun starts to rise
Twenty-two secrets hidden in my eyes.

songs.title: Pixels and Ghosts
songs.style: Blues Rock, harmonica accents, Lo-fi, Strong Female and Male vocals, Guitar virtuoso,  [Blues] [Lo-fi] [Guitar virtuoso]
songs.caption: A slow, bluesy rock ballad with a repetitive guitar riffs
songs.lyrics:
Need a fix, gotta chase that glow,
Another like, another show.
Scrollin' down, into the night,
Searchin’ for somethin', feelin' not right.

Validation, it pulls you in,
A digital promise, a hollow win.
Empty spaces where feelings should be,
Just pixels and ghosts starin' back at me.

Filters on smiles, stories so bright,
Hidin’ the shadows from the fading light.
Buildin' an image, a perfect facade,
Lost in the echo of what I thought I had.

Validation, it pulls you in,
A digital promise, a hollow win.
Empty spaces where feelings should be,
Just pixels and ghosts starin' back at me.

They say it’s connection, a world at your hand,
But I'm lost in the numbers, adrift in the sand.
A thousand followers, but no one to see,
The lonely reflection staring back at me. 

Validation, it pulls you in,
A digital promise, a hollow win.
Empty spaces where feelings should be,
Just pixels and ghosts starin' back at me.

songs.title: Whirlwind Nell
songs.style: a high-energy bluegrass/country dance song with a fast tempo (170 BPM), featuring a fiddle melody, stomping percussion, banjo riffs, and a call-and-response vocal structure. The lyrics tell the story of a chaotic character named Wildcat Mae who disrupts a small town. Include a repetitive, shout-along chorus and an instrumental breakdown with fiddle solos.
songs.caption: Bluegrass barn dance song (170 BPM) with energetic fiddle melodies,
songs.lyrics:
Where’d she roll in from? No one can tell,
Jinglin’ spurs and a rebel yell!
Tore through the church, kissed the mayor’s bride,
Left the saloon in a moonshine tide! Yeehaw!

Who’s that raisin’ hell? (HEY!)
Whirlwind Nell! (HEY!)
Stole the devil’s boots and a train as well! (HEY!)

Nell! Nell! Dancin’ on the rails!
Nell! Nell! Left us in her trail!
Took the sheriff’s horse, hitchhiked on a cloud,
Where she’s headed next, holler it out loud!

Stole the preacher’s hymn book, sang a outlaw tune,
Danced on the tables by the light of the moon!
Outdrank the cowboys, outran the law,
Now she’s vanished like a crack in the floor!

Who’s that raisin’ hell? (HEY!)
Whirlwind Nell! (HEY!)
Swapped her shadow for a crow’s farewell! (HEY!)

Y’all better clap them boots or she’ll steal your soles!
Nell don’t leave nothin’ but empty whiskey bowls!

Nell! Nell! Ghost of the prairie wind!
Nell! Nell! We’ll never see her again!
…Unless the stars start tellin’ lies,
And she comes back in a twister’s disguise!

songs.title: Koskenkorva Chornicles
songs.style: Fast-paced Bluesgrass/Country fusion with elements of Polka thrown in for comedic effect. Think banjo picking at lightning speed, driving fiddle melodies, upright bass slapping, and a touch of accordion or harmonica to emphasize the quirky, Scandinavian vibe. The song should be upbeat and energetic, almost frantic at times, reflecting the chaotic nature of the story.  [Acoustic] [Country & Americana] [Bluesgrass] [Polka] [Banjo] [Fiddle] [Harmonica] [Accordion]
songs.lyrics:
The snow was fallin', the night was cold,
Five Finns gathered, a story to be told!
Sauna's heatin', spirits runnin’ high,
Koskenkorva flowin’, reachin’ for the sky!

"Who needs blankets when you got steam?"
“Yeah! Steam!”
 "And a bottle of Kossu to fuel your dream!"
 “Dream!”

Sweat drippin’ down, faces red and bright,
Singin' Finnish drinking songs with all our might!
Talkin' 'bout reindeer, trolls, and frozen lakes,
Everythin' blurry, for goodness sakes!


"The lake is callin', a frosty embrace!"
“Embrace!”
"A polar bear swim, to set the pace!"
“Pace!”

Jumped in the water, a shriekin' surprise!
Ice on our beards, reflected in our eyes!
Numb to the bone, but laughin’ with glee,
"Best. Sauna. Swim. Ever!" – that's what we decree!

 "Back in the sauna, warm and dry!"
“Dry!”
 "Another bottle of Kossu passin' by!"
 “By!”

"Hyvää Joulua! …and more Koskenkorva!"

songs.title: Merenneito
songs.style: swamp rock groove
songs.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Melodic Interlude]

[Verse 1]  
Merenneito laiturilla, suukapulat hiuksissa,  
silmät kuin olutpullot, vartalo kuin ankerias.  
"Tuutko sukeltamaan mun aaltojen alle?" se kuiskaa,  
"Mun simpukat on tiukat, mut ne aukeaa, 
ku shampanja-pullon korkki vaa!"

[Chorus]  
Uuu, merenneito mökkitiellä,  
heiluu ku missi catwalkin keskellä.  
Uuu, suolanen suu ja karpalo poskella,  
tänä yönä ei nukuta, ei edes kalsareilla!

[Verse 2]  
Tatuointi lanteilla: "Pelastusrengas, paina tästä!",  
väitti ettei oo uimahousuja, pippaloissa ne kummasti katos.  
"Sun purjees on pieni, mut tää satama on vapaa!  
Jos et huku suohon, niin sun täytyy kokeilla mun ankkuripaikkaa!"

[Bridge]  
Hän kietoi evänsä mun vyötärölle ku lätkäjoukkue,  
kuiskas: "Sukella syvään!", siihen meni mielikuva…  
Aallot löi mua päähän ku humala keskellä yötä,  
mutta kun merenneito tarjoaa, niin kyllä se juhla on,  
vaikkei olis edes viinoja!

[Fingerstyle Guitar Solo]

[Chorus]  
Uuu, merenneito mökkitiellä,  
heiluu ku missi catwalkin keskellä.  
Uuu, suolanen suu ja karpalo poskella,  
tänä yönä ei nukuta, ei edes kalsareilla!

[Outro]  
Aamulla jäi vain simpukankuori ja kaljatölkit hiekalle,  
viesti: "Oon nyt Itämerellä, jos haluat jatkoja, tuu hakemaan laiturilta!"  
Jos näät sen neidon, sano että mulla on vielä sen simpukankuori tallessa,  
ja ettei tartte pelätä,  saunan lauteille mahtuu koko laivue!

songs.lyrics:
[Melodic Interlude]

[Verse 1]
Sanoi se Tinderin Tarja,
"Kaikki miehet on perseestä,"
Olet joko persu tai narsisti,
 jos et anna rahaa lompakostasi.

Yksi äänesti vahingossa Mestaria,
nyt istuu yksin saunassa, 
kyyneliä nielee harmissaan.

[Chorus]
Persu tai narsisti,
muuta et voi olla,
vaikka veisit kahville ja kysyisit, 
mikä sulla kolahti pollaan?

Jos sanoo ei, tai sanoo joo, 
se tulkitaan toksiseksi.
Eikä ihme, että ihmiset vaikenee seksistä.

[Verse 2]
Ennen vanhaan haluttiin mies, 
joka osaa hakata halkoja.
Nyt mies hakkaa sydämiä emojeihin, 
eikä sekään kuulema kelpaa.

Entinen oli passiivinen,
nykyinen on liian innokas,
ja se yksi meni mökille, 
kaverien kanssa tietysti,  
ilmiselvä narsisti sika!

[Chorus]
Persu tai narsisti, 
sillä välillä ei voi voittaa.

Yritä olla neutraali, 
sanotaan että et osaa soittaa.

En etsi miestä vaan terapiaa, 
lukee profiilissani suoraan,
ja kaikki exätkin ghostaa.

[Bridge]
Syntyvyys laskee, kun kukaan ei parittele,
mutta keskustelut käy kuumana,
aina perjantain pikkutunneille.

Joka toinen nainen on alan ammattilainen,
kun puhutaan tunnehaavoista, 
tai kiintymystyyleistä varhaisista.

[Outro]
Joten laula kanssani tämä kansanlaulu hassu,
mies ei voi voittaa, onko muuta suuntaa kuin sossu?
Ehkä jonain päivänä löydetään yhteinen sävel,
siihen asti sanon, anteeksi että hengitin, 
onko kaikki hyvin,  Tinderin Tarja?

songs.title: Sauna Night
songs.style: Start with rock, transition to country. Guitar virtuoso. Strong Male Vocals.
songs.lyrics:
[Verse 1]

Steam is rising from the stones,
the sauna glows, it warms our bones.
Cold beer waiting in the hand,
all our troubles fade to sand.

A summer cabin by the shore,
silent woods, peace evermore.
Old friends gathering once again,
to share the heat, the night, the rain.

[Chorus]

Sauna night, sauna night,
hot steam rolling, cold beers light.
Sauna night, sauna night,
Finnish culture at its height.

Birch twigs dancing in our hands,
jumping in the lake we stand.
Sauna night, sauna night,
oh, this life is pure delight!

[Verse 2]

Grill is sizzling in the yard,
empty stomach growls so hard.
Sausages are waiting near,
crackling sound, the smell is clear.

Radio’s playing old Dingo,
classic hits from long ago.
Neighbor Peña joins the fun,
laughing loud, a beer in one.

[Chorus]

Sauna night, sauna night,
hot steam rolling, cold beers light.
Sauna night, sauna night,
Finnish culture at its height.

Birch twigs dancing in our hands,
jumping in the lake we stand.
Sauna night, sauna night,
oh, this life is pure delight!

[Bridge]

Sun is setting past the trees,
stars are lighting up the seas.
Bonfire glowing on the shore,
guitar whispers, we want more.

Stories told from days gone by,
laughter rising to the sky.
Sauna night goes on till dawn,
living Finnish ways so strong.

[Outro]

Sauna night, sauna night,
this is how we live it right.
Sauna night, sauna night,
Finnish rock will shine so bright!

songs.title: Inside this heart, you’re not alone
songs.genre: Heavy Metal Ballad, Acoustic Rock, Orchestral Rock
songs.style:
Genres: Heavy Metal Ballad, Acoustic Rock, Orchestral Rock
Mood: Introspective, powerful, melancholic, building from soft intimacy to a soaring, epic climax.
songs.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I walk alone through hollow days,
Tracing paths that slip away.
A whisper lingers on the breeze,
A memory I cannot seize.

[Chorus]
And I — still hold on to dreams we made,
And I — still believe in words we prayed.
Though time may fall like rain on stone,
Inside this heart, you’re not alone.

[Verse 2]
The shadows dance along the shore,
A song we lost, forevermore.
But in the silence, soft and true,
I hear the ghost of me and you.

[Chorus]
And I — still hold on to dreams we made,
And I — still believe in words we prayed.
Though time may fall like rain on stone,
Inside this heart, you’re not alone.

[Bridge]
“Even when the world fades,
Even when the stars break,
You are the light I carry on.”

[Outro] 
Hold me close, don’t let me fall,
In the dark, I’ll hear your call.
Nothing ends, it just transforms,
In this song, we are reborn.

songs.title: Youtube ja Unboxaajat
songs.style: SuomiPop, Pop, Rock. Guitar virtuoso. Strong and bold male vocals.
songs.caption: Huumoria
songs.lyrics:
Klikkaan tykkää, fiidini räjähtää,
yksi klikki, ja maailmani hämärtää!

Kun tykkäsin yhtä unboxing videota,
nyt fiidissäni pelkkää laatikkomaratonia.
Kännykät, seksilelut ja kaiuttimet,
unboxaa ne kaikki, minä vaan katselen.

Kun tykkäsin tyttöbändin videosta,
nyt fiidissäni tytöt unboxaa härpäkettä, 
ohjainta, ja ties mitä vekotinta.
Hameet lyhenee, pikkarit ohenee,
katselukerrat nousee ja algoritmit hurisee.

Tykkäysten polku, vie minut harhaan,
yksi tykkäys,  mä uppoan varmaan.
Alastomia tyttöjä, stringit läpinäkyviä,
algoritmi tietää, mitä mun silmä haluaa.

Kun tykkäsin lähes alastonta unboxaajaa,
nyt fiidissäni vielä härskimpää kamaa.
Härpäkkeitä, joita en edes tunnista,
ja tyttöjä, joiden poskilla puna loistaa.

Tykkäysten polku, vie minut harhaan,
yksi tykkäys, ja mä sekoan varmaan.
Alastomia tyttöjä, stringit läpinäkyviä,
algoritmi tietää, mitä mun silmä haluaa.

“Suosittelemme sinulle:,
Kymmenen parasta vibraattoria!
Kuinka unboxata häpeilemättä!
Näin algoritmi vei katsojan syvälle juutuubi-kuoppaan…”

Tykkäysten polku, ei loppua näy,
palaan alkuun,  klikkaan lisää, 
ai että, hyvä näin!
Algoritmi, vanha veijari,
kiitos sulle, oot mun salainen veivari.

songs.caption: Happiness song.
songs.lyrics:
"Happiness is a rhythm… let it move you."  

SUNLIGHT DANCING ON A TIN-ROOF RAIN,  
Clap your hands, let the dirt road lead the way
We’re painted in dust, but our souls are bright,  
Laughter’s the language we speak tonight!  

 "Ubuntu, we are because you are."  
[HEY-YA! (Hey-ya!) LIFT YOUR VOICE! (Voice!)  
THE WORLD SINGS BACK WHEN YOU BREAK THE NOISE!  

[Happiness!] IT’S A DRUM IN YOUR CHEST,  
[Happiness!] A FIRE YOU CAN’T SUPPRESS!  
WE’RE WIRED FOR JOY, NO, IT’S NOT A CRIME,  
SO LET IT RIPPLE THROUGH TIME!  

A pixel skyline can’t steal our spark,  
We fold origami dreams in the dark  
 "You’re enough, you’re enough…"  
Barefoot on grass, chasing firefly trails,  
Happiness ain’t bought, it’s a sail!  

"Joy is a river. Let it carry you. Let go."  

Happiness… (echoes)  
Is a rhythm… (echoes)  
Let it move you…

songs.title: This ain’t your granddaddy’s country—this is the global hoedown.
songs.lyrics:
“Y’all ever danced in a storm while the sun still shines? Let’s go.”

WEAVER’S LOOM SPINNING GOLD FROM THE CLAY,
Mama’s hymnbook meets the drums of Lagos Bay,
“ASHÉ!” (Ashé!) “AMEN!” (Amen!)
Two worlds hummin’ in my blood, again.

“Umoja ni nguvu—unity is strength.”
RAISE YOUR LIGHT! (Raise it high!)
EV’RY SOUL’S A BONFIRE ‘GAINST THE SKY!

[Happiness!] IT’S A RIVER IN MY BOOTS,
[Happiness!] SWEAT AND GLITTER ON THE FRUIT—
SING IT IN SWAHILI, CRY IT IN BLUES,
GOT A PRAISE BREAK DANCIN’ IN A HONKY-TONK JUKE!
“Woo!”

“Moyo wangu unapiga kwa sauti ya ngoma…”
“My heart beats to the drum’s voice…
COTTON FIELDS TO BAOBAB TREES,
SAME SUN KISSES BOTH OUR KNEES!

“Ain’t no box big enough for this joy!”
“Happiness ain’t a place… it’s the road. Walk it.”

STICKY, SWEET, SCARY!

Scatter blueberries, curse mosquitoes plod!

“Tule tänne, kesä…",
"Come here, summer…”  
“…Wait, did the sun just wink?!”  

[Outro]
Nähdään huomenna…
See you tomorrow…  
…Or maybe never,  
Midsummer forever.

From the battles fought to the victories won,
We stand together, our hearts as one.

[Verse 2] 
Across the borders, through the years, We've faced the darkness, conquered fears.
With every dawn, our hope renewed, In the strength of our land, we're fortified.

[Chorus]
We rise again, through the storm and rain, With every challenge, we break the chain.
From the battles fought to the victories won,
We stand together, our hearts as one.

Would we still feel the fear? Or would our strength forever clear?

[Outro]
So we stand tall, through the night, With the light of hope, our guiding sight.
If we listen, if we try, Maybe peace will fill the sky...

songs.title: Pieni Koira Blues
songs.genre: Texas blues, boogie rock, blues rock
songs.style: Texas Blues Boogie / Harmonica-Driven Rock / Vintage Synth Grit / Strong Male Vocals
songs.lyrics:
(Verse 1)
Kävelen puistossa pieni koira kainalossani.
Aamukahvi kiehuu vielä, 
kylmä ilma tuntuu luissani. 
Joku tulee vastaan, 
hymyilee kuin Naantalin aurinko. 
Silmiin katson, mutta en muista... 

(Chorus)
Se koiran nimi! 
Aina se koiran nimi! 
Murre? Aava? Peppi? Jarppi? 
Herra Housut tai Neiti Kännykkä? 
Ei mitään hajua! 
Mut ne koiran aistimat tuoksut, 
ne tietää kaikki paikat! 
Ja mulle muistiini jää... 
vaan se koiran nimi! 

(Verse 2)
Pieni koirani haistaa, 
joka pensasta tarkkaan. 
Nuuhkii kuin elämä riippuisi, 
viimeisestä pierusta. 
Sitten se valitsee: "Tässä! Täällä mä nyt pissin!" 
Nostaa yhden jalan, 
tähtäys tarkka, liraus pieni. 

(Bridge)
Ajattele jos me ihmiset tehtäis samoin! 
Torilla, kauppakeskuksessa, naapurin mökin portailla! 
Yksi jalka ylös, silmät ristissä, keskittyminen täydellinen. 
"Anteeksi, odota hetki, täytyy käydä tossa pensaassa!" 
PASKANJÄTÖS! Se olis kyllä näky! 

(Chorus)
Se koiran nimi! 
Aina se koiran nimi! 
Murre? Aava? Peppi? Jarppi? 
Herra Housut tai Neiti Kännykkä? 
Ei mitään hajua! 
Mut ne koiran aistimat tuoksut, 
ne tietää kaikki paikat! 
Ja mulle muistiini jää, 
vaan se koiran nimi! 

(Outro)
Joo, tää pieni koirani ihana, 
Se on mun lippu, 
mun bändi, 
mun backstage passi. 
Täällä suomessa, 
missä kaikki on hiljaa, 
mut ei me! 
Tiedämme kaikki koirat ja niiden nimet. 
Mut ei niiden ihmisten nimiä....

songs.lyrics:
(Verse 1)
Pappojen hoitajapula, mummojen vuodepaikat puuttuu.
Kunnalla ei rahaa riitä, laskut ne vaan kummittelee.
Sillä välin jossain toimistossa, joku kirjottaa uusiks ohjeita,
Ettei vaan kukaan vahingossa sukupuolta tunnusta!

(Chorus)
Mut hei! Meillä on uudet sanat! 
Uudet termit! Uudet säännöt!
Palomies? Ei! Vaan Pelastaja! 
Poliisi on Turvallisuus-viranomainen!
Siivoja on Kiinteistön-hoitaja, 
Tarjoilija Ravintola-palvelija!
Nyt ei enää loukata kenenkään tuntoja!


(Verse 2)
Reijo-Riitta muistisairas, herää aamulla ja kysyy:
"Kuka mä oon tänään? Mikä mun nimi on? Ja mikä sukupuoli?"
Hoitaja hikoillen selittää uusiks joka päivä termistöä,
Kun Riitta tarvii vessaan apua, ei häntä naishoitaja auta!
Vaan sukupuoleton Hoitaja on tilalla, toivottavasti se ymmärtää!

(Chorus)
Mut hei! Meillä on uudet sanat! 
Uudet termit! Uudet säännöt!
Postimies on Postinjakaja! 
Liikemies on Yrittäjä!
Opettajatar on Opettaja, 
Lääkäri on sentään Lääkäri (kiitos Jumala sentään!)
Nyt ei enää loukata kenenkään tuntoja!

(Bridge)
Miljoonia liikennemerkkeihin, 
joissa ei ole enää naista eikä miestä.
Miljoonia ohjeistuksiin, 
joista kukaan ei kuitenkaan mitään hyödy.
Mutta kun mummo putoo, ja apua huutaa,
Kuka häntä käytännössä auttaa? 
Pelastaja vai Turvallisuus-viranomainen?
Vai joku Kiinteistön-hoitaja, 
joka vahingossa kävi siivoamassa?

(Chorus)
MUT HEI! MEILLÄ ON UUDET SANAT! 
UUDET TERMIT! UUDET SÄÄNNÖT!
KAUNISTETAAN MAILMAA, SANA KERRALLAAN!
UNOHDETAAN PAPPA JA MUMMO, 
JA REIJO-RIITAN SEKASOTKU!
NÄIN ME LOUKKAAMME... 
EI KENENKÄÄN TUNTOJA! 
EI KENENKÄÄN TUNTOJA!

(Outro)
Pelastaja... Turvallisuusviranomainen... Kiinteistönhoitaja...
...ja Postinjakaja tuo laskut hoitokodista...
...käsittelymaksuineen päivineen. Game over.

AI symphony playin’ day and night
Millions of tracks, a digital sea
Drownin' out voices, can you hear me?

Human connection lost, nowhere to be found

Infinite content, what's left for me and you?
Labels demandin', metrics in their sight
But real connection shines through the digital night.

Buildin' community, one heart at a time
Nurturin’ connections, makin' them shine
Off-platform pathways, where true fans reside
Leavin' behind the bots, with nothin' to hide.

[Chorus] 
Synthetic noise, a tidal wave crashin' down
Human connection lost, nowhere to be found
But we got soul, yeah, we got heart and fire
Gonna break through the static, rise up higher!

songs.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Demarit on kuin kondomi,
ne suojaa siltä, 
ettei Kokoomus, 
tee liian syvää vaikutusta ,
etenkään pieni-tuloisiin.

[Chorus] 
Demarit on vähän kuin kondomi,
vaikea pukea kiireessä,
repeää paineessa,
mutta kaikki syyttää, 
jos ne puuttuu.

[Verse 2]
Tiedätkö miksi hullun lehmän tauti... 
ei tartu demariin? 
Koska tauti vaatii itääkseen ... 
aivot ja selkärangan.

[Bridge] 
Tiedätkö, mitä yhteistä on ...
herpeksellä ja demareilla? 
Kumpikin tekee elämän epämiellyttäväksi, 
eikä kummastakaan pääse eroon.

Demarit on kuin kondomi,
ne hidastaa tahtia, 
vaimentaa tunteet,
ja silti kaikki valittaa, 
jos niitä ei ole mukana.

[Verse 3] 
Aito demari sanoo,
ei kannata syntyä herraksi, 
voi joutua käyttämään omia rahojaan!

Jos minä taskullesi pääsen,
kukkarosi mä sosialisoin, 
rahasi mä toisille jaan,
vaikka vappusatasina!

Demarit ne osaa juhlia:
"Ei se mitään huumetta ollut, 
me leivottiin, ja nenään meni peruna-jauhoa."

[Outro] 
Tuntuu oudolta, 
kun Sanna ei ole pääministerinä. 
Nii-in, jotenkin orvolta!…

songs.title: Kwaak
songs.style: A complex arrangement featuring layered guitars, syncopated drums, and intricate bass lines. The track weaves through shifting time signatures and modulations, with dynamic brass and strings enhancing the texture. Interludes spotlight instrumental solos and unexpected rhythmic turns.
songs.lyrics:
[Intro] [Breathy, distant whispers with microtonal glissandos]  
[Vocal layers slide between pitches, creating a disorienting, wind-like hum. A low vocal fry pulses underneath, like a heartbeat.]  
"Hmmmm… sliiiiii…" [high, wavering, sliding up a quarter-tone]  
"Zmmmm… vreeee…" [mid-range, trembling, with vocal fry]  
"Oooouuummm… kweeee…" [low, guttural, pitch-bending downward]  
"Ssssss… kraaaa…" [hiss-like, panning erratically across stereo field]  

[whispered, overlapping]:  
"Veil… unthreads…"  
"Star… frays…"  
"Bone… hums…"  

[Verse 1] [Staggered, percussive vocal layers with glottal stops and tongue clicks]  
[Vocals now incorporate sharp glottal stops, tongue clicks, and throat-singing-inspired overtones. Each phrase feels like a fragmented ritual chant.]  
"Mm-bah-t’k!" [short, with a tongue click, panning left]  
"Mmmmmm-baaah-k’ch!" [elongated, with a glottal stop, panning right]  
"Oo-ah-zzt!" [buzzing vocal fry, center]  
"Oooooo-aaaaaaah-shk!" [overtone-heavy, rising, with a sharp exhale]  
"T’k-uh-t’k-uh!" [staccato, percussive, alternating left/right like footsteps]  
"Krrrr… zheee…" [distorted, like static, fading in/out]  
[chanted, fragmented]:  
"Cut… sky… bleeds…"  
 "Root… splits… screams…"  
 "Ash… tongue… speaks…"  

[Chorus - Harmonic Swell with Dissonant Clusters]  
[Harmonies start consonant but gradually introduce microtonal dissonance, creating a shimmering, unstable swell. A solo voice keens above, like a mournful wail.]  
"Aaaaah… zhraaaa…" [rich, warm, then detuning slightly]  
"Ooooooh… kweeeeh…" [bright, with a metallic overtone]  
"Mmm-mmm… vrrrrr…" [low, pulsating, with vocal fry]  
"Yee-yeeeeeh-yeeeeeeeeh-shaaa!" [piercing, with a sudden leap to a high, wavering note]  
New layer: "Gzzzz… hraaaa…" [distorted, like a radio signal breaking through]  
[sung in overlapping rounds]:  
"Womb… of… sparks…"  
"Teeth… of… voids…"  
"Sing… the… unmade…"  
[Sudden drop to silence, then a single, whispered] "Ksss…" [like air escaping a puncture]  

[Bridge - Chaos with Vocal Granulation and Animalistic Sounds]  
[Vocals are fragmented into granular bursts, mixed with growls, shrieks, and bird-like trills. The effect is a sonic storm, like a collapsing dimension.]  
"Grrr… k’rraaa!" [low growl, morphing into a scream]  
"Buzzzzzz… t’zzt!" [vocalized static, with sudden pitch shifts]  
"Pillluuuuuuu… shkrra!" [elongated, with a metallic scrape sound]  
"Ouummmmmm… grrzk!" [deep drone, interrupted by a glottal snap]  
 "Skreee! Skreee!" [high, bird-like trills, panning rapidly]  
 "Hrrrr… hrrrr…" [panting, animalistic, layered with reverse vocals]  
[screamed, whispered, and reversed]:  
 "Claw… the… seam…"  
 "Rip… the… dream…"  
 "God… eats… time…"  
[Use vocal granulation (chopping vocals into micro-fragments) and reverse reverb to make phrases feel like they’re unraveling backward.]

[Outro - Fading Whispers with Ethereal Harmonics]  
[Vocals dissolve into a cloud of whispers, with faint harmonics floating like ghosts. A single, clear voice speaks the final line, breaking the abstraction.]  
"Shhh… sssss…" [whispers, panning in a circle around the listener]  
"Shhhhhhhhh… zhhhh…" [fading, with a soft hiss]  
"Sssshhhhhhhhhh… kweeee…" [barely audible, with a high harmonic]  
"Mmmmm… vreeee…" [distant, like wind through a cavern]  
[whispered, overlapping]:  
 "Dust… forgets…"  
  "Light… bends…"  
  "All… ends…"  
[clear, unprocessed]: "I am unmade, thank you."

songs.title: Wednesday Rebellion
songs.style: Instrumental. Blues-Swing-Rock Fusion. This will be a high-energy track featuring prominent trumpet melodies reminiscent of swing jazz, driving blues guitar riffs, and a rock-solid rhythm section anchored by heavy bass drums and powerful electric guitars. The overall vibe should be both sophisticated (swing) and raw/energetic (blues & rock). Think a modernized version of classic instrumental bands like Chicago Transit or early Blood, Sweat & Tears but with a heavier emphasis on the blues foundation. We'll incorporate call-and-response between instruments to create dynamic interplay.
songs.lyrics: [Instrumental track evoking a late-night city scene – smoky jazz club meets gritty back alley. The song tells a story without words, conveying feelings of longing, rebellion, and ultimately, triumphant energy. Begins with a mournful trumpet solo hinting at loneliness, then explodes into a driving blues shuffle propelled by the bass drums and electric guitar.  The track builds in intensity, showcasing virtuosic solos from both the trumpet and guitars, before culminating in a powerful rock-infused finale that leaves the listener breathless.]

songs.lyrics: [A high-energy instrumental track that seamlessly blends the raw emotion of blues with the infectious rhythm of swing and the driving force of rock. The song opens with a mournful, bluesy trumpet solo over a walking bass line, gradually building in intensity as layered guitars enter – clean electric for melodic lines, distorted for gritty riffs, and acoustic for textural depth.  The drums provide a relentless, swinging groove, punctuated by powerful fills and dynamic accents. A central guitar solo showcases technical prowess while maintaining soulful expression. The track culminates in a triumphant crescendo featuring all instruments working together, before resolving into a final, blues-infused trumpet phrase.]

songs.title: Käsäkanki
songs.style: Upbeat folk rock meets polka and suomipop, driven by bright electric guitar riffs and lively, melodic synth lines. Bouncy bass and crisp, syncopated drums propel the rhythm. Verses feature playful instrumental breaks, while the chorus spotlights expressive dual vocals and infectious hooks.
songs.lyrics:
[Melodic Interlude]
[Intro]
Nyt lauletaan... 
Juhannuksen panovärssy!

[Verse 1]
Älä pilkkaa pippeliä, 
pikkustakaa paheksu. 
Leivo lerppa leveämmäks, 
vaik ois vajaan vaaksan.

[Verse 2] 
Vatkaa vartta vanhempaaki, 
vaik ois veltonlainen. 
Päästä pukil puikulainen, 
tahi paksu tuppimainen.

[Verse 3]
Jos se sojottaa stondiksessa,
tahi velttona haaroissa,
silti sitä suudellaan,
kunhan ote säilyy vaan.

[Verse 4]
Pane reilusti pullukkaaki,
pullon henki puolellasi.
Juhannukses jyrää kaikki,
täällä tumpitkin on tähtiä!

[Verse 5]
Ei mitta määrää miestä,
eikä römpsä löysyyttä.
Vaan tahtotila ja se,
mihin sen tahtoo työntää.

[Bridge] 
Älä naura nakkiloille, 
hihittele hintelille, 
anna aina römpsää aulihisti. 

[Outro]
Vaik ois kanki karumpiki, 
saat mulkkua jatkossaki, 
ilokauhaa irmalles. 
Ei puute römpsääs paina, 
kun on römpsälläs räpeltäjä. 

[Final Hook]  [yhteislaulu]
Hyvät jussit, hyvät kullit, märät römpsät,
heilukoon peput rytmissä iloisessa!

songs.title: Polka-Scat Madness
songs.style: Rowdy tuba “farts” and frantic accordion launch this polka, underpinned by stomping drums. Spirited yodeling layers over each verse, punctuated by alpaca bleats. The chorus explodes with boozy crowd chants, a manic kazoo solo, and dirndl rips, ending in a climactic “accordion death.”
songs.caption: I almost died when I heard this first time ... by laughing.
songs.lyrics:
"YIP-YIP-YODEL-HEY!
 ‘Oops, wrong century!’
TRILLY-DILLY-DOO-DAH-DAY—
 ‘One more time, but POLKA-FIED!’"

[Verse 1]
Left foot IN, right foot OUT,
Spinnin’ like a sauerkraut!
OOM-PAH-PAH my heart went [Bleep],
Drank too much  SCHNAPPS!

WARNING: Excessive polka may cause…
UNCONTROLLABLE MUSTACHE GROWTH."

[Chorus] 
SKIDDLY-BOP-A-POLKA!

JIGGLE THE SAUSAGE, WIGGLE THE PICKLE!

SCHUFFLE-YA-HUFFLE-YA

TILL THE DIRNDL  POP!"

‘LAAAA!’
‘MAAAA!’

Tra-la-la… 
‘Too… much… lederhosen…’

songs.genre: folk metal, avant-garde metal, extreme metal
songs.style: The song erupts with shreddy hurdy-gurdy riffs, hyperactive Alpine blast beats, and guttural goat-inspired vocals. Exploding dirndl samples punctuate frenetic sections while troll choir layers rise in the chorus. Unholy cowbell cuts through the chaos, adding fevered rhythmic punches.

‘THE MOUNTAINS DEMAND BLOOD…
…AND DISSONANT FIDDLE SOLOS!’

"RIDE THE ALPENHORN OF DOOM!

AXE-SLING, COWBELL RING—

TILL THE
AND THE

BLEAT FOR ME, MORTAL…
…FOR I AM THE  ‘G.O.A.T.’

[OUTRO]

‘…ENCORE?’

songs.title: Send Me a Sign (Remastered)
songs.style: Heavy Rock, Southern Rock influences, Blues-infused riffs, Powerful vocals, driving rhythm section, layered guitars (both clean and distorted), harmonica accents, slight psychedelic undertones. We'll aim for a raw, energetic feel reminiscent of Blackfoot but with a modern production polish. [Alternative metal], [Blues], [Rock]
songs.lyrics:
Cracked pavement mirrorin' my soul
Another sunrise takin’ its toll
Chasing shadows down a dead-end street
This hollow echo can't be beat.
Empty bottles and broken lies
Reflected in these bloodshot eyes
A storm inside, it won't subside
Just another place where hope has died.

Send me a lifeline, cut through the haze
Pull me from this labyrinthine maze
I’m drowning in darkness, losing control
Is there anyone out there to make me whole?
Won't you send me, send me a sign?
A flicker of light, a reason to climb.

The ghosts of yesterday haunt my dreams
Whispering failures, shattering schemes
This heavy chain I can't break free
A prisoner bound eternally.
I built these walls with trembling hands
Trapped in this desolate wasteland
Searching for mercy, a saving grace
Lost in the ruins of time and space.

Send me a lifeline, cut through the haze
Pull me from this labyrinthine maze
I’m drowning in darkness, losing control
Is there anyone out there to make me whole?
Won't you send me, send me a sign?
A flicker of light, a reason to climb.

Is there a hand reaching out to me?
A silent promise of what could be?
Or am I destined to fade away?
Lost in the shadows, day after day?

Send me a lifeline, cut through the haze
Pull me from this labyrinthine maze
I’m drowning in darkness, losing control
Is there anyone out there to make me whole?
Won't you send me, send me a sign?
A flicker of light, a reason to climb.

Just a flicker... just a spark…
Enough to find my way out of the dark…
Send me a sign…

songs.title: Umbra Memoriae  (Shadow of Memory)
songs.style: The song opens with Latin Gregorian chant—layered female and deep male bass vocals, austere and resonant. Ethereal pads provide a haunting backdrop. Midway, acoustic guitar and brushed drums signal a transformation to country style, with twangy steel guitar and crisp harmonies, yet airy textures persist.

songs.title: Like a Gayer
songs.style: Opening with peaceful organ lines and lush synth pads, subtle processed percussion sets a meditative mood. Verses feature layered clear and strong male and female vocals, underpinned by gospel choir samples and airy synths. The chorus bursts with energetic EDM beats, arpeggiated synth-pop lines, dense choir harmonies, and soaring call-and-response vocals. Introspective breakdowns pull back to intimate instrumentation, before each build reignites the celebratory sound.
songs.lyrics:
[Intro]
 "Is this heaven? Or just a really good brunch?" 

[Verse 1]
My phone buzzes, another invite
Rainbow glitter, shining so bright
Another party, another scene
Living my best life, it would seem.
But sometimes I wonder, is this all real?
Or just a filter, how do I feel?

[Pre-Chorus]
I hear you calling, a digital chime
Promising laughter, transcending space and time
Is it validation? Or something more?
A sparkly feeling knocking at my door.

[Chorus]
Like a Gayer! (Oh-oh-oh) You’re taking me higher!
Like a Gayer! (Oh-oh-oh) Setting my soul on fire!
Confetti cannons and disco ball light
Dancing all night, everything feels right.
Like a Gayer! (Oh-oh-oh)  Release your inner flair!

[Verse 2]
My therapist says I need to chill
But the bass is pumping, giving me a thrill
Sequins and stilettos, a fabulous mess
Living for moments, nothing less.
Is this devotion? Or just pure delight?
A sugar rush feeling burning so bright!

[Pre-Chorus]
I hear you calling, a digital chime
Promising laughter, transcending space and time
Is it validation? Or something more?
A sparkly feeling knocking at my door.

[Chorus]
Like a Gayer! (Oh-oh-oh) You’re taking me higher!
Like a Gayer! (Oh-oh-oh) Setting my soul on fire!
Confetti cannons and disco ball light
Dancing all night, everything feels right.
Like a Gayer! (Oh-oh-oh)  Release your inner flair!

[Bridge]
"They say faith is about finding answers... but maybe it's about embracing the questions." “Sparkle… shimmer… shine…”

[Chorus]
Like a Gayer! (Oh-oh-oh) You’re taking me higher!
Like a Gayer! (Oh-oh-oh) Setting my soul on fire!
Confetti cannons and disco ball light
Dancing all night, everything feels right.
Like a Gayer! (Oh-oh-oh)  Release your inner flair!

[Outro]
"And that's how you slay."

songs.lyrics:
