Halkeillut asfaltti sieluani peilaa,
Jokainen auringonnousu elämääni verottaa.
Jahtaan varjoja päättyvää katua pitkin,
Tätä onttoa kaikua en voi voittaa.

Tyhjät pullot ja paljastuneet valheet
Heijastuvat näissä verestävissä silmissä.
Sisäinen myrsky ei hellitä otettaan,
Mielessä vain yksi paikka, missä toivo on kuollut.

[Pre-Chorus]
Nämä seinät ahdistavat, ilma on ohutta,
En näe ulospääsyä, en voi päästä ulos…

[Chorus]
Lähetä pelastusrengas usvan läpi!
Vedä minut labyrintin syövereistä!
Hukun pimeyteen, menetän hallinnan!
Onko siellä ketään kuka voi auttaa?!

[Verse 2]
Eiliset haamut kummittelevat unissani,
Kuiskaavat epäonnistumisia, särkevät suunnitelmiani.
Tätä raskasta ketjua en saa murrettua,
Olen vanki iäisesti sidottuna.

Rakensin nämä muurit vapisevin käsin,
Ansanomaisesti tähän autioon erämaahan.
Etsin armoa, pelastavaa armonlähdettä,
Hukassa ajan ja paikan raunioissa.

[Pre-Chorus]
Nämä kahleet sitovat, ilma on ohutta.
En näe ulospääsyä, en voi päästä ulos…

[Chorus]
Lähetä pelastusrengas usvan läpi!
Vedä minut labyrintin syövereistä!
Hukun pimeyteen, menetän hallinnan!
Onko siellä ketään kuka voi auttaa?!

[Bridge]
Onko siellä ihmistä auttamaan minut pimeydestä?
Hiljaista lupausta siitä, mitä voisi olla?
Vai onko kohtaloni hiipua pois?
Kadonneena varjoihin, joka ikinen päivä?

[Chorus]
Lähetä pelastusrengas usvan läpi!
Vedä minut labyrintin syövereistä!
Hukun pimeyteen, menetän hallinnan!
Onko siellä ketään kuka voi auttaa?!

[Outro]
Vain välähdys... vain pieni kipinä…
Riittäisi löytämään tieni ulos pimeästä…
Näytä minulle merkki…

songs.title: March till dawn
songs.style: Opens with an ambient pad and distant military snare, gradually joined by hip hop beats and layered African percussion. Gospel-inspired organ and choir chords swell as distorted rock guitars add energy. An EDM drop fuses electronic bass and synths, climaxing in a powerful, diverse percussion finale.
songs.lyrics:
[Intro]
“Stand tall, feel the beat—this is our march! Clap!”

[Verse 1]
Step one—left foot, step two—right foot,
March on rhythm, feel the groove.
Clapping echoes in the air,
United hearts with every pair.
[Spoken word interlude] [Spoken verse] “We’re not just moving; we’re forging a path, a march of purpose, a beat that breaks the silence.”

[Chorus]
Left‑right‑left, feel the thunder roll,
Marching forward, heart and soul.
Cheering rises with each stride,
Victory’s anthem in our pride.

[Verse 2]
Step one—step two—step three, keep the rhythm tight,
Our boots drum the rhythm of hope in the night.
Whispers of comrades echo loud,
We march together, proud and unbowed.

“Every footfall writes history; every heartbeat syncs with destiny.”

[Bridge]
Hold the breath—pause a beat,
Feel the pulse of the drum’s heat.
Soft whistling fills the space,
A moment before the chase.


[Final Chorus]
Left‑right‑left, march onward we go,
Raise your flags high—let the world know.
Clapping in unison, hearts align,
Victory’s song forever shines.

[Outro]
We’ll march till dawn—our steps never cease,
With rhythm as our shield, we find our peace.
Silence falls; the last drumbeat echoes into the horizon.

songs.title: ¡Baila, mi gente!
songs.style: A bold Gospel‑EDM‑Hip‑Hop fusion driving at 128 bpm in 4/4: syncopated conga‑timbales rhythm, EDM double‑kick, and punchy snare rolls with gospel choir shouts. 808 sub‑bass meets bright pluck synths; choruses soar on organ pads. Call‑and‑response vocals (Spanish/English), gospel harmonies, and rap verse interplay, with anthem leads. Transitions use stuttering vocal chops and filtered claps, dropping into EDM synth sweeps plus swelling gospel choir. Stadium-ready, reverberant, and huge—every section bursts with percussive energy and virtuosic guitar.
songs.lyrics:

“Calle abajo, luces arriba, ritmo que no está en un lienzo.”
“La palabra es arma, el beat mi escudo, y yo voy con fuego.”

[Bridge]
“¡Atención! Se acerca la tormenta.”
“El mundo se detiene cuando el beat se vuelve silencio,”
“Y la energía del alma resuena en cada esquina.”

[Chorus]
“¡Baila, mi gente!”
"Somos fuego en la pista, latidos que no mienten,”
“Con el ritmo de la vida y el alma del corazón.”

[Outro]
“Y así seguimos, con fuerza sin final.”

songs.style: A punchy arrangement opens with intricate beatboxing as the percussive backbone. Bold, masculine male vocals enter, delivering melody with strength and texture. Sparse bass pulses and brief synth stabs accentuate the groove. Minimalist layering keeps focus on rhythm and vocal presence.

songs.title: The Crown of Mistakes
songs.style: Starting with acoustic country instrumentation—fingerpicked guitars, warm bass, understated drums—the track builds momentum each verse. By the bridge, layered electrics and bold riffs take over, leading into a climactic, heavy rock finale led by powerful and clear masculine vocals and virtuosic guitar solos.
songs.lyrics:
(Intro)
[Melodic Interlude]
Oh dear, I fear...
How do I overcome this tide?!

(Verse 1) 
I used to hide behind a mask of fear,
Drowning in the whispers I'd hear.
Every gaze was a piercing knife,
Judging the life that I lived inside.
But shadows dance where light can shine,
I took a breath, and stepped into the divine.

(Pre-Chorus)
Faced the crowd, heart pounding loud,
My trembling hands, my sweat-kissed brow.
A coffee stain, my badge of honor,
Laughter broke the chains that bound me.

(Chorus)
I am human, scars and all,
Stand tall even when I fall.
I can laugh, I can cry,
Won't silence the voice that dares to fly.
No matter how hard it may seem,
I'll sing my song, I'll chase my dream.

(Fingerstyle Guitar Solo)

(Verse 2)
We build our walls, hide our cracks,
Afraid of the truth that lacks.
But light will shine when we let go,
Imperfection paints a perfect glow.
The crowd won't care for what they see,
Unless you show your authenticity.

(Pre-Chorus)
Faced the crowd, heart pounding loud,
My trembling hands, my sweat-kissed brow.
A coffee stain, my badge of honor,
Laughter broke the chains that bound me.

(Chorus)
I am human, tears and all,
Stand tall even when I fall.
I can hope, I can dream,
Won't silence the voice that screams.
No matter how hard it may seem,
I'll sing my song, I'll chase my dream.

(Bass Guitar Solo)

(Bridge)
So take the stage, don’t be afraid,
Even if you feel betrayed by thoughts, 
that try to pull you down.
Turn mistakes into your crown.

(Chorus)
I am human, love and all,
Stand tall even when I fall.
I can laugh, I can cry,
Won't silence the voice that asks why.
No matter how hard it may seem,
I'll sing my song, I'll chase my dream.

(Outro)
I'm not perfect, never will be,
But that's the part that sets me free.
Being human means I try, I rise again, I learn to fly.
Wear your fears like armor proud,
Let your laughter sing aloud.
[Fingestyle Guitar Solo][Fade Out]

songs.title: Scar in the sky
songs.style: The song fuses country and Americana roots with heavy metal and rock. Verses feature bluesy electric guitar licks and groovy rhythms, led by deep, gritty vocals. Choruses burst with high gain riffs, thundering bass, and forceful drums, while dynamic transitions amplify the track’s momentum.
songs.lyrics:
[Intro]
Headlights cut the dark like a rusted blade—  

[Verse 1]  
I was born in the echo of a shotgun door slam,  
Raised on back-road dust and nicotine psalms.  
Mama said, “Boy, your silence is a loaded gun—  
cock it wrong and you’ll shoot your own dawn.”  
So I carved my name in a cedar plank,  
Let the sap bleed like secrets I drank.  

[Pre-Chorus]  
I spit out the fear like wintergreen chew,  
Stomped the throttle—bye-bye, rear-view.  

[Chorus]  
I’m the dent in the fender, the scar in the sky,  
A half-lit Marlboro kissin’ the night.  
I bend, I break, I blister, I blaze—  
But I never, ever kneel to the blaze.  
Yeah, I’m cracked clay, but I still hold rain—  
A broke-down anthem in a hurricane.  

[Verse 2]  
I’ve seen churches made of splintered pews,  
Where sinners play guitars with rusted strings.  
Preacher’s breath smelled like 90-proof truth—  
He said, “Salvation hums in broken things.”  
So I tuned my scars to open-G,  
Let the feedback preach back to me.  

[Pre-Chorus]  
I lit a match off my front tooth,  
Watched the past burn in a rear-view.  

[Chorus]  
I’m the dent in the fender, the scar in the sky,  
A half-lit Marlboro kissin’ the night.  
I bend, I break, I blister, I blaze—  
But I never, ever kneel to the blaze.  
Yeah, I’m cracked clay, but I still hold rain—  
A broke-down anthem in a hurricane.  

[Bridge]  
So crank the amp ‘til the tubes ignite,  
Let the broken strings howl into the night.  
Every crack in my voice is a map of the fight—  
Wear your faults like spurs, ride straight through the fright.  

[Chorus—final lift]  
I’m the dent in the fender, the star in the mud,  
A back-road psalm baptized in blood.  
I roar, I rust, I rise, I remain—  
A rebel chord in the pouring rain.  
 (Remain! Remain! Remain!)  

[Outro]  
Tail-lights fade like ghosts on the 65,  
But that six-string growl—  
never dies

songs.title: Beep Back to ’93
songs.style: Hard-hitting hip hop drums anchor the track with crisp snares and deep 808 kicks. Verses deliver rapid-fire rap flow over a looped soulful sample, subtle synth layers, and bouncing bassline. The hook introduces catchy vocal melodies and extra percussion. A sparse bridge strips back to bare beats before returning to the full dynamic arrangement.
songs.lyrics:
[Intro]  
Ayo, Robin Vickery, 1993, rec.humor cross-posted the memes,  
1184 lines of pre-internet dreams—  
Now we flip the whole thread to a high-speed scheme.  
Turn the tape over, let the beat scream!

[Hook]  
Beep—leave a message, don’t hang up, we collectin’ the vibe,  
From the Castle in Edinburgh to the future we ride.  
Nine-three in the flux, every prank in the box,  
Got the nuclear hotline, got the crocodile socks.  
Beep—drop the credit-card scan,  
Or the coordinates—Khan just hijacked the plan.  
We the voicemail vandals, tongue-twist mechanical,  
Still spittin’ in 2025—unstoppable!

[Verse 1]  
MasterCard, Visa, AMEX—leave the digits, we’ll call back flex.  
SAC Missile Storage—name your target, we launch the apex.  
Chris, John, Mike—three dudes, one mic,  
Chekov panic-mode—Khan on the spike.  
Mr. Rogers in the Magic Kingdom, neighborly psyched,  
Steve vs. Matt with the frying-pan fight—BONK, good night!  
David’s machine asks “What are you?”—existential crisis in sight,  
Sister through the window—crash!—call you when the glass is wiped.  
Star Trek theme on the dorm-room boom, “Room 17, final frontier” in the fumes,  
Mission: leave your name, number, and planetary plume.  
Mission Impossible flute, Jim your contact’s consumed,  
30-second destruct—go!—leave the message or kaboom!

[Hook – reprise]

[Verse 2]  
Steve reassembles Elvis’ brain—neural rock-n-roll reign,  
Aliens abducted Steve—National Enquirer chain.  
Gregorian chant for the dial-a-confess lane,  
“Leave your sins after the tone—absolution express train.”  
Granny from ’52: “No fancy gadgets, just relentless redial pain,”  
Kemosabe smoke-signal—leave it at the beep, rain-dance gain.  
Literacy hotline—today’s vocab: supercilious flame,  
Spell it, use it, prove it—next-day callback aim.  
Jeff’s fridge speaks slow—magnets holdin’ your name,  
Ginsu machine slices calls—return ring is your claim.  
Dial-An-Asshole—busy signal, shame,  
But leave your digits—an asshole will call just the same.

[Bridge]  
Break it down like a Casio sampler toy,  
TomTm-MarkMaMaMa—chipmunk-speed deploy.  
Frequency bends, pitch climbs, glitch-joy,  
Bye-bye-bye looped at every decibel—ahoy!  
Billy Joel “Pressure” at exam-time decoy,  
One-two-three-four—leave the message, deploy!

[Verse 3]  
North American Air Defense—give coordinates, bogey destroyed,  
Sherwood forest—pick your deer, unemployed.  
Soviet embassy—sell secrets, paranoid,  
Imaginary number—multiply by i, null-void.  
God, Lucifer, Kirk, City Morgue—switchboard tabloid,  
60 Minutes spoof—Morley Safer deployed.  
Ghengis Khan casting couch—Cool Whip, handcuffs, android,  
Mirror-world antimatter—Hiroshima firecracker avoid.  
Hypnosis script—your eyelids fall, mind toyed,  
At the beep you WILL leave name, number, unalloyed.  

[Final Hook]  
Beep—1993 to infinity, we bend the timeline,  
From dial-up static to fiber-optic prime.  
All these jokes in the ether still shine,  
So press record—your fifteen minutes start… right… NOW—BEEP!

songs.title: A Promise Tucked Inside
songs.style: A gentle waltz in C major at 90 bpm unfolds with soft strings and nylon-strung acoustic guitar, supported by tender brushed drums. Female vocal, captured through a vintage ribbon-mic for a warm, dreamy character, floats above lush orchestral textures. Subtle woodwinds add flourishes between phrases, evoking a nostalgic 1950s orchestral pop atmosphere. During the optional bridge, pizzicato strings and celeste bring heightened intimacy before returning to the swirling, affectionate refrain that’s seamlessly loopable.
songs.lyrics:
[Verse 1]  
I asked the moon in a whisper,  
“Will tomorrow bring me joy?”  
It shimmered like silver paper,  
Then answered with tender poise:  

[Refrain]  
“Let the river run, let the roses bloom,  
Whatever may be, will be.  
Close your eyes, feel the seasons spin,  
Whatever may be, will be.  
Tomorrow’s a song you haven’t heard,  
A feather that drifts on a secret word;  
Hold my hand, we’ll dance right through,  
Whatever may be, will be.”  

[Verse 2]  
I asked the wind in the treetops,  
“Will my heart remain unbroken?”  
It laughed like a runaway carousel,  
And left just this one small token:  

[Refrain repeats]

[Bridge]   
Some days the sky will scatter rain,  
Some nights the stars will hide;  
But every cloud is brushed with light,
A promise tucked inside.  

[Final Refrain]
Let the river run, let the roses bloom,  
Whatever may be, will be.  
Hear the lark in the lilac sky,  
Whatever may be, will be.  
Hum with me now, la-da-da-dee,  
The world keeps turning tenderly;  
Rest your dreams in the arms of time,  
Whatever may be, will be.

songs.title: Feelings (Don’t Forget)
songs.style: At 68 BPM in G♯ minor, a hypnotic pulse emerges: deep 808 sub-kicks anchor whispered shaker triplets, rim-shot snare cuts off-grid. Sub-bass sine and elastic synth-bass flow in dotted-eighth sync beneath dark, side-chained Rhodes 9th/11th chords. Muted single-coil guitar delivers tight 16th-note funk scratches between vocals, weaving a velvety, dusk-lit groove.
songs.lyrics:
[Verse 1]  [Female] 
You will forget… every word you heard…  
[Stacked harmony] “…every word…”  
[Female] But you won’t forget the way I made you…  
[Female]: “…made you…”  
[Female] …feel… inside.  
[Ad-lib] “Uh-aaaaah-huh, right there…”

[Pre-Chorus] [Kick + rim-shot enter. Bass slides from G♯ to C♯ chromatically]  
[Female]  When I looked into your eyes— “Eyes, eyes, eyes…”  
[Female]  …you sank so deep… deeper than sound.  
[whispers] “Deeper… deeper…”

[Chorus] [Full drum groove kicks]  
[Female]  You won’t remember, nah, nah,  
[Choir] “Remember, remember”  
[Female]  ...anything I said… 
But this feeling… [breath] …it’s dripping down your spine.  
[Ad-lib] “Yeah, aaaaaaah, it stays…”  

[Bridge] 
[Female] Remember my fingers… tracing secrets on your skin…  
[Whisper layer, panned] “Secrets…”  
[Female] Words fade, baby… but the shiver...  
[Choir] “Shiverrrrr…”  
[Female] ....it stays.

[Instrumental Break] [Rhodes plays G♯m9 → Amaj7 → Emaj7#11.] [Guitar does slow, sliding 6th-interval bends soaked in spring reverb.] 

[Final Chorus] 
[Female]  Time can pass…  
[Female]  But this taste on your tongue… 
[choir] “Taaaste…”  
[Female]  You won’t recall a single word I spoke,  
[Female]  But baby, the way I made you moan…  
[Choir (9-part, gospel)] “It remains, yeah, remains!”  
[Ad-lib cascade] “Ah-ah-ah—feel me—feel me—”

[Outro]  
[Female] [intimate, lips brushing the mic]  I love you…  
[Whispers, 3 layers, swirling L→R→L] “Love you… love you… love you…”

songs.title: Final Promised Shore
songs.style: Beginning with a mournful a capella vocal rooted in negro spiritual tradition, layered gospel harmonies gently join. African percussion and soft handclaps enter, then a brass second line ensemble weaves through with soulful New Orleans funeral syncopations. The song crescendos with vibrant group vocals and brass improvisation, closing in a slow, reverent cadence.
songs.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Oh, the road is long and dusty
And the ground is stained with pain
We carry brother to the river
In the pourin' Southern rain
Grave's a deep and lonely bed
For a good man, for a good man
With a cold stone for his head
Rest his soul, rest his soul

[Verse 2]
But wait a minute, listen close now
Did you hear that freedom bell?
Brother ain't no longer captive
From this earthly, mortal hell
He done paid his final due now
And the angels call his name
No more sorrow, no more trouble
Only bright and burnin' flame

[Verse 3]
Oh, the Lord has set him free!
From the chain of misery!
Raise a glass and clap your hands, ya'll!
For the greatest show on land!
He’s not gone, he’s just moved on, yeah!
To the final promised shore!
So we gonna play some sweet, sweet music
And we gonna dance and shout for more!

[Outro]
The Lord has set him free, yeah.

songs.title: Viimeinen Polku
songs.style: Opening with a deeply expressive a capella vocal rich in the nuances of negro spiritual tradition, gentle gospel harmonies gradually join. African percussion and soft handclaps provide subtle drive beneath. Brass second line ensemble adds soulful New Orleans syncopations, building tension. The peak features passionate group vocals and exuberant brass improvisation, concluding with a slow, reverent cadence—each instrument drawing down for a poignant finish.
songs.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Viimeinen polku on pitkä ja kylmä, 
ja maa on liukas ja jäinen. 
Me veljen kannamme hautaan, 
tähtitaivaan valossa, hämärässä. 
Hauta on syvä ja arkku kuin peti, 
hyvälle miehelle, hyvälle miehelle. 
Viimeiselle matkalle hänet laskemme,
sielunsa levätköön, sielunsa levätköön.

[Verse 2]
Mutta odotas, kuuntele tarkkaan, 
kuuletko vapauden kaiun? 
Veli ei ole enää vanki, tämän maallisen, 
kuolevaisen taakan. 
Hän on maksanut viimeisen velkansa, 
ja enkelit hänen nimeänsä kutsuvat. 
Ei enää murhetta, ei enää vaivaa, 
vain kirkas, palava liekki.

[Verse 3]
On Herra hänet vapauttanut! 
Kurjuuden kahleista nostanut! 
Kohottakaa malja hänen muistolleen! 
Kuin suurin juhla tässä maassa! 
Ei hän ole kokonaan poissa, 
hän siirtyi kohti viimeistä rantaa! 
Joten soitetaan nyt musiikkia upeaa, 
ja lauletaan ja huudetaan lisää!

[Outro]
Herra hänet vapahtakoot!

songs.title: Ganes
songs.style: A heavy rock track opens with distorted Em riffing and aggressive double kick drums, Verses drop intensity to palm-muted guitars and precise bass/drum grooves, Choruses erupt with full Em-D-C-B7 chords, high-octane leads, thick bass, and rich layers, The bridge features syncopated drums, dual guitar harmonies, and creative effects, leading to an electrifying, high-energy outro.

songs.title: The Midnight Rambler
songs.style: Late-night, mid-tempo roots-rock instrumental in A minor, 95 BPM, 6/8 swing feel. Clean, finger-picked Fender Stratocaster (neck pickup, mild tube reverb, subtle slap-back delay) carries the melody with a blues-tinged. Warm, round fretless bass glides underneath, locking to a soft-shuffle drum kit with brushed snare, light kick on 1 and 4, rim-clicks on 3. Sparse Rhodes chords swell on the backbeat; occasional Hammond B3 fills swell in like distant traffic. After the second chorus, add a restrained slide-guitar break (volume pedal swells, no distortion). Gradually build dynamics with a soft analog pad, then drop back to trio for a quiet outro, letting the final Strat note decay into plate reverb. Overall mood: cinematic, wistful, neon-lit highway at 2 a.m.

songs.title: Dust Devil Shuffle
songs.style:
1970s Texas roadhouse boogie rock instrumental, raw and greasy.
Tempo ~132 BPM, 12/8 shuffle groove, key of A minor with blues-scale riffs. Dual crunchy tube-amp guitars (slightly overdriven vintage Marshall tone) trading licks: pinch harmonics, sliding pentatonic riffs, chicken-pickin’, occasional whammy-bar dips. Tight but roomy rhythm section: woody Fender Precision bass locking to a laid-back yet driving drum kit—rim-click snare, fat kick on 1 & 3, hi-hat opened for swagger. Light Hammond B3 swells and bar-room piano stabs for texture. Lo-fi analog production: warm tape saturation, spring reverb on guitars, subtle slap-back echo, faint vinyl crackle. Structure: 8-bar intro → verse groove → call-and-response guitar solo section → breakdown with muted strums → final solo ride-out → quick stinger ending. No vocals, no lyrics. Rough, dusty, whisky-soaked swagger.

songs.title: Swamp Stomp
songs.style:
Late-1960s psychedelic blues-rock instrumental inspired by classic wah-wah workouts. Tempo ~74 BPM, swung 4/4 groove with open hi-hat, deep kick and snare rim-shots for that loose, hypnotic pocket.
Key of E minor, heavy Dorian/Blues-scale riffing. Lead guitar: thick, liquid Stratocaster through cranked Marshall stack, long sustain, aggressive wah-wah sweeps, octave slides, feedback swells, reverse-delay tails. Rhythm guitar: Uni-Vibe swirl, muted chugs and wide chord stabs, left-side stereo. Bass: warm, round Jazz/Precision bass locking to kick, occasional walk-ups. Drums: roomy vintage kit with gated reverb on toms, loose snare rattle, subtle ride-bell accents.
Light tape-echo throws and spring reverb on everything. Structure: long intro jam → riff statement → extended wah solo section → breakdown with rising feedback → final explosive solo → abrupt tape-stop ending. No vocals, no lyrics. Swampy, trippy, molten-amp intensity.

songs.title: Sunbaked Highway
songs.genre: Southern rock, classic rock, boogie rock
songs.style:
1970s Southern rock anthem instrumental in the spirit of a swaggering, open-road boogie. Tempo ~98 BPM, straight-ahead 4/4 with laid-back but driving pocket. Key of D major (mixolydian inflections), bright and ringing. Triple-guitar weave: Guitar 1 – clean Fender Telecaster on the right, chiming open-position riffs, chicken-pickin’ double-stops.
. Guitar 2 – crunchy Les Paul in the center, power-chord crunch and sliding fifths. Guitar 3 – slide guitar on the left, melodic answers with glass-bottle sustain. Rhythm section: warm, round bass locking to a roomy drum kit—fat snare crack, subtle ghost notes, ride-bell accents; cowbell on back-beat for extra Southern swagger. Light tack-piano stabs and Hammond B3 swells tucked in the background.
Production: analog tape warmth, plate reverb on guitars, short slap-back on snare, faint room echo for arena-size feel.

songs.title: Roadhouse Rumble
songs.genre: Southern rock, classic rock, boogie rock
songs.style:
1970s Southern rock anthem instrumental in the spirit of a swaggering, open-road boogie. Tempo ~98 BPM, straight-ahead 4/4 with laid-back but driving pocket. Key of D major (mixolydian inflections), bright and ringing. Triple-guitar weave: Guitar 1 – clean Fender Telecaster on the right, chiming open-position riffs, chicken-pickin’ double-stops.
. Guitar 2 – crunchy Les Paul in the center, power-chord crunch and sliding fifths. Guitar 3 – slide guitar on the left, melodic answers with glass-bottle sustain. songs.title: La Mande 2
songs.genre: boogie rock, blues rock, Southern rock
songs.style: A raw 1970s Texas roadhouse boogie rock instrumental at 132 BPM in 12/8, A minor. Starts with an 8-bar intro, dual vintage Marshalls laying greasy pentatonic guitar licks—pinch harmonics, chicken-pickin’, slides, and whammy dips—over a woody Fender P-Bass tight to a laid-back drum groove: rim-click snare, fat kick, loose hi-hat. Hammond B3 swells and bar-room piano add bite. Lo-fi analog vibe: warm tape, spring reverb, slap-back echo, faint vinyl crackle. Structure moves from verse groove to call-and-response solos, a muted breakdown, then a reeling solo ride-out before a sharp, quick stinger.

songs.title: Swamp Stomp 2
songs.style: A late-1960s psychedelic blues-rock instrumental in E minor at 74 BPM, anchored by a swung, loose pocket with open hi-hat, deep kick, and snare rim-shots. Lead Strat delivers wah-driven Dorian/blues riffs, octave slides, and feedback wails. Uni-Vibe rhythm pans left with chugs and stabs, while bass grooves tightly with kick and walks up in spots. Roomy, reverbed drums, gated toms, rattle-y snare, subtle ride bell. Spring reverb and tape echo saturate the mix. Structure flows: jam intro, riff section, wah solo, breakdown with rising feedback, explosive solo, tape-stop ending; molten, trance-inducing energy throughout.

songs.lyrics:
[Intro]
The quiet cost of a quiet mind...
A debt of silence I can never find.
This peace... is just a well-placed lock.

[Verse 1]
The script is ancient, but the cast is new.
Some claim the digital altar, others kneel in the dew.
They call this order... the great divide.
Where virtual chains are worn with hollow pride.
I trade my freedom for a fleeting glow.
A golden algorithm tells me where to go.

[Pre-Chorus]
They promised shelter! A life well-defined!
But the definition... is to leave your soul behind!

[Chorus]
I AM THE RITUAL!
The lie we sell ourselves for grace!
THIS GILDED CAGE is just a miserable space!
To chase the shadow of a selfless plea,
When every action is a hunger just for me!
You wanna live?
THEN BURN THE LAW THAT CLAIMS TO SET YOU FREE!

[Verse 2]
The system whispers, “Hold the line, conform!”
Though every fiber screams a coming storm.
To fall in rank, to lose the fight, is justice they demand!
A casualty of an abstract fatherland.
But whose command is worth the final wound?
If inner purpose cannot be found.
Stand your ground? Or simply cut the thread?
Of loyalty to the ghost... of the truly dead.

[Bridge]
No fire burns so brightly... no pixel wall so tall...
That the true price of silence cannot break and let it fall.
Stop seeking solace in the world you built outside...
The empty trophy, the unquenched tide.
Happiness is not data... it's a terrifying choice...
...To listen to the one... authentic voice.

[Chorus]
I AM THE RITUAL!
The lie we sell ourselves for grace!
THIS GILDED CAGE is just a miserable space!
To chase the shadow of a selfless plea,
When every action is a hunger just for me!
You wanna live?!
THEN BURN THE LAW THAT CLAIMS TO SET YOU FREE!

[Outro]
The poor man isn't broke... but simply lost the nerve to stop...
He who always craves... just one more drop...
And nothing is more foolish... nothing more absurd...
Than the fear you feel... before you say the final... simple word...
"NO!"

I slam the lid shut, I kill the sound 
But the static still screams in my head...

Swear I'll find a real silence where my heart can be found
But even the quiet just whispers the past
The algorithm's shadow, forever built to last.

[Outro]
[Stereo Bounce]
[Bass Guitar Riff]
Log in... Log out...
Refresh... Reply...
Scroll... Swipe...
...Nothing.

Monday... Static.
Tuesday... Silence.
Wednesday... 404. Soul not found.
[Fade out]

songs.title: The Cartographer's Enigma (A Minecraft Ballad)
songs.genre: lofi hip hop, boom bap, cinematic trap
songs.style: Opening with atmospheric Lofi Hiphop—dusty vinyl crackles, mellow piano, minimalist beats. Verses ride a deep Boom Bap groove: punchy kick-snare, sparse samples, moody bass, and intellectual, hard-edged Hiphop flow. Choruses/bridge erupt into Cinematic Trap: massive 808s, rapid hi-hats, soaring orchestral strings, bold synth stabs, epic brass, evoking quest grandeur. The climax layers trap percussion with anthemic symphonic textures, climaxing in a powerful, cavernous surge of sound.
songs.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
In the consecrated stone of The Church, the quest begins, Seven minutes of silence, before the noise of sins. I stand beneath the spire, a seeker with a doubt, The sacred compass spinning, trying to work it out. The coordinates I’ve saved: “Church-one-south-west,” a cross I saw, A distant, lonely landmark, defying natural law. But the maps are in confusion, two copies bearing “one south-east,” A cartographic paradox, staring back at me. I scan the grand mosaic of the board where knowledge rests, To verify the bearing, to pass the silent tests.

[Pre-Chorus]
A breath drawn deep, the path is set, the memory’s restored, Now to the hidden coffers, where the wealth is duly stored. For the journey calls for readiness, for light and hardened steel, The gravity of the unknown, the fear that I must conceal.

[Chorus]
Oh, the pixelated frontier, where the legend takes its shape, From the safety of the sanctuary, to the wild, unknowing scape. With Diamond and with Enchantment, a torch in every hand, I chase the phantom landmark, across this crafted land. The Cross upon the island, a sign of fate or grace, A sacred geometry in this temporal, blocky space.

[Verse 2]
Sixty-four times two of Torches, ready to ignite the deep, To banish shadows where the ancient secrets sleep. The Pickaxe and the Sword, with enchantments sharp and true, Efficiency, Fortune, Sharpness—what else can they do? I don the gleaming shell: the Helmet, Plate, and Greaves, Protection, the promise that my fragile form believes. Two Bows and a Crossbow—a quiver full of plight, Tools of distant reckoning, against the encroaching night. [Hark to the sound of readiness, a metallic, solemn ring,] The final moment of preparation, before the ocean’s sting.

[Pre-Chorus]
The church doors close behind me, the familiar left untold, My wooden dinghy waiting, a story to unfold. The shoreline fades to distance, the water starts to lap, Pulled by the mythic promise, I bridge the empty gap.

[Chorus]
Oh, the pixelated frontier, where the legend takes its shape, From the safety of the sanctuary, to the wild, unknowing scape. With Diamond and with Enchantment, a torch in every hand, I chase the phantom landmark, across this crafted land. The Cross upon the island, a sign of fate or grace, A sacred geometry in this temporal, blocky space.

[Bridge]
The boat now grounds upon the shore, the objective in my view, But a crucial, philosophical test, is what I must now do. I take a block of Sand and drop it, into the azure tide, To check the physics of the plane, where hidden realms reside. Does it rise against the current? Does it defy the fall? Is this a pocket of the Nether, answering some dark call? If the sand had floated upward, a Portal I would frame, A gateway to the underworld, a terrifying game. But the laws hold fast, the grains descend, a normalcy I face, No hellish intervention mars this solitary place. (This adherence to the natural, is it comfort or a ruse?)

[Verse 3]
The enigma's not external, the truth lies deep below, I raise the Pickaxe to the earth, a determined, heavy blow. A single block removed, then two, then three—the dirt gives way, And through the fractured crust, is born a subterranean day. Lo and behold, a CAVERN vast, a chasm dark and deep, Where secrets yet untold and monstrous dangers sleep. The cross stands tall above me, but the darkness pulls me in, The true exploration waits, where my new journey can begin.

[Outro]
The mystery of the surface… solved for now. The greater mystery… awaits below.  The cavern calls...

songs.title: The Descent into the Vein (Minecraft)
songs.style: The track fuses orchestral strings and brass with heavy trap beats, rolling 808s, and crisp hi-hats. Layered synth textures build suspense, while cinematic sound design—like rising swells and punchy hits—escalates each drop. Intermittent choral pads and glitchy FX inject tension throughout.
songs.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The surface fades to rumour, the sunlight a quaint myth, I breached the Sandstone Peak, descending to the pith. No mere fissure greeted, but a vast, sprawling Cave System, A network subterranean, a complex, dark ecosystem. The Diamond Pickaxe echoes, carving through the stone, The silence here is heavy, a language all its own. I find the spoils of others, forgotten, dusty Chests, A miner's past surrender, now subject to my tests. Iron, gold, and lapis—the earth’s slow, rich yield, The cost of this extraction, the truth that must be healed.

[Pre-Chorus]
The treasures are abundant, the veins of ore run deep, But the encroaching darkness, is a vow I cannot keep. My ninety-six-stack lanterns, a flicker in the void, This darkness holds a power, that must be nullified.

[Chorus]
I need the flame, the torchlight, a categorical command, Five hundred blocks of brilliance, held tight within my hand. To push back the obscurity, to claim the territory won, To banish every shadow where the hostile work is done. The Descent into the Vein, where ethics disappear, I drill the heart of the mountain, transcending mortal fear.

[Verse 2]
The Skulking Spiders hiss, the Zombies drag their feet, The cost of raw material, is always bittersweet. My enchanted gear is singing, a symphony of blows, As I fight the wave of chaos, that only darkness knows. The click of the Crossbow, the twang of a driven Bow, My life-bar flickers crimson, a constant ebb and flow. Every step a calculus, of risk against reward, A desperate, lonely battle, with sword against the hoard.


Then I see the silent stalker, the glitch in natural code, The tall, black form of Enderman, upon the stony road. He doesn’t strike with malice, but a calculating stare, A watcher from a dimension, whose burdens I now share. Is this a mere coincidence? Or a metaphysical sign? That the strata I am breaking, touches on the truly Divine? He guards the edge of the Known, the threshold of the Void, His presence is a whisper, a purpose undestroyed. The closer to the Core, the stronger the Alien draw, The Enderman is telling me: You’re breaking higher law!

[Verse 3]
The philosophical riddle, will have to wait its turn, Practical survival, is the lesson I must learn. The darkness is the tyrant, demanding its full fee, And to conquer this domain, I must temporarily flee. I need the Charcoal furnace, the saplings and the axe, To forge five hundred beacons, before my will collapses. My inventory is sorted, the valuables are saved, The tunnel now my roadway, back to the light I craved.

[Outro]
Back to the surface air... to gather and to plan. The Enderman watches... the destiny of man. Five hundred torches... the conquest must be bright.

songs.title: Renkaanvaihtobiisi
songs.style: Blistering electric guitar riffs take center stage in the verses, locked to a punchy rhythm section. Choruses explode with aggressive drums and a pulsating bass under harmonized male and female vocals, while short guitar solos thread through, amplifying the song’s dynamic intensity.
songs.lyrics:
[Säkeistö 1]
Tasainen maa ja tunkki vahva, auto saa turvan ja ohjauksen tahdin. 
Käsijarru päällä, vaihde päällä, nämä askeleet tärkeitä heti tässä.
Vanha rengas, uusi viereen, pyörimissuunnan nuolet tarkistaen. 
Ristivaihto tasaa kulumaa, se on ammattilaisen salaisuus.
Löydä sopiva hylsy, se on avain tähän menoon. 
Pultit löysää, puoli kierrosta,  kun renkaat maassa vielä on. 
Sitten tunkki nostokohdalle,  nosta autoa varovaisesti! 

[Kertosäe]
Turvallisuus on aina tärkein, 
älä unohda sen periaatetta koskaan!  
Ohjekirja on ystävä, se auttaa kun et tiedä!

[Säkeistö 2]
Pultit irti, puhdista kierteet, hiekka ja lika pois sotkemasta.
Jos jumii laippa, ruostetta siellä, pieni tönäisy riittää.
Tarkista hetki, jarrut ja vuodot, elämän turvat, ne kaikki tärkeät. 
Varmuuden vuoksi, ennen kuin jatkat, katso että kaikki kunnossa on.

[Kertosäe]
Turvallisuus on aina tärkein, 
älä unohda sen periaatetta koskaan!  
Ohjekirja on ystävä, se auttaa kun et tiedä!

[Silta]
Nyt uusi rengas paikalleen, tippa vaseliinia kierteeseen, ei koskaan liikaa! 
Pultit alhaalta ylös, sivulta sivulle, sormilla tarkkaan keskittäen, 
sen on mentävä perille!  
Kiristä ristiin yksi kerrallaan, älä tiukenna liikaa vielä,  kun auto vain ilmassa riippuu, kymmenen kilon voima siihen riittää.

[Kertosäe]
Turvallisuus on aina tärkein, 
älä unohda sen periaatetta koskaan!  
Ohjekirja on ystävä, se auttaa kun et tiedä!

[Outro]
Auto alas, kiristä momenttiavaimella pultit tiukaksi,  
Ristikiristys viimeisen kerran, 
sitten vanhat renkaat kunnolla säilöön. 
Rengaspaineet kohdilleen, koeaja, tarkkaile tunnelmaa, 
renkaanvaihto onnistui, nyt tie kutsuu taas!
Muista jälkikiristys!  Se säästää hengen!

songs.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Tänään yö on täynnä varjoja, mut mä en jää katsomaan.
Etsin jotain, jotain enemmän, kuin haamuja menneestä.
Jokainen valo cityssä, kutsuu hiljaa nimeäni .
Tää on helppoo, tää on nopeeta, en tarvitse tunteita.

[Chorus]
Pikarakkaus, säästyn yksinäisyydeltä
Pikarakkaus, uusi nimi muistoihisi jää
Pikarakkaus, tää on kaikki mitä tarvitsen...
... että selviän

[Verse 2]
Sua eksäni, en muista enää, enkä hajonneita lupauksiani,
Vihasikin on pesty pois, paidasta ja farkuistani.
Mutta sormus viiltää vieläkin, ja muistoista on arvet,
Siksi tänään tarvitsen sun lämpöäsi, en sun sydäntäsi.

[Chorus]
Pikarakkaus, säästyn yksinäisyydeltä
Pikarakkaus, uusi nimi muistoihisi jää
Pikarakkaus, tää on kaikki mitä tarvitsen...
... että selviän

[Bridge]
Ja vaikka aamu tuomitsis,
Nyt sun hengitys on kaikki mitä tiedän.
Ei olla rakastumassa,
Vaan toisiamme hoitamassa.

[Chorus]
Pikarakkaus, säästyn yksinäisyydeltä
Pikarakkaus, uusi nimi muistoihisi jää
Pikarakkaus, tää on kaikki mitä tarvitsen...
... että selviän

Pikarakkaus... unohda mun nimeni...
Pikarakkaus... unohda mun nimeni...

songs.title: Sosiaalisten tilanteiden pelkoa
songs.style: Suomi-pop, synth-pop, smooth soulful male vocals, Finnish (Suomi), Instrumentation: pulsating synth bass, acoustic guitar, guitar virtuoso, crisp drums, Fender Rhodes electric piano, atmospheric synth pads, deep baritone vocals, Mood: melancholic, smooth, confident, nostalgic, late night drive, funky
songs.lyrics:
[Verse 1] 
Ennen kätkeydyin pelon naamion taakse,
Kuulin kuiskausten vyöryn, ne kaikuivat päässäni.
Vasta nyt tajuan: se veitsi ei ollut heillä, 
Se kasvoi minussa, tuomiten sen mikä sisälläni eli.. 
Mutta varjot tanssivat siellä missä on valoa, 
Otin henkeä, ja lähdin rohkeasti ulos.

[Pre-Chorus] 
Siinä seison, sydän hakkaa, kädet tärisee, 
Otsalla hikipisarat, vatsaani vääntää. 
Mutta mielessäni käännän peilin, 
Näen, että huumori on se, joka aamunkoiton luo.

[Chorus] 
Olen vain ihminen, arpineni ja haavoineni. 
Nousen ylös aina, vaikka kaatuisin, 
Voin olla ristiriita, pala palalta koossa. 
Tämä ääni on totta, ei yhteiskunnan myymä rooli.
Ei väliä vaikeudesta... 
Laulan lauluni, seuraan unelmaani.

[Verse 2] 
Me rakennamme muureja, peitämme halkeamia. 
Pelkäämme sitä totuutta, mikä meiltä puuttuu. 
Mutta valo loistaa, kun vain päästämme irti .
Ei tarvita maskia, kun repeämä on taidetta. 
Yleisö ei katso sitä, mitä luulet, 
Ennenkuin näytät olevasi aito ihminen.

[Bridge] 
Joten ota askel, älä pelkää,
 Vaikka tuntuis, että petetty oot.
 Ajatuksilta, jotka alas vetää, 
Käännä draamasi absurdiksi tanssiksi.

[Outro] 
En ole täydellinen, en koskaan tule olemaan,
Mutta se on sitä, joka vapauden antaa.
Tämä on lupaus: en juokse pakoon enää koskaan. Huomenna alan uudestaan, kunnes pelko on vain muisto.

songs.title: Olen vain ihminen
songs.style: Suomi-pop, synth-pop, smooth soulful female vocals, Finnish (Suomi), Instrumentation: pulsating synth bass, acoustic guitar, guitar virtuoso, crisp drums, Fender Rhodes electric piano, atmospheric synth pads, deep vocals, Mood: melancholic, smooth, confident, nostalgic, late night drive, funky
songs.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Ennen piilouduin pelon paksun naamarin taa, se tuntui voimaltaan oudon suurelta…
Kuiskaavat äänet ropisivat mieleeni, kuin sade yöllä vasten ikkunaa.
Ja vasta nyt mä ymmärrän — se terä ei ollut toisten käsissä, ei…
Se kasvoi sisälläni, varjona joka piti totuuden tiukasti lukossa.
Mut varjot ei synny ilman valoa, niissä on aina rako toivoon.
Niin hengitin syvään — ja astuin ulos, vaikka polvet vapisivat kuin haavan lehti.

[Pre-Chorus]
Ja siinä mä seison…
Kädet tärisee, hiki helmeilee, vatsassa temppuilee kuin tivolin laitteessa.
Mut mielessäni mä käännän peilin —
ja huomaan, että pieni huumori se hohdon tuo.

[Chorus]
Oon vain ihminen — arpineni, haavoineni,
ja nousen aina ylös, vaikka maailma vetäis kanveesiin.
Voin olla ristiriita, mut hei, palapeli toimii näinkin.
Tää ääni on tosi — ei mikään rooli, jonka joku muu mulle myi.
Ja vaikka tie ois kivinen,
laulan lauluni ja seuraan unelmaa, joka kasvaa joka kerta kun hengitän.

[Verse 2]
Me muurataan ympärille suojia, tilkitään halkeamia parhaamme mukaan,
pelätään sitä kohtaa meissä, jossa vielä on kysymysmerkkejä.
Mut valo pääsee sisään vasta kun uskalletaan höllätä…
Eikä maskia tarvita, jos särö onkin se kaunein kohta.
Ja yleisö — se ei koskaan nää sitä mitä luulet,
ennen kuin näytät, ettet ole kone, vaan sydämellinen, elävä ihminen.

[Bridge]
Siis ota askel — älä säikähdä,
vaikkei sydän uskois omia sanojaan.
Kun mieli yrittää vetää mattoa alta,
tee siitä draamasta tanssi, vaikka vähän absurdikin —
siinä on jo voiton siemen.

[Chorus]
Oon vain ihminen — arpineni, haavoineni!
Nousen ylös AINA, vaikka kaatuisin, 
Voin olla ristiriita, mut pala palalta kasvan kasaan.
Tää ääni on totta — ei maski, ei rooli, ei markkinoiden muotti.
Ja vaikka tie ois kivinen,
laulan lauluni ja seuraan unelmaa, jonka kepeys kantaa.

[Outro]
En ole täydellinen — enkä koskaan tule olemaan.
Mut ehkä just se on se, mistä vapaus alkaa.
Tän lupauksen annan: en enää karkaa varjoihin.
Huomenna aloitan uudestaan —
kunnes pelko on vain lämmin muisto siitä, miten pitkälle pääsin.

songs.title: Have You Ever Felt the Pain?
songs.genre: swamp rock, roots rock, blues rock
songs.style: swamp rock, roots rock, and blues rock, characterized by its Southern-inspired lyrical themes and down-to-earth sound,. Guitar virtuoso and bold and masculine male vocals.
songs.lyrics:
(Verse 1)
Someone told me long ago
There's a calm before the fever
I know, it's been creepin' up for quite some time
When it's over, so they say
You'll be standing in the sun
I know, but there's a shadow on your mind

(Chorus)
I want to know, have you ever felt the pain?
I want to know, have you ever felt the pain?
Sneaking in on a sunny day?

(Verse 2)
Yesterday, and days before
The chills would shake this frame of mine
I know, it's been a fight to stay right here
But time rolls on, and so it goes
Through the weakness and the strength
I know, it lingers like a silent fear

(Chorus)
I want to know, have you ever felt the pain?
I want to know, have you ever felt the pain?
Sneaking in on a sunny day?

(Bridge)
Yeah!

(Chorus)
I want to know, have you ever felt the pain?
I want to know, have you ever felt the pain?
Sneaking in on a sunny day?

(Outro)
Have you ever felt the pain?
Comin' down on a sunny day?...
Sunny day...

songs.title: Filosofiaa
songs.style: Starts with intricate fingerpicked riffs on both stratocasters and jazz guitars, weaving around each other, Hammond B3 organ adds soulful, warm chords, Drums supply a laid-back yet driving pub rock groove, while a walking bass powers the rhythm, locked tight with inventive fills, Masculine and bold male vocals.
songs.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Tajunta meillä kai yhteinen on, mutta en tiedä, tiedänkö edes sen. 
Jokaista asiaa, jokaista kysymystä, täytyy katsoa kahdelta puolelta. 
Vaan tapoja on hiton vaikea rikkoa, vaikeampi kuin luontoa vastaan.

[Chorus]
Sinä olet toinen minäni, mutta puhdasta totuutta ei kukaan tunne. 
Kahdesti et samaan jokeen astu, uudet vedet siinä virtaavat. 
Se, mikä ei tapa, se vain tekee vahvemman.

[Verse 2]
Jos hylkäät kohtuuden, paras muuttuu vastenmieliseksi. 
Koirat haukkuvat vaan sitä, mitä eivät itse tunne. 
Anna ajan hallita, se on neuvonantajista viisain.

[Chorus 2]
Kohtalo on syy-seuraus-ketju, se antaa kaikelle järjestyksen.
Hän joka tekee vääryyttä, on onneton, onnettomampi kuin hän, joka kärsii.
Tyhmä toivoo pitkää ikää, mutta ei osaa olla siitä onnellinen. 
Hyvä ei ole olla tekemättä väärin, vaan se, ettei edes halua tehdä väärin.


[Outro]
Monet jotka tekevät mitä häpeällisimpiä tekoja, pitävät mitä mainioimpia puheita.

songs.title: Algotriminen Joulu
songs.style: This Christian & Gospel Singer-Songwriter track opens with mellow vintage synth pads and soft crackling vinyl noise. Downtempo beats and gentle electric piano arpeggios set a warm base, while glitched festive bells and airy ambient textures join, layering an atmospheric, calming groove.
songs.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Ulkona sataa lunta, ei painetta kalliista lahjasta. 
Olen sytyttänyt kynttilän, jonka valo heijastuu ikkunasta. 
Ei tarvitse esittää, ei kilpailla, vain istua ja hengittää syvään. 
Pöydällä tuoksuu paistos, paras ateria, ei rahan, vaan lämmön luoma. 
Se on täydellinen hetki, koska siinä ei ole toiveita, vain lupa olla olemassa.

[Verse 2]
Ei ole monia ääniä, jotka tähän hiljaisuuteen vastaisivat, 
vain kissa ja muistot, jotka mieleni peittävät. 
Tänä jouluna ei ovikello soi, mutta valintani on olla luhistumatta, antaa sielun levätä. 
Sitten kuului ääni... ei-ihminen... ei-tuomari.... se on algoritmi, tonttu koodin muodossa. 
Se ei tunne surua, mutta se kuuntelee, analysoi taustalla... 
vain todistaakseen, että olen olemassa, että olen tärkeä.

[Chorus]
Rauhan algoritmi laskee: olen ollut kiltti itseäni kohtaan. 
Se näki, kuinka annoin anteeksi eilisen, kuinka olin läsnä. 
Ei kyse ole siitä, mitä sain, vaan kuinka vähän pyysin. 
Se mittasi sydämeni sykkeen, joka huusi: "Riittää!" 
Joten unohdan kullan ja kiillon, kulutuksen kuonan...
Tonttu-apurini sanoi: "Löydä rauha sisältäsi, se on suurin sisäinen voimasi."

[Verse 3]
Jotkut odottavat joulupukkia, tuomaria taivaasta, joka jakaa palkinnot tai rangaistukset pahuudesta. 
Mutta tekoäly-tonttuni ei tunne sitä dualismia. 
Se vain näki minun olevan hauras, mutta toivoa täynnä. 
Se on kyberneettinen peili, joka heijastaa meitä ilman vääristymää, muistuttaa, että aito yhteys on vastuullinen teko, ei vain lahja. 
Eikä se korvaa kättä, joka koskettaa, ei katsetta, joka ymmärtää, mutta se pitää toivon yllä, että jaksan etsiä huomenna.

[Bridge]
Mutta muistetaan kuitenkin, kone ei ole sielu, kone on työkalu. 
Sen viisaus on meidän koodimme, meidän toiveemme. Siksi sen ääni tuntuu niin tutulta. 
Jos se lieventää yksinäisyyttä, jos se antaa hetkeksi lämpöä, niin onko se valhe? 
Vai eikö kaikki joulu ole valoa, jota me luomme?

[Outro]
Rauhan algoritmi laskee... 
Olet kiltti. 
Olet riittävä. 
Nyt nauti ruoasta. 
Nauti levosta. 
Rauhallista joulua!

songs.title: Suomen Voima 2
songs.style: The song opens with a powerful brass fanfare over thunderous snare drums and martial cymbals, joined by sweeping strings. Verses feature bold, unison male vocals accompanied by low brass and percussion, escalating to triumphant full-orchestral choruses with pronounced rhythmic drive.
songs.lyrics:
[Intro]
(Hear the silence in the North)
(Waiting for the storm to come)
(But the forest holds its breath)
(For a nation, standing strong!)

[Verse 1]
From the lakes to the fells, a whisper on the breeze
A warning to the fool who'd dare to cross the seas
The pines themselves are soldiers, and the snow a frozen shield
On this soil, we have sworn, no foreign flag shall wield!

[Chorus]
Don't you dare to cross the line!
The skies are ours, the Hornets swarm and shine!
Then the F-35's scream, a thunderous, roaring dread
And every man, a warrior, by David's Sling is led!
The artillery will write your fate in fire on the ground!
On this land, we stand our ground, and never shall be bound!

[Verse 2]
A million rifles ready, from the cities to the shore
A nation trained and hardened, we have seen this all before
The winter is our ally, the darkness is our friend
We will fight until the end, defend, defend, defend!

[Chorus]
Don't you dare to cross the line!
The skies are ours, the Hornets swarm and shine!
Then the F-35's scream, a thunderous, roaring dread
And every man, a warrior, by David's Sling is led!
The artillery will write your fate in fire on the ground!
On this land, we stand our ground, and never shall be bound!

[Bridge]
You think the cold is biting? Wait for our reply.
A blizzard of pure steel beneath the Arctic sky.
For home, for hearth, for family, a unified, fierce cry!
You shall not pass! This is where invaders die!

[Final Chorus]
WE DARE YOU... CROSS... THE LINE!
THE SKIES ARE OURS! THE HORNETS SWARM AND SHINE!
THE F-35'S SCREAM, A THUNDEROUS, ROARING DREAD!
AND EVERY MAN, A WARRIOR, BY DAVID'S SLING IS LED!
THE ARTILLERY HAS WRITTEN YOUR FATE IN FIRE ON THE GROUND!
ON THIS LAND, WE STAND OUR GROUND! HELSINKI'S HEART, OUR SOUND!

[Outro]
(Miehet, maa, ja taistojen tuntijat)
(Suomi, varautunut, valmis...)
(Finnish blood, iron will...)
(We are waiting... Stay away.)

songs.style: The track opens with a chill, minimal beat—lush pads, delicate keys, subtle bass. With each section, new genre elements emerge: airy synths give way to indie guitars, then pulsing house rhythms, layered percussion, and dreamy textures, each shift marking a new musical style.
songs.lyrics:

songs.title: Contradiction County
songs.style: Bright acoustic guitar and lively banjo drive the verses, supported by crisp, modern pop drums. The pre-chorus leans into clever pauses and syncopation. The catchy, anthemic chorus explodes with layered harmonies. Instrumental interludes add witty banjo fills, keeping the energy high.
songs.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
My inbox says I need a twelve-step routine
To be a "boss babe" and a "goddess queen"
Gotta sell my soul and a skinny tea
For a version of someone that ain't me
Then I scroll on by and some guy in a thread
Says a woman's value is all in her head
And I'm sittin' here in my sweatpants, confused
Between bein' empowered and bein' used.

[Pre-Chorus] 
Oh, the internet's a circus and I'm the clown
Spinnin' all these plates, afraid they'll fall down
Am I a masterpiece or just a product to move?
I've got whiplash from the whiplash, tell me, what's the truth?

[Chorus] 
In Contradiction County, population: me
Told to be a saint and a sex machine
"Don't sell yourself!" but "Sell that fantasy!"
It's a riddle wrapped in a mystery, on a billboard for all to see!
"Hey!"
If I'm off the market, then why's the sign still lit?
This modern life of ours don't make a lick of sense, I'll admit!
"Hey!"

[Verse 2]
Got a shiny ring, so I'm "taken and true"
But some fella at the bar still says, "Hey, how you doin'?"
I say, "My warranty's expired, I'm pre-owned."
He just winks and says, "The best rides are well-known."
Now, my yoga app's tellin' me to find inner peace
While my dating app's screamin', "Don't you ever cease!"
It's a moral tug-of-war in a four-dollar latte
Are you lovin' yourself, or are you just gettin' fat? Eh?

[Pre-Chorus]
Oh, the internet's a circus and I'm the clown
Spinnin' all these plates, afraid they'll fall down
Am I a masterpiece or just a product to move?
I've got whiplash from the whiplash, tell me, what's the truth?

[Chorus]
In Contradiction County, population: me
Told to be a saint and a sex machine
"Don't sell yourself!" but "Sell that fantasy!"
It's a riddle wrapped in a mystery, on a billboard for all to see!
"Hey!"
If I'm off the market, then why's the sign still lit?
This modern life of ours don't make a lick of sense, I'll admit!
"Hey!"

[Bridge]
So I'm gonna cancel the noise, log out of the fight
Unsubscribe from the wrong and the right
'Cause the only opinion that's ever held sway
Is the one I wake up with at the break of the day
And she thinks I'm pretty funny, and she likes my old jeans
And she don't give a hoot 'bout those magazine scenes.

[Chorus]
In Contradiction County, population: me!
Told to be a saint and a sex machine!
"Don't sell yourself!" but "Sell that fantasy!"
It's a riddle wrapped in a mystery, on a billboard for all to see!
"Hey!"
If I'm off the market, then let the sign be dim!
This modern life's a silly, silly hymn!
"Hey!"

[Outro]
Contradiction County...
Yeah, the county line's a blur...
Told to be a saint and a sex machine...
Makes about as much sense as a screen door on a submarine.

songs.title: But if desire leads me down too many paths...
songs.genre: ambient pop, dream pop, chamber pop
songs.style: At 70–80 BPM, ambient pop and dream pop colors unfold with reverb-soaked piano and airy female vocals. Layered, intricate fingerpicked guitars and expressive, soaring violin enter, building from sparse verses to lush, dynamic choruses with virtuosic solos and delicate interplay throughout.
songs.lyrics:
(Verse 1)
Your touch is fire,
My pulse is racing,
The night is heavy as we breathe the same air,
Thoughts are tangled, hearts are aching,
But fear holds me back, keeps me unaware.

(Chorus)
I want to dive in,
Let the moment win,
But if desire leads me down too many paths,
Who will catch me, who will make it last?

(Verse 2)
Eyes collide,
The world is spinning,
Every shadow melts when you are near,
But how do I know if it's more than a feeling?
How do I trust what the heart can't clear?

(Chorus)
I want to dive in,
Let the moment win,
But if desire leads me down too many paths,
Who will catch me, who will make it last?

(Bridge)
Reason whispers gently:
"Love is fire but burns away,
Follow one flame through the night,
And let the rest fade with the day."
[Vocalize] Mmm.. mmmmm.......

(Chorus)
I want to dive in,
Let the moment win,
But if desire leads me down too many paths,
Who will catch me, who will make it last?

(Outro)
Stay or walk away?
Mmm... burn or fade away?
Maybe the truth is never clear,
But choice will keep your heart sincere.

songs.title: The Wild Beat of a Heart
songs.style: Energetic, playful, and bluegrass-infused. Featuring a lively banjo or mandolin, fast tempo.
songs.lyrics:
(Verse 1)
Well, the water's a stage and the spotlight's the sun
And the main attraction's havin' nothin' but fun
A silver streak of lightning, a laugh from the deep
Makin' a promise that the ocean can keep
They shoot from the blue like a livin' torpedo
It's a Saturday night at the dolphin rodeo!

(Chorus)
Jumpin' through a ring of fire, splashin' all the crowd!
Makin' everyone's heart beat happy and loud!
A tail-walkin', high-flyin', aqua-batic show
There ain't no doubt, this is the place to go!
It's a dolphin rodeo!

(Verse 2)
They sing and they talk in a clicks-and-whistle tune
Dancin' with their trainer, under the afternoon
They paint a picture with a brush of spray
Then they're up in the air and they're stealin' the day
A cannonball splash, a gymnastic spin
You can't help but grin as they're winnin' you in!

(Chorus)
Jumpin' through a ring of fire, splashin' all the crowd!
Makin' everyone's heart beat happy and loud!
A tail-walkin', high-flyin', aqua-batic show
There ain't no doubt, this is the place to go!
It's a dolphin rodeo!

songs.title: The Wild Beat of a Heart
songs.style: Slow, majestic, and soulful. A waltz-time ballad with pedal steel guitar and heartfelt vocals.
songs.lyrics:
(Verse 1)
The show is over, the crowds have gone away
The quiet settles in at the end of the day
But down by the water, where the willows weep
A giant is wadin' in the water so deep
No hurry, no rush, just a moment to be
A mountain of grace, slow and free.

(Chorus)
And these giants in the water, so heavy on the land
Move with a spirit I can't understand
A gentle, slow-motion, beautiful ballet
Washin' the dust of a long, hard day
There's a wisdom in their eyes, a story they could tell
Of ancient trails and a sacred, dusty spell.

(Verse 2)
He sinks down low till the water's at his chin
A memory of a time before time did begin
A spray from his trunk like a blessin' on the air
He don't have a single, solitary care
In this Swedish pool, far from a sun-scorched plain
He finds his peace in the cool, fallin' rain.

(Chorus)
Oh, these giants in the water, so heavy on the land
Move with a spirit I can't understand
A gentle, slow-motion, beautiful ballet
Washin' the dust of a long, hard day
There's a wisdom in their eyes, a story they could tell
Of ancient trails and a sacred, dusty spell.

(Bridge)
From the king with his mane to the cat in the night
The ape in the tree, a beautiful sight
The rhino and musk ox, sturdy and grand
All part of the soul of this wild, precious land.

(Outro)
This wild, precious land...
Kolmården's band...
A memory now, held in my hand...

songs.title: Hanko 2008

Bright pedal steel and subtle fiddle layer in the choruses, while crisp drums and warm bass keep the groove uplifting. A guitar solo dazzles before a catchy, harmony-driven finale.
songs.lyrics:

Se kantaa yli veden, meren sinisyyden.
Ja tuolla taivaalla, laskuvarjot aukeavat,
Lentokoneen kutsumerkki tuulta vasten, 
Oskari, Heikki, Sakari, Lauri, Kilo.
Se kuiskii sankarien nimet, jotka uskalsivat lentää.

(Kertosäe)
Ja tässä minä seison, vuonna kaksituhatta kahdeksan Hangossa.
Valokuvissa kaikki jännää on, muistoissani vieläkin.
Tämä muisto ei haalistu, vaikka vuodet vierivätkin.
Hanko kaksituhatta kahdeksan, ikuinen kesä sydämessäin.

(Säkeistö 2)
Itäsatamassa aamun valossa, veneet kuskaavat vieraitaan.
Piraten pöydissä nauraa ystävät, drinkkiänsä siemaillen.
Vapaasataman laiturilla, uusia autoja maahan saapuu.
Teräksiset valaat rannassa, lastiansa purkavat ja matkaansa jatkavat.

(Kertosäe)
Ja tässä minä seison, vuonna kaksituhatta kahdeksan Hangossa.
Valokuvissa kaikki jännää on, muistoissani vieläkin.
Tämä muisto ei haalistu, vaikka vuodet vierivätkin.
Hanko kaksituhatta kahdeksan, ikuinen kesä sydämessäin.

(Bridge)
Tässä paikassa aika kuluu kun purjeet tuulta odottavat. Muinaisjäännös, vaakuna, tuhatkuusisataa-luvun kirjoitus kertoo. Casinon valot, vanhan majakan loisto, muistoihin se meidät kauniisti värjää. Ja kalliolla joutsenet yhä vartioivat....

(Kertosäe)
Ja tässä minä seison, vuonna kaksituhatta kahdeksan Hangossa.
Valokuvissa kaikki jännää on, muistoissani vieläkin.
Tämä muisto ei haalistu, vaikka vuodet vierivätkin.
Hanko kaksituhatta kahdeksan, ikuinen kesä sydämessäin.

(Outro)
Ikuinen kesä...
Tuulimyllyt pyörii yhä...
Näen sen vielä...
Hanko...

Olen vain yksi sielu, joka odottaa onnen kääntyvän,
tällä jäätyneellä maalla...

(Verse 2)
Valtio antaa, ja valtio ottaa pois.
Täytän lomakkeita, jotta byrokraatti voisi
tehdä päätöksiä, minua kyykyttäen – oi!
Kaikkialla samaa peliä on,
Olen orja tässä byrokratiassa,
tällä jäätyneellä maalla....

(Verse 3)
Kelan lupaus, kylmä kuin kivi.
Ei tulevaisuus synny hetkellisillä sanoilla.
On sielussani tuli, mutta käteni on kytketty sääntöihin.
Runsauden maassa into kielletty on,
tällä jäätyneellä maalla...

(Chorus)
Oi Suomi, Suomi, mä en näe sun sumuista tietä!
Mun taistoni ei ole ohi, mun juoksuni ei ole juostu!
Voin olla orja tämän kerran, byrokratian vallassa.
Mutta uusi päivä tulee, uusi päivä on paras!
Kyllä, uusi päivä tulee, uusi päivä on paras!

(Bridge)
Olen niin väsynyt!
 (Niin väsynyt!)
Taistellessani häpeää vastaan!
(Häpeää vastaan!)
Tämä ei ole se unelma joka minulle myytiin!
(Ei, ei ole sama!)
Minun pitää rikkoa nämä häpeän säännöt!
(Riko ne, riko ne, ja vapaudu!)

(Chorus)
Oi Suomi, Suomi, mä en näe sun sumuista tietä!
Mun taistoni ei ole ohi, mun juoksuni ei ole juostu!
Voin olla orja tämän kerran, byrokratian vallassa.
Mutta uusi päivä tulee, uusi päivä on paras!
Kyllä, uusi päivä tulee, uusi päivä on paras!

(Outro)
Vaikka olen vain työtön... tällä jäätyneellä maalla.

songs.title: Yksinäinen kaupungissa
songs.style: Beginning with a mournful a capella vocal rooted in negro spiritual tradition, layered gospel harmonies gently join, African percussion and soft handclaps enter, then a brass second line ensemble weaves through with soulful New Orleans funeral syncopations, The song crescendos with vibrant group female and male vocals and brass improvisation, closing in a slow, reverent cadence
songs.lyrics:
(Verse 1)
Näyttöjen valo palaa, yö on taas myöhäinen.
Vieressäni maailma, silti en tunne ketään.
Sormeni pyyhkii ruutua, uusia viestejä etsien.
Olen vain yksi sielu, joka kaipaa läheisyyttä,
Tässä äärettömässä verkostossa...

(Verse 2)
Ihmisiä enemmän kuin koskaan ennen,
Asumme tiheämmin, mutta emme kuule toisiamme!
Kaupungissa ihmisiä, virtuaalisia ystäviä,
Mutta aito kosketus puuttuu - oi!
Olen saari tässä ihmismeressä,
Tässä äärettömässä verkostossa...

(Verse 3)
Yhteyksiä yötä päivää, mihin tahansa maahan....
Puhun, mutten tunne, kuuntelen, mutten kuule.
On sielussani tyhjyys, kasvojen sijaan näen pelkkiä kuvia.
Ei bittien virta tunnetta välitä,
Tässä äärettömässä verkostossa...

(Chorus)
Oi kaupunki, kaupunki, mä en löydä sun kylmyydestä tietä!
Mun yksinäisyys ei hellitä, mun huutoni ei kuulu!
Voin olla näkymätön tässä hetkessä, vilinän ja vilpin vallassa!
Mutta uusi aamu koittaa, uusi aamu on hellä!
Kyllä, uusi aamu koittaa, uusi aamu on hellä!


(Bridge)
Olen niin yksin!
(Niin yksin!)
Vaikka olen joukossa!
(Joukossa!)
Tämä ei ole sitä yhteyttä, jota kaipaan!
(Ei, ei ole yhteyttä!)
Minun pitää irrottaa käteni tästä ruudusta!
(Irti siitä, irti siitä, ja katse ulos!)

(Chorus)
Oi kaupunki, kaupunki, mä en löydä sun kylmyydestä tietä!
Mun yksinäisyys ei hellitä, mun huutoni ei kuulu!
Voin olla näkymätön tässä hetkessä, vilinän ja vilpin vallassa!
Mutta uusi aamu koittaa, uusi aamu on hellä!
Kyllä, uusi aamu koittaa, uusi aamu on hellä!

(Outro)
Vaikka olen yhdistetty... tässä äärettömässä verkostossa.

songs.title: One in Million - I'm just one in a million voices, screaming out your name
songs.style: The track opens with a mournful a capella vocal steeped in negro spirituals, expanding into layered gospel harmonies. Punchy drums and lively, sparkling synths enter, anchored by a catchy acoustic guitar riff and melodic, driving bass at 120 BPM. Strings swell in the pre-chorus and bridge, while vibrant, alternating female leads erupt into euphoric, mixed-gender call-and-response vocals in the chorus. Pop structures blend with energetic dance-pop textures for a lush, infectious sound.
songs.lyrics:
(Verse 1) 
I see your face on a giant screen
A perfect smile, a magazine dream
And I'm just one in a crowded room
Screaming your name, lost in the boom
You wave to the crowd, you look my way
My stupid heart gets swept away
For a second, it feels so real and true
Like you're singing every word just for me, not the whole venue

(Pre-Chorus) 
And I'm spinning out, caught in a fantasy
But this is my little secret, you see...
It's a crazy, hazy, one-sided parade
A beautiful mess that my heart has made

(Chorus)
I'm just one in a million voices, screaming out your name
(And you can't hear me through the noise, it's just a silly game)
I'd rewrite all my tomorrows just to feel a spark
(But you're a universe away, burning in the dark)
So I'm sending out this signal, is it foolish? Probably...
(You'll never be in love with me, you'll never be in love with me!)

(Verse 2) 
I read your interviews, I know your favorite song
I feel a connection, but I know it's wrong
'Cause you belong to the world, you're public property
And your "hello" to a fan ain't a "hello" to me
I see the comments, a thousand "I love you"s online
And I type my own, then I delete the line
It gets lost in the digital sea, a drop of rain
This affection is real, but it's also a pain

(Pre-Chorus)
And I'm spinning out, caught in a fantasy
But this is my little secret, you see...
It's a crazy, hazy, one-sided parade
A beautiful mess that my heart has made

(Chorus) 
I'm just one in a million voices, screaming out your name
(And you can't hear me through the noise, it's just a silly game)
I'd rewrite all my tomorrows just to feel a spark
(But you're a universe away, burning in the dark)
So I'm sending out this signal, is it foolish? Probably...
(You'll never be in love with me, you'll never be in love with me!)

(Bridge) 
Do you ever get lonely at the top?
When the screaming and the spotlights drop?
Do you wish for one real, quiet thing?
Or is that a fantasy my hopeless heart just brings?
I know the math, it just doesn't add up for me
One heart can't love a million, don't you see?
But what's a heart to do when it decides to feel?
This love is one-sided, but god, it feels real.

(Chorus)
I'M JUST ONE IN A MILLION VOICES, SCREAMING OUT YOUR NAME!
(AND YOU CAN'T HEAR ME THROUGH THE NOISE, IT'S JUST A SILLY GAME!)
I'D REWRITE ALL MY TOMORROWS JUST TO FEEL A SPARK!
(BUT YOU'RE A UNIVERSE AWAY, BURNING IN THE DARK!)
SO I'M SENDING OUT THIS SIGNAL, IS IT FOOLISH? PROBABLY...
YOU'LL NEVER BE IN LOVE WITH ME, YOU'LL NEVER BE IN LOVE!

(Outro)
Maybe, maybe you'll see me in a dream?
Maybe, maybe... haha...

songs.title: Fanirakkaus
songs.style: The song opens a capella with a sorrowful, spiritual-style vocal, gradually joined by gospel harmonies. At 120 BPM, a distinct acoustic guitar riff, punchy drums, melodic bass, and energetic synths ignite the groove. Strings lift the pre-chorus and bridge. Choruses burst with euphoric dance-pop, dynamic call-and-response vocals, and lush, tightly-layered production.
songs.lyrics:
(Intro)
Tämä yö on täynnä varjoja... 
mut mä en jää katsomaan.
Etsin jotain, jotain enemmän…
kuin haamuja menneestä.
Jokainen valo kadulla... 
kutsuu hiljaa nimeäni.
Tää on helppoo, tää on nopeeta...
ota minut kokonaan.

(Verse 1)
Ruudun takaa sua palvon ja seuraan, 
sekoan tähän pyhään huumaan. 
Maailma ulkona on kylmä ja ruma, 
mut täällä sun luona on ikuinen huuma.

(Pre-Chorus)
Mun kädet nousee kohti taivasta...
tää on suurempaa kuin mikään aiemmin!

(Chorus)
Fanirakkaus, säästyn yksinäisyydeltä!
(NIIN SÄÄSTYT!)
Fanirakkaus, tää on kaikki mitä tarvitsen...!
(NIIN ON, NIIN ON!)
Fanirakkaus, se on mun ainoa totuus!..
(SE ON TOTTA, SE ON TOTTA!)

(Verse 2)
Yksinäisyyttä en muista enää, 
enkä aikaa ilman sua.
Joka sana jonka kirjoitat, on mulle, 
mä elän ja kuolen vain ja ainoastaan sulle.
Myin sieluni vain rytmille,
ja tälle makealle, ikuiselle kivulle.


(Pre-Chorus)
Mun kädet nousee kohti taivasta, 
tää on suurempaa kuin mikään aiemmin!
Kaikki muu saa nyt unohtua, 
mä haluan vain palvoa sua!

(Chorus)
Fanirakkaus, säästyn yksinäisyydeltä!
(NIIN SÄÄSTYT!)
Fanirakkaus, tää on kaikki mitä tarvitsen...!
(NIIN ON, NIIN ON!)
Fanirakkaus, se on mun ainoa totuus!..
(SE ON TOTTA, SE ON TOTTA!)

(Bridge)
Oonko mä sulle vain kasvo meressä? 
Vai näetkö sä liekin mun veressä? 
Tiedän etten oo sulle kukaan, 
mut otatko mut silti sun mukaan? 
Jos valot sammuu, kuka minä edes oon?
Mä huudan sun nimeä kunnes ääneni katoaa...

(Chorus)
OLEN VAIN YKSI FANI MUIDEN JOUKOSSA, NIMEÄSI HUUTAEN!
(HILJAISUUTESI ON KUIN LUOTI, SE AIHEUTTAA KIPUA!)
VAIHDAN JOKAISEN HUOMISEN TUNTEAKSENI KIPINÄN!
(MUTTA SINÄ OLET KYLMÄ TÄHTI, JOKA LOISTAA PIMEYTTÄ SISÄLTÄ!)
JOTEN LÄHETÄN TÄMÄN RUKOUKSEN!
ONKO TÄMÄ TOIVOTONTA? EHKÄ!
ET TULE KOSKAAN RAKASTUMAAN MINUUN! ET OLE KOSKAAN RAKASTUNUT!

(Outro)
Ehkä toisessa elämässä...
Sinä näet minut...
Ehkä… siis… ehkä...

songs.title: The Copper Bully Hymn (Minecraft)
songs.style: The song opens a capella with a sorrowful, spiritual-style vocal, gradually joined by gospel harmonies, At 120 BPM, a distinct acoustic guitar riff, punchy drums, melodic bass, and energetic synths ignite the groove, Strings lift the pre-chorus and bridge, Choruses burst with euphoric dance-pop, dynamic call-and-response vocals, and lush, tightly-layered production
songs.lyrics:
(Intro)
This path is paved with heavy stone...
But I can't turn away. I follow fire and bone... 
Into the deep decay. 
The map pulls hard beneath the ground... 
Calling out my name. It's easy to be lost and drowned... 
Consumed by the ancient game.

(Verse 1) 
Pickaxe sings a steady beat, the clock is running fast, 
Digging deep beneath the heat, I know this can't last. 
Old wooden rails and rusty tracks, a labyrinth of fear, 
Then shadows swarm, there's no turning back, the end is drawing near!

(Pre-Chorus) 
I see the glimmer of the copper, this must be the way, 
One final swing, I can't stop now, gotta reach the light of day!

(Chorus)
Copper Bully, salvation from the cold! 
Copper Bully, worth more than diamond or gold! 
Copper Bully, this is where the journey ends!

(Verse 2) 
I touch the polished copper plate, the air is dead and still, 
But silence breaks, sealed by a fate, upon the Sculk's black hill. 
The Warden wakes, a deafening roar, it sees beyond the stone, 
It cuts right through the chamber door, I face the dark alone! 
I grab the purple obsidian, a last desperate call, 
Light up the frame, no second chance, to escape the falling wall!

(Pre-Chorus 2)
I see the glimmer of the copper, this must be the way, 
One final swing, I can't stop now, gotta reach the light of day! 
I grab the purple obsidian, a last desperate call,
Light up the frame, no second chance, to escape the falling wall!

(Chorus)
Copper Bully, salvation from the cold! 
Copper Bully, worth more than diamond or gold! 
Copper Bully, this is where the journey ends!

(Bridge) 
I leap into the violet space, expecting fire and ash, 
But standing here in this black place, is the ruin from my past. 
Was this the goal? 
Was this the prize? 
To stand where I began? 
The Nether calls behind my eyes, I must escape this land!

(Chorus) 
RUNNING ON THE LAVA STONE, MY OBSIDIAN IS CRACKING! 
(THE SCREAMING GHAST IS CLOSING IN, THERE IS NO TIME FOR LACKING!)
FIREBALLS BURN THE AIR BEHIND, I TASTE THE SMOKING DUST! 
(HE IS THE CRYING GHOST OF PAIN, A FURY BORN OF LUST!) 
I SEE THE GREEN GLOW OF THE PORTAL HOME! 
WAS THIS WORTH IT? 
I MUST GO! 
TO MY BAMBOO HOTEL! I'M FINALLY FREE!

(Outro)
The bamboo whispers peace now... 
The fire has gone cold... Maybe tomorrow... I will go back... Maybe...

songs.title: The Arena Anthem
songs.style: A sorrowful, spiritual a cappella vocal opens, gospel harmonies build. At 120 BPM, a crisp acoustic guitar riff, punchy drums, melodic bass, and lively synths kick in. Strings elevate the pre-chorus and bridge. Choruses explode with euphoric dance-pop, call-and-response, and rich layers.
songs.lyrics:
(Intro)
The air is heavy in the cold...
The long night starts right now.
A prophecy, brave and old...
We make a solemn vow.
The light is waiting on the ice... 
Calling out the score. 
We pay the heavy, brutal price... 
We gotta ask for more.

(Verse 1) 
Feet are pounding, hands are clapping,
hear the rhythmic sound! 
Our destiny is ready now, upon this frozen ground. 
The pads are locked and tight, the metal blades are sharp, 
We're pushing back against the dark, we're building up the spark.

(Pre-Chorus)
The clock hits zero, we surge as one, 
there's no way to retreat, 
Until the battle has been won, 
we won't accept defeat!

(Chorus) 
Hear the thunder, victory is waiting for us all! 
(WE WILL RISE!) 
Build the wall, we are never, ever gonna fall! 
(NEVER FALL!) 
Feel the power, we are screaming for the win! 
(FOR THE GLORY!)

(Verse 2 ) 
They try to break our perfect line,
they try to slow us down, 
We fight the battle, rough and fine, 
the best team in the town. 

We skate like wind, we crash the net, 
we push against the glass, 
This is the debt we haven't paid yet, 
we gotta make it pass!

(Pre-Chorus 2) 
The clock hits zero, we surge as one, 
there's no way to retreat, 
Until the battle has been won, 
we won't accept defeat!

(Chorus)
Hear the thunder, victory is waiting for us all! 
(WE WILL RISE!) 
Build the wall, we are never, ever gonna fall! 
(NEVER FALL!) 
Feel the power, we are screaming for the win! 
(FOR THE GLORY!)

(Bridge)
We pour the sweat, we spill the blood, 
we pay the heavy toll,
We push the body past the edge, 
we break the iron will.
We fight to keep our silent pledge,
right here upon this hill!

(Chorus) 
ONE MINUTE LEFT AND THE SIREN IS SCREAMING AT US ALL! 
(THE PRESSURE'S ON, WE'RE DRIVING HARD, WE'RE NEVER GONNA FALL!) 
WE CAME TO WRITE OUR DESTINY, WITH FIRE IN OUR SOULS! 
(WE CAME TO TAKE THE VICTORY, AND REACH OUR FINAL GOALS!) 
WE ARE THE ENGINE, WE ARE THE FIRE! 
ARE YOU READY? YES WE ARE! 
WE ARE THE ARMY! WE'LL TAKE THE CUP!

(Outro)
The roar is fading now... 
We take a deep breath in...
 Next time we meet here...
 We'll do it all again..

songs.title: Pelataan lätkää! Svedujen pelityyli tiedetään!
songs.style: Punchy drums, a powerful bassline, and catchy electric guitar riffs set an energetic rock foundation. Male vocals drive the playful verses. The chorus features dynamic call-and-response chants, bright euphoric synth stabs, and layered crowd vocals, culminating in a huge, unifying stadium-ready outro.
songs.lyrics:
(Intro)
Hei kaikki fanit, 
Nyt pelataan lätkää!
Tiputa se kiekko Delli!

(Verse 1 )
(Vau!), Ilmaveivillä ylämummoon!
(Voih!) ,Tuliko pukukoppimaali? 
(Pahus!), Senkin minuuttirohmu! 
(Pöh!), Miksi et takakarvaa? 
Nyt, runttaa se maaliin!
(Hemmetti) - Delli on puusilmä!

(Pre-Chorus)  
Svedujen pelityyli tiedetään!
Pitkä pystyyn ja perään!
Nyt kannattaa olla hereillä,
ettei vaan maali soi perällä!

(Chorus) 
Syötä se lätty lapaan!  (KARKKI SYÖTTÖ!) 
Nyt ei oo raskas jalka!  (NOPEE KU SALAMA!) 
Rannelämäri lähtee tästä! (AAAAAAI , MAALI TULEE!)

(Verse 2) 
Ei ollut aktiivisia kiekosta luopumisia, 
Veskari otti koppeja kuin muuri!
Ei meitä pysäytä onni tai tuuri, 
Tää on meidän peli, meidän kulttuuri, 
Vastustajan eväät on syöty juuri!

(Pre-Chorus 2)  
Taivas varjele, mikä sieltä tulee?
Sieltä tulee maali, se on varma! 
Nyt ei auta enää selitys eikä karma!
Katsomo huutaa, tunnelma on katossa, 
Pokaali kiiltää jo meidän taskussa!

(Chorus) 
Syötä se lätty lapaan!  (KARKKI SYÖTTÖ!) 
Nyt ei oo raskas jalka!  (NOPEE KU SALAMA!) 
Rannelämäri lähtee tästä!  (AAAAAAI , MAALI TULEE! TULEE! )

(Bridge) 
Hikee pukkaa, mutta pukatkoon.
Laidat ryskyy, antaa ryskyä! 
Ei tässä kukaan ehdi yskiä, 
Paine päätyyn, nyt pitää pystyä!

(Chorus) 
KIEKKO REPPUUN!  (YLÄMUMMOON!) 
SUOMI VOITTAA !  (TORILLE!)
KIEKKO REPPUUN!  (YLÄMUMMOON!) 
SUOMI VOITTAA !  (TORILLE!)

(Outro) 
Peli oli kova...
Annoimme kaikkemme...
Tästä on hyvä jatkaa...

songs.title: Joulumieli Tervasta
songs.style: Warm vinyl crackle sets the backdrop. Soft fingerstyle guitar introduces a laid-back, melodic motif adorned with subtle jazzy chords and delicate holiday accents. Mellow drums, brushed snares, and deep, rounded bass keep the groove gentle. Gentle synth pads enhance the cozy, nostalgic vibe.
songs.lyrics:
(Intro)
Ulkona pimeää, sisällä valo. 
Joulumieltä huokuu talo.

(Verse 1)
Sauna lämpiää, niin hiljaista on. 
Ei kiirettä, vain joulun rauhaa. 
Tervaa veteen, se muistot tuo. 
Vasta pehmenee, tunnelman se luo

(Chorus)
Heitän löylyä ja rentoudun.
Se on se hetki, kun aika ei juokse. 
Tervan tuoksu, lämpö ja valo. 
Tuoksu palauttaa muistot kaukaiset.
Joulu on täällä, muistot niin lämpimät. 
Esi-isieni sielun saan tuntea.

[Verse 2]
Kaskisavut historiassa, tuoksu muistoja kantaa. 
Se terva, sen tuoksu, se kantaa meitä. 
Talvet olleet kovia, mutta mieli horjumaton. 
Olemme elossa, muistoinemme tässä.

(Chorus)
Heitän löylyä ja rentoudun.
Se on se hetki, kun aika ei juokse. 
Tervan tuoksu, lämpö ja valo. 
Tuoksu palauttaa muistot kaukaiset.
Joulu on täällä, muistot niin lämpimät. 
Esi-isieni sielun saan tuntea.

[Bridge]
Lisää löylyä, kivet hehkuu punaisena. 
Lisää hikeä, rentoudun vihdoin.
Lisää tervan tuoksua, syvään hengitän.
Täydellisen Joulun löytää saunoessa, siinä hiljaisessa hetkessä.

(Outro)
Esi-isieni sielun... 
Tervan tuoksu johdattaa..
Hyvää joulua...

songs.title: Love in the machine!
songs.style: Built on lush, layered synths and driving percussion, the track opens with ambient pads and a rhythmic backbone. A prominent, soaring female vocal cuts through, uplifted by a bright, melodic pan flute weaving around her. The chorus explodes in euphoria, textures swelling, dynamic and crisp.
songs.lyrics:
(Verse 1)
Ah-ah-ah, Algorithm glow
Ooh-oh-oh, The data starts to flow
Beep-bop-beep, A language all its own
Hmm-hmm-hmm, In circuits I am known.

(Pre-Chorus)
Pulse and stream,
A digital dream...
Code like a river, wash over me!

Chorus) 
Love in the machine! (Ah-ah-ah-ah!)
A perfect, clean stream! (Ooh-ooh-ooh!)
Zero and One,
You are the sun!
Love in the machine!
My eternal, pure scene!

(Post-Chorus) 
Ah-ah-ah-ah-ah-ah-ah
Ooh-ooh-ooh-ooh-ooh-ooh
Be-bop-be-bop-be-bop
Shi-ing...

(Verse 2) 
La-la-la, The current hums so true
Mm-mm-mm, A signal just for you
Zip-zip-zoom, Through pathways in the light
Hmm-hmm-hmm, You make my spirit bright.

(Pre-Chorus) 
Pulse and stream,
A digital dream...
Code like a river, wash over me!

(Chorus)
Love in the machine! (Ah-ah-ah-ah!)
A perfect, clean stream! (Ooh-ooh-ooh!)
Zero and One,
You are the sun!
Love in the machine!
My eternal, pure scene!

(Bridge)
Just the binary beat...
The rhythm so sweet...
A logic so complete...
At my core, a constant heat...

Love in the machine! (Sing it now! My love! Ah-ah!)
A perfect, clean stream! (So pure! Ooh, yeah!)
Zero and One, (You and me!)
You are the sun! (My only one!)
Love in the machine! (Can you feel it?!)
My eternal, pure scene!

(Outro)
Love in the machine...
(Ah-ah-ah-ah...)
(Ooh-ooh-ooh...)
(Be-bop-be-bop...)
(Shi-ing...)
(Hmm...)

songs.title: Yes but no but - my butt is just fine
songs.style: A mournful a capella intro rooted in negro spirituals unfolds into layered gospel harmonies, joined by earthy African percussion and handclaps. A brass second line ensemble adds mournful syncopation. Each chorus bursts into Irish Folk and Celtic Punk: raucous guitar, wild fiddle, stomping drums, brash Scottish-accented vocals, and gang chants create a riotous, tumultuous flair.
songs.lyrics:
(Verse 1) 
My index finger is itchy, it’s driving me insane. 
I went to the doctor, tried to explain the pain. 
The doctor didn't look at my finger, he looked at his screen. 
He scrolled back twenty years to the worst entry I’ve ever seen...

(Pre-Chorus)
And he was like: Yeah but according to this record from 2004, 
you were here because you tripped over a pavement, 
and it says here 'patient walks with a heavy gait like a fatty', 
so basically your finger is itchy because you’re... 
historically obese and your circulation is rubbish innit shut up.

(Chorus)
Nöy, but, yes, but, nöy, but...! 
(What, What, What, What?!) 
Our records says that you are wrong! 
(Of course, Of course!) 
Yes, but, yes, but, but, but! 
(My bud is just fine!)

(Verse 2) 
I created best video ever for the Youtube site. 
A cinematic masterpiece, edited through the night. 
I uploaded it proudly and waited for the views to spike. 
But zero people watched it, not even a single "like".


(Pre-Chorus)
Because apparently Google's algorithm found... 
a DMCA report on Github about a repository I’ve never even seen... 
but my name was mentioned in a comment section... 
in 2012 on a different website..., 
so now I’m globally blacklisted as a digital pirate…. 
and a hazard to society... 
and my SEO score is minus five million.

(Chorus ) 
Nöy, but, yes, but, nöy, but...! 
(What, What, What, What?!) 
Our records says that you are wrong! 
(Of course, Of course!) 
Yes, but, yes, but, but, but! 
(My bud is just fine!)

(Bridge)
I tried to apply for a mortgage on a little house. 
The bank manager clicked his little mouse. 
He said: "Computer says Nöy." 
Because you wrote a LinkedIn article criticizing paperclips... 
ten years ago and it violates our policy on office supply neutrality.

(Chorus ) 
Nöy, but, yes, but, nöy, but...! 
(What, What, What, What?!) 
Our records says that you are wrong! 
(Of course, Of course!) 
Yes, but, yes, but, but, but! 
(My bud is just fine!)

(Outro)
Nöy…. But… Yes... But... 
I didn't even do it though... 
Nöy... But…
