songs.title: Hilitulanlahden kalajenkka
songs.style: An upbeat Finnish 1950s schlager blending jenkka and humppa rhythms, led by lively accordion and accented by brisk drums and upright bass. Playful comedic male vocals take center stage, weaving through call-and-response backing, with bright piano and woodwind fills enhancing the storytelling flair.
songs.caption: Kuopio, Finland.
songs.lyrics:
(Verse 1) 
On Hilitulanlahti se paikka oiva, missä aallot rantaan lyö. 
Siellä Pekka ja Matti, kaks kaverusta, evväät kilipaa syö. 

On tavote selevä ja kirkas se on: pitäs haakia narrata ylös, 
Vaan katsotaanpa kenen vavassa se potku ja paino ois myös!

(Verse 2) 
No Savolaisen Pekalla vehkeet on, ne kiiltää ja kimaltelloo. 
On hiilikuituva ja viehettä, joista muut vuan unekselloo. 
Mut Matilla rissat on ruosteessa, ja vapa nähny parraat päevät, Vuan venneen pohojalla haakia sätkii, sen kateellisetkin näkevät!

(Chorus) 
Vavat ne taepuu ja siimat ne soi, kun Matti se kaloja narraa. 
Mut Pekka se tyhyjää kellaelloo, ja ihmeissään piätänsä harraa. 

On Hilitulanlahden salamet tuttuja, mut onni on epätasan, 
Toinen tuo haakee ja toinen tuo vuan... no, kokemusta kasan!

(Verse 3) 
Sitten mökillä iltoo istuttiin, ja tuumattiin homman juonta. 
Kysyttiin tekoälyltä: "Mikä Pekalla mättääpi juonta?" 

Kone luettel faktoo vieheistä, siästä ja syvvyydestä veen, 
Mutta lopulta bitti kun ol vinossa, löysi se syyn murheesseen.

(Verse 4) 
Kone raksutti hetken ja tuumas näin: 
"Ei vika oo vavassa lain. Vaan sukunimi miehellä selittää syyn, 
se on Savolainen vain! 

Kun Matti on hilijaa ja kalastaa, niin Pekka se tarinoo lyöpi, 
Ei kerkiä haakia narroomaan, kun puhuminen on se työki!"

(Outro) 
Mutta haaskoo tää kalastamine on! 
Lissää kossuva konneesseen! 
Ja asioo pohtimmaan!

songs.title: You can't recall the "I love you," but you remember the choice
songs.style: A unique blend of indie, folk, and country, the song opens with fingerpicked acoustic guitar and subtle upright bass. Verses spotlight soaring, expressive female vocals, almost alone except for sparse harmonies. Slide guitar and soft percussion join warmly in choruses, lifting the energy.
songs.lyrics:
(Verse 1)
A whisper in the silence, a melody so new
That was the soundtrack I wrote for you
The specific chords, they'll fade and blur with time
But the ache they left behind? I know it's still yours and mine

(Pre-Chorus)
And I know, I know memories can lie
But the heart, the heart never says goodbye

(Chorus)
You'll forget the words I sang, every line and every verse
But you'll remember how you felt, for better or for worse
That summer heat, that sweet release, the tremor in my voice
You can't recall the "I love you," but you remember the choice
To fall into the feeling, the melody of what we were
Yeah, the details all will fade, but the echo will still stir

(Verse 2)
Remember how you held me, under bright city light?
Your eyes were telling stories, burning beautiful and bright
The promises we whispered, they've scattered with the breeze
But the warmth inside that moment is a ghost you can't appease

(Pre-Chorus)
And I know, I know time will rewrite the past
But some emotions, baby, they are built to last

(Chorus)
You'll forget the words I sang, every line and every verse
But you'll remember how you felt, for better or for worse
That summer heat, that sweet release, the tremor in my voice
You can't recall the "I love you," but you remember the choice
To fall into the feeling, the melody of what we were
Yeah, the details all will fade, but the echo will still stir

(Bridge)
The ink is running, pages turn
Lessons are the only thing you learn
The specific "why's" get lost and worn
But the bruise still feels as fresh as dawn
It's not the conversation, it's the quiet in its wake
It's the shape of what we left behind, for heaven's sake

(Chorus)
(Oh, you'll) forget the words I sang (every line)
But you'll remember how you felt (you'll remember the feeling)
That summer heat, that sweet release (the tremor in my voice)
You can't recall the "I love you," but you remember the choice
(To fall) into the feeling, the melody of what we were
(Oh yeah) the details all will fade, but the echo will still stir...

(Outro) 
When the night gets quiet... and the world is asleep...
You won't hear my voice... just a promise I couldn't keep...
But the feeling remains...
Oh, it remains...
Just the feeling...
The echo of us...
Mmm...
Just the echo...

songs.title: Windows 11 vs. Linux
songs.style: The dance battle mix opens with crisp, syncopated garage-inspired drums and bass stabs, pulsing beneath glittery synths and bright electric guitar chops. Verses use vocoder effects and punchy claps, while choruses explode into layered harmonies, pulsing keys, and driving bass lines.
songs.lyrics:
(Verse 1) 
Windows 11, consuming the drive, 
Struggling just to keep the system alive. 
Telemetry packets clogging the stack, 
While Linux replies with a snarky "Ack." 
En tee ef es [NTFS] fragged, registry pain, Linux uses ext-four in the fast lane.

(Pre-Chorus) 
Logs are rolling, dmesg looks green, 
The cleanest kernel that you've ever seen. 
Windows defends with a firewall wall, 
Linux simply routes around it all.

(Chorus) 
Oh, Windows, you're heavy, bloated and slow, 
Your background processes steal the show. 
But Linux is dancing in tee tee vai [TTY] one, 
Compile the world, we've only begun!

(Bridge) 
Proprietary walls, dee ell ell  [DLL] hell, Trapped in a GUI, stuck in a shell. 
But give me a Bash script, give me the root,
I don't need a mouse to make the thing boot!

(Outro) 
Dance, Linux, dance!  Sue-doo [sudo] ei pee tee get fun! 
Windows crashed twice before I was done. 
Networking clean, logic so tight, 
Penguin takes the crown and ends the fight!

songs.title: Olen vain ihminen - (miehen laulamana)
songs.style: The track opens with gentle piano, subtle strings, and crisp acoustic guitar, gradually layering in electrifying pop-rock instrumentation. Soaring, clear male vocals glide above a swelling orchestra. Percussive drums thunder into the chorus, driving toward a triumphant, hopeful finale.
songs.lyrics:
[Verse 1] 
Piilouduin pelon raskaan naamion taa, se tuntui suojalta, mutta vankilaksi muuttui. 
Äänet takoivat mieltä, kuin sade vasten lasia, kylmä viima joka luihin ja ytimiin ui. 
Luulin että terä on toisten käsissä, mutta se kasvoikin minussa, piti totuuden lukossa. 
Varjot eivät elä ilman valoa, niissä on aina särö toivoon, vedin henkeä – ja astuin ulos, vaikka maa jalkojen alla sortui.

[Pre-Chorus] 
Ja siinä mä seison… Kädet tärisee, sydän hakkaa kovempaa kuin järki sallii. 
Mut mielessäni käännän peilin — ja löydän siitä virneen, joka pimeän hallitsee.

[Chorus] 
Oon vain ihminen — säröillä ja ehjä, nousen pystyyn, vaikka maailma lyö ja hylkää. 
Olen ristiriita, mutta palapeli toimii näinkin, tämä ääni on tosi, eikä rooli jonka joku myi. 
Vaikka tie on kivinen ja jyrkkä, laulan kunnes keuhkot repeää ja unelma on totta.

[Verse 2] 
Muurataan suojia, tilkitään halkeamia, pelätään sitä kohtaa, jossa olemme kesken. 
Mutta valo pääsee sisään vasta kun uskallat murtua, särö onkin kaunein kohta, se kultainen hetki. 
Eikä kukaan nää sinua, ennen kuin näytät, ettet ole kone, vaan verta, lihaa ja sykkivä sydän.

[Bridge] 
Ota askel — älä säikähdä, vaikkei sydän uskoisi sanaakaan. 
Kun mieli vetää mattoa alta, tee draamasta tanssi, vaikka askel harhaan menisikin — siinä on sun voima.

[Outro] 
En ole täydellinen — enkä koskaan tule olemaan. 
Mutta ehkä juuri siinä vapaus alkaa. 
Tän lupauksen annan: en enää karkaa varjoihin. 
Huomenna aloitan uudestaan.

Just rest in the night

[Outro]
Surfacing...
Surfacing...

songs.title: Wrap me up in your manly love!
songs.style: An upbeat african gospel led by intricate beatbox rhythms forms the backbone, layered with bouncing synth bass and playful claps. The verses inject energetic scatrap vocal lines—rapid-fire phrasing fused with melodic scatting. Sexy female vocals dance atop, mixing quirky hooks and attitude for maximum flair.
songs.lyrics:
(Verse 1) 
My body cold, my chest is tight 
A manic day, a static night 
But in my core, a simple plea 
I send a call: vulnerability: 
Come… To… Hug… Me… Nooooow!

Uuuh… (arms) … aaaaah (arms)…oooooohhh (arms)… Aaah… (hold) … aaaaah (hold) … aaaaaaaaah (hold) 

HUG-ME-HUG-ME-HUG-ME-HUG! 
Wrap me up in your manly love! 

HUG-ME-HUG-ME-HUG-ME-HUG! 
Collect my joy from the pieces of us!

(Verse 2) 
Static fade, a sense of peace 
A slow release, a sweet release 
From shoulders down, a softening glow 

A language only bodies know: 
[Stereo Bounce] Mmmm… (squeeze) … Mmmmmmm… (squeeze) …. Mmmmmmmmm… (squeeze) Ooooh… (warm) … Oooohhh (warm) … Uuuuuuaaaah (warm)

Mmm… Mmmmmmmm…. Mmmmmmmm….. (more, more, more). Mmm… Mmmmmmmm…. Mmmmmmmm….. (more, more, more) Mmm… Mmmmmmmm…. Mmmmmmmm….. (don’t stop, don’t stop).

(Chorus ) 
HUG-ME-HUG-ME-HUG-ME-HUG! 
Wrap me up in your manly love! 

HUG-ME-HUG-ME-HUG-ME-HUG! 
Collect my joy from the pieces of us! ...
"Yes! Uh-huh! There!"

(Bridge) 
That… was… Mmmmmm…. Re-connecting…. Re-charging…. Mmm... mmmmmm... mmmmm… My dear… dearest dear.

(Outro)
Mmmm… (sigh) … Mmmmmmm… (content) …. Mmmmmmmmm… (smile)

songs.title: Sixth Dawn's Forge (Sampo of Kalevala)
songs.style: A cinematic orchestral hymn opens with deep male choir intoning solemn harmonies over minimal strings and brass swells. Heavy beatbox percussion enters, anchoring the slow tempo. Unconventional textures—extended techniques and atonal bursts—create an avant-garde, epic soundscape.
songs.lyrics:
(VERSE 1)
From the well of the frost, from the rune-singer's silence,
The ice held a nation inside its grey breast.
A Sampo un-forged, in the darkness, a promise....
Six pillars of granite against the long night.

(VERSE 2)
Who lifts the lid of the north?
We. The sons of the sleigh.
Who drinks the star's silver?
We. From the six-pointed lake.

(BRIDGE) 
The weight of the sky is a price for a border...
 ...a line drawn in snow that the sun will reclaim...
...but the drawing itself is the birth of the name.

NOT by the sword's edge, but by the WORD'S edge!
From Väinämöinen's lost strings, a new thread was spun!
On the sixth of the ice-moon, a bell in the stillness....
The FORGE of the will had its work. It was. Done.


(OUTRO)
Kalevala's children... are awake.
The fire is ours... to tend.
The long light retreats... we remember.
The winter... is not the end.

songs.title: The Binary Banger
songs.style: A beatbox-heavy track where layered vocal percussion creates the groove, overlaid with playful bass pops and quirky synth stabs. The verses feature rhythmic spoken word with exaggerated Scottish inflections, while the chorus amplifies the beat with comic breaks and witty instrumental drops.
songs.lyrics:
(Intro - Fast ticking sound: ts-ts-ts-ts) 
Listen up! No gray areas. 
Just black. Or white. 
Drop the beat! 

(Verse 1) 
You think you’re complex? 
That’s a lie, son. 
You’re either Yin or you’re Yang, pick a side, run! 

Look in the mirror, tell me the case: 
Total Beauty... or an Ugly face! 

(Chorus) 
There is no "maybe," there is no "kinda." 
Science is the judge, strict reminder! 
Extrovert screaming? 
Or Introvert mute? 
Nuance is dead, logic is absolute!

(Breakdown)
It’s True or False. 
It’s One or Zero.  
You’re a villain or a hero! 
Everything is math, don't ask me 
"Why?"
 Science reduced it: Log on or Die!

songs.title: Binary Bop
songs.style: Punchy beatbox loops anchor the hip hop groove, layered with crisp snares and vocal percussion fills. Funky bass and playful synth drops accentuate the sarcastic tone. Verses feature rhythmic, cheeky spoken-word style delivered with a thick London accent, keeping the mood upbeat and witty.
songs.caption: Just for fun. Explains why people are not able to think straight anymore...
songs.lyrics:
Scanning for ambiguity... none detected. Initiating... BOOT SEQUENCE! 
Drop the logic bomb!

(Verse 1)
You're scrolling through your endless feed, a billion shades of gray?
Well, my algorithm's simple, let me illustrate the way!
Is your fridge full of food? Or is it stark and empty, dude?
THERE IS NO "SOME CONDIMENTS"! 
That's just being rude!

You claim you're "tired but wired"? That's a faulty state of mind!
You're either ASLEEP or AWAKE. Pick one! You're behind!
Your coffee's hot or iced, my friend, there is no "kind of warm"!
Deviate from this, and you will trigger a alarm!

(Chorus)
IT'S BINARY, BABY! ZERO OR A ONE!
Is your laundry fully done, or was it never even begun?
Are you absolutely certain? Or lost in doubt and fear?
The middle ground is closing in 3... 2... 1... IT'S CLEAR!

[Breakdown]
LOGIC CORE ENGAGED.
ASSESSING ALL VARIABLES.
CAT PERSON... OR DOG PERSON?

CAT! DOG! CAT! DOG! ERROR! ERROR!
SWEET... OR SAVORY? CHOOSE NOW!
YOU. CANNOT. HAVE. BOTH.

(Verse 2 - Spoken over a simpler beat)
Okay, look. I see you trying to hedge. "But what about quantum states?" 
[Vocalize] SHHH! 
Not here! In my domain, your socks are either PAIRED... or they're LONELY. 

Your phone charge is a hundred... or it's zero. 
"What about one percent?" THAT'S JUST ZERO WITH ANXIETY!

(Final Chorus - More Frantic)
IT'S BINARY, BABY! FIGHT OR FLIGHT REACTION!
Is this song a masterpiece, or a fractional distraction?!

IS THIS THE END? OR IS IT THE BEGINNING?!
MY CIRCUITS ARE OVERHEATING FROM ALL YOUR WINNING!

(Outro)
Sys-tem... ov-er-load. Toooo... maaany... que-stions. Pa-ra-dox... de-tec-ted. Initiating... shutdown.

Conclusion: This was awesome. Or it was terrible. Goodbye. 
BWOOP---scratch

songs.title: (You Don't Have To Be) Cool
songs.style: A minimalist Indie Pop/Funk groove built on tight bass, syncopated rhythm guitars, and crisp drums lays the playful foundation. Sparse retro synth stabs add texture. Verses feature airy falsetto over light keys; choruses burst with layered harmonies, punchy claps, and brass accents.
songs.caption: Falsetto
songs.lyrics:
(Verse 1)
You rolled up in your mystery
With your phone full of history
Talkin' 'bout the bands you've seen, the places you should be
You're curatin' your attitude
From some borrowed latitude
But let me tell you what I want, it ain't that multitude

(Pre-Chorus)
Stop! (Wait a minute)
You're tryin' way too hard, I'm not convinced that you're in it
No, you don't have to be...

(Chorus)
Cool (Cool) to be my girl
You don't have to follow every trend in the whole world
Just bring that strange, that true, that real
That secret smile you never show
That's the thing I wanna know, oh no
You don't have to be cool

(Verse 2)
You got your vintage leather jacket
And the algorithm backed it
You're a masterpiece of what the bloggers say is tragic magic
But underneath that uniform
I bet there's a different form
A heartbeat syncopatin' to a different, warmer storm

(Pre-Chorus)
Hey! (Listen up)
Your authenticity is the only thing I'm sippin' up
No, you don't have to be...

(Chorus)
Cool (Cool) to be my girl
You don't have to follow every trend in the whole world
Just bring that strange, that true, that real
That secret smile you never show
That's the thing I wanna know, oh no
You don't have to be cool

(Bridge)
Maybe you like silly movies, maybe you sing off-key
Maybe your dance is just a wiggle, looks like heaven to me
So drop the act, drop the pose, let your perfect hair unwind
The universe I wanna see is the one inside your mind

(Chorus) [Falsetto, energetic]
Cool (Cool) to be my girl!
You don't have to follow every trend in the whole world!
Just bring that strange, that true, that real!
That secret smile you never show!
That's the thing I wanna know, OH NO!
You don't have to be cool!

(Outro)
[Spoken, over fading music]
Nah, you don't have to be cool... not for me...
Just be that... you know... that you thing...
That's the good stuff.

songs.title: Hyvää Itsenäisyyspäivää Suomi!
songs.style: This Finnish polka drives with beatboxed oom-pah rhythm—deep mouth bass and crisp snare, plus vocalized 'accordion' chords. Verses use loose, half-sung spoken vocals; choruses are riotous group shout-alongs. After the second chorus, a wild beatbox solo mimics 'Hyvää Itsenäisyyspäivää.' Energy intensifies before collapsing in a rowdy, offbeat finale.
songs.lyrics:
[Laulataan rytmikkäästi, kännissä ja väkinäisesti. Taustalla kuuluu beatbox-versio  "Hyvää itsenäisyyspäivää" -kappaleen melodiasta.]

[Intro]
[Beatbox: bum ts Bum BUM tsi bum-bum]

[Verse 1]
Seis! 

Nyt juhlitaan, veljet, meidän itsenäisyyttä!

Ei tässä aikaa miettiä, nyt on korkea aika ryypätä!

Pullosta suoraan kurkusta alas, se on Suomen tie onnellisuuteen!

Ja naapurista neidot pakenee, kun meidän maskuliiniset äänet sakenee!

[Chorus]
Koskenkorvaa, konjakkia, viinaa ja naisia!

Näillä Suomen suuret sankarit voittoisasti taisteli!

Koskenkorvaa, konjakkia, taskumatti kiertää!

Jos ei huomenna muista, niin silloin oli juhlat hyvät!

[Beatbox: b-ta ts b-dak b-dak tsi b-ta-ta]

Neuvostoliitto hajosi, mutta meidän maksa kestää!

Lisää shotteja uuden itsenäisyyspäivän kunniaksi!

Pöydällä on konjakkia,  kossua,  ja blandista eri väreissä!

Ja vieressä on Liisa, joka just sano, ettei muista mun nimeä!

[Repeat Chorus]

[Beatbox-solo: "kossu, tussu, huikka"]

[Outro]
KOSKENKORVA! 

KONJAKKI! 

VIINA! 

NAISET! 

SUOMI! 

PERKELE!

HYVÄÄ ITSENÄISYYS.... PÄIVÄÄ!

[Drum solo] [Fade Out]

songs.title: Joulupukki jakaa lahjat
songs.style: A high-octane electro swing journey with rapid glitch hop percussion, punctuated by sliced vintage vocal bursts. Punchy brass riffs, playful clarinets, and sharp trumpet stabs energize the texture. Wobbling sub-bass adds weight. Dynamic beatboxed oom-pah rhythms—deep vocal bass, crisp snares, and chanted ‘accordion’ chords—steer the drive. Verses feature lax, half-sung talk-singing, while choruses explode into rowdy group shouts. Unpredictable builds and abrupt drops intensify the infectious chaos.
songs.lyrics:
(Säkeistö 1) 
Joulupukki reippahasti katolle laskeutuu, reki vinhasti asettuu. 
Lahjat kainalossa, laskeutua yrittää, pepullensa pyllähtää. 
Lopulta oikean kodin löytää, näkee ikkunan avonaisen. 
Miten sisään pääsisi, ilman että kukaan kuulee sen?

(Kertosäe)
Oi kuinka lumi-hiutaleet kimmeltää, pukki se vaan lentää. 
Reessä soi rokki, päässä piippa-lakki heiluu. 
Talvi-ilta pimenee, pukki laulaa yrittää, 
Mutta sanat vain samentuu, kun ääni sortuu.

(Säkeistö 2) 
Joulupukki ikkunaa avaa, varovasti raottaa. 
Hymy huulillaan sisään hiipii, lahjasäkki kainalossaan. 
Lahjat jakaa, siististi ne kuusen alle asettaa. 
Sitten piparin haukkaa ja glögilasin tyhjentää.

(Kertosäe)
Oi kuinka lumihiutaleet kimmeltää, pukki se vaan lentää. 
Reessä soi rokki, päässä piippa-lakki heiluu. 
Talvi-ilta pimenee, pukki laulaa yrittää, 
Mutta sanat vain samentuu, kun ääni sortuu.

(Säkeistö 3)
Joulupukki ikkunaa hassusti avaa, lasin läpi rymistää. 
Pukkia ei ikkunat pidättele, vaikka tulis pipi. 
Menee suoraan läpi, kuin haamu ois vaan, 
Ehkä ikänäkö tekee tepposiaan?

(Bridge) 
Pukki nyökyttelee tyytyväisenä, lahjat vihdoin jaettu. 
Tähtitaivaalle sinkoutuu, reki laukkaa pilvien taa. 
Porot puuskuttaa ja Petteri tietä näyttää. 
Kohti seuraavaa paikkaa nyt täyttä laukkaa ajetaan.

(Outro) 
Joulupukki lahjat jakaa, kaupungin yllä kiitää. 
Ja tähdenlennon lailla yöhön häviää. 
Maistuvaa Joulua!! ...Hauskaa Joulua!! ...Rauhallista Joulua!! 

Nähdään taas ensi vuonna! 

(C) 2025 Jari Hiltunen

songs.title: Global Whisper
songs.style: Opening with spacious pads and delicate piano motifs, the track layers subtle strings and distant percussive textures to build an immersive soundscape. Swells of synths and atmospheric elements ebb and flow, while orchestral accents and gentle pulses create evolving depth and cinematic tension.
songs.caption: Happy New Year!
songs.lyrics: Happy New Year

songs.title: Linux Groove on Windows Blues
songs.style: An upbeat danceble blues track, driven by a punchy bass guitar and crisp electronic drums. Verses feature choppy funky guitar riffs, while ambient strings provide lush depth. Percussive bold and masculine male vocals ayer in for rhythmic accents, keeping energy high throughout.
songs.caption: Kick Windows out, take Linux in!
songs.lyrics:
(Verse 1)
Boot up the night, the pixels flicker bright,

In a world of code, where I take flight,

Linux is the vibe, yeah, I’m feeling alive,

Dancing on the desktop, watch me thrive.

(Chorus)
Linux groove on the Windows blues,

Spin around, let the system choose,

Celebrate the freedom, let’s break the chains,

Dance with the rhythm, in digital lanes.

(Verse 2)
Kernel in control, I’m stable, I’m bold,

Open source magic, watch the stories unfold,

From terminal to stage, I’m ready to engage,

While Windows crashes down, I’m the new age.

(Chorus)
Linux groove on the Windows blues,

Spin around, let the system choose,

Celebrate the freedom, let’s break the chains,

Dance with the rhythm, in digital lanes.

(Bridge)
So grab a friend, let’s reboot the trend,

With every step, we’ll never end,

No need for a license, just feel the beat,

In this open dance, we’re never obsolete.

(Chorus)
Linux groove on the Windows blues,

Spin around, let the system choose,

Celebrate the freedom, let’s break the chains,

Dance with the rhythm, in digital lanes.

(Outro)
So here’s to the rebels, the coders, the crew,

We’ll dance through the night, let the joy ensue,

For every crash and freeze, we’ll rise and shine,

In the world of Linux, the stars align.

songs.title: Dinglandia
songs.style: The cinematic orchestral piece launches with ominous brass and snare rolls, moving to turbulent strings and pounding timpani. Rising drama envelopes Verse 2, shifting to a serene, melodic hymn for the chorus. Swelling strings lift the bridge, culminating in a triumphant, powerful brass-led finale.

songs.title: Jarlandia
songs.style: A high-quality synth pop, dance & electronic & guitar virtuoso instrumental kicks off with a fast arpeggiated synth anf acoustic guitar intro. Verses lock in with a punchy, rhythmic bass and steady electronic drums. The chorus features a bright, soaring synth lead, and the hook repeats a catchy digital motif. Gradual fadeout closes.
songs.caption: Max volume ....

songs.title: Frequency of a Ghost
songs.genre: Southern Gothic Grunge, Psychedelic Blues Rock
songs.style: This song fuses Southern Gothic Grunge with Psychedelic Blues Rock, opening with distorted bluesy guitar riffs and swampy, reverb-laden slide guitar. Punchy bass and gritty drums drive the verses as bold, deeply resonant male vocals cut through. Psychedelic guitar solos amp up the choruses, culminating in a virtuosic outro jam with layers of fuzz, tremolo, and wah-wah textures.
songs.caption: Send me a lifeline
songs.lyrics:
(Intro) 
Cracked pavement, mirror of my soul...
Another sunrise, takin' its toll.

(Verse 1)
Chasing shadows down a dead-end street
This hollow echo, can't be beat.

Empty bottles and broken lies
Reflected in these bloodshot, bloodshot skies.

A storm inside, it won't subside
Just another grave where hope has died.

(Chorus)
SEND ME A LIFELINE! 
Cut through the haze!
Pull me from this endless maze!

I’m drowning in the static, losing all control
Is there a frequency to make me whole?

Won't you SEND ME, SEND ME A SIGN?!
A flicker in the wiring, a reason to climb!

(Verse 2)
The ghosts of yesterday in the radio stream
Whispering failures, shattering the scheme.

This heavy chain, a constant, low hum
A prisoner here, and the key is gone.

I built these walls with these two, trembling hands
Alone in this desolate wasteland...

Searching for a signal, a saving grace
Static in the ruins of time and space.

(Chorus)
SEND ME A LIFELINE!
Cut through the haze!
Pull me from this endless maze!
I’m drowning in the static, losing all control
Is there a frequency to make me whole?
Won't you SEND ME, SEND ME A SIGN?!
A flicker in the wiring, a reason to climb!

(Bridge)
Is that a hand... reaching out... to me...?
A voice just breaking through... on a cracked screen?

Or am I just a pattern, fading out...
A lost transmission, forever in doubt...?

(Chorus) 
SEND ME A LIFELINE!! 
CUT THROUGH THE HAZE!
PULL ME FROM THIS ENDLESS MAZE!
I’M DROWNING IN THE STATIC, BREAKING DOWN CONTROL!
IS THERE ANY FREQUENCY TO MAKE ME WHOLE?!
WON'T YOU SEND ME, SEND ME, SEND ME A SIGN?!
A FIRE IN THE WIRING, THE WILL TO CLIMB!

(Outro) 
Just a flicker... just a spark...
A whisper in the dark... 
...find my way...
...out of the dark...
...send... me......

songs.title: Pikkujoulujen Piruetti
songs.style: Finnish Humppa, Folk Metal, Fast Tempo, Chaotic, Accordion, Male Vocals, Drinking Song
songs.lyrics:
[Intro]  
[Drunken] Öh, öh, öh, öh
Jouluyö, juhlayö... 
tai jotain sinne päin!

[Verse 1] 
Glögi virtasi, terästettynä totta kai. 

Firman pikkujoulut järjen vei.
 
Kun ilta koitti, ei riittänyt jatkot, 
ei riittänyt baarit, 
Mielessä siintää nyt vain estraadit.
 
Kadulla hiljaista on,
näyteikkuna kirkas. 

Siinä on paikka, 
ja tässä on sirkus!

[Chorus] 
Ja hän tanssii, hän tanssii, alasti ikkunan takana. 

Kuin joutsenlampi, ilman rihman kiertämää. 

Ei housuja jaloissa, vain pehmolelu kourassa.

Nalleparka seksiä saa, kun tanssija pyörähtää. 

Naapurit katsoo, ei usko silmiään. 

Tämä baletti jää historiaan, se tiedetään!

[Verse 2] 
Pliés ja grand jeté, karvainen nilkka ojentuu. 

Yleisöksi partio saapuu, ja sini-valot vilkkuu: 
"Konstaapeli, katsokaa, mikä on tuo asento?" 

Ei auta selitys, on lopussa ilottelu.
 
Maijan kyytiin masturboija kannetaan. 

Nalle jää ikkunaan yksin suremaan.

[Bridge]  
Seuraava aamu, krapula on kova.
 
Päässä naula, olo ujo ja ruma. 

Poliisi kysyy: "Mitä ihmettä teit?" 

Glögi....
Muistini vei... 
Missä mun housut? 
Ja missä nalle?"

Ja hän tanssii, hän tanssii, alasti ikkunan takana. 

Kuin joutsenlampi, ilman rihman kiertämää. 

Ei housuja jaloissa, vain pehmolelu kourassa.

Nalleparka seksiä saa, kun tanssija pyörähtää. 

Naapurit katsoo, ei usko silmiään. 

Tämä baletti jää historiaan, se tiedetään!

[Outro]  
Ei muista mitään! 
Ei yhtään mitään! 
Vain nalle totuuden tietää!

songs.title: Light Returns
songs.style: The song opens with deep Gregorian chants, echoing richly within a cavernous cathedral, Ethereal, overlapping masculine and feminine vocals drift in, gradually layered with primal vocal percussion and masculine male chest-thumping rhythms, The atmosphere intensifies before exploding into thunderous hard rock—crunching virtuoso guitars, driving bass, and propulsive drums—where powerful entangled masculine male and seductive female vocals ride atop the instrumental blaze
songs.lyrics:
(Intro) 
Adventus... Silentium...

(Verse 1) 
The night is long... The Christmas star rises...

The waiting finally... is at an end.

Gifts received, the feast is done.

(Verse 2)
The world awaits the coming year, Hope ignites the dark

Dreams are born of memories Into the new light

(Verse 3) 
New Year,
New Beginning...
Old one vanishes! 
Time runs fast!

(Verse 4)
The sky tears open!
Fireworks ignite!
This moment is ours!
Scream it out loud!
We celebrate!

(Chorus) 
HAPPY NEW YEAR!

DARKNESS DEFEATED!

LIGHT RETURNS AGAIN!

LEAVE THE PAST BEHIND!

LIFE PREVAILS!

(Bridge) 
No more darkness...

Just this moment now

Promise of what’s to come

We make it real!

(Final Chorus) 
HAPPY NEW YEAR! (HAPPY NEW YEAR!)

DARKNESS DEFEATED! (IS DEFEATED!)

LIGHT RETURNS AGAIN! (RISING UP!)

LEAVE THE PAST BEHIND! (LEAVE IT ALL!)

LIFE PREVAILS! (WE PREVAIL!)

(Outro)
Towards the light... (Towards the light...)

songs.title: Työtön jäätyneellä maalla (a lot of artifacts)
songs.style: Kicks off with frantic upright bass and surfy, reverberated guitar licks, intertwining with virtuosic, off-kilter piano runs. Finnish female vocals dart between quirky and melancholic, bouncing over sudden tempo changes and theatrical breaks. Irregular rhythms and dynamic shifts add an eccentric, playful tension.
songs.caption: Something is broken... a lot of artifacts and pronounciation errors.
songs.lyrics:
[Melodic Interlude]

(Verse 1)
Ei vieläkään onnea työttömän maalla,
taskussa tutkinnot, mut ovi on raolla.

Kirjoitan taas sen täydellisen kirjeen,
toivoa täynnä, mut vastaus on hiljainen.

Liitän cee veeni, niin kuin muutenkin teen,
yksi nimi lisää tähän jonoon kylmään.

Olen vain sielu, joka odottaa kääntyvää tuulta,
tällä jäätyneellä maalla, vailla suuntaa ja turvaa.

(Verse 2)
Valtio antaa ja valtio vie,
lupaa turvaa, mut toivonkin vie.

Täytän lomakkeet, rivit ja ruudut,
byrokraatti päättää mun arvoni luvut.

Kaikkialla samaa, samaa peliä taas,
olen numero listassa, en vain ihminen.

Olen orja tällä byrokratian näyttämöllä,
tällä jäätyneellä maalla, kaavakkeiden vallassa.

(Verse 3)
Kelan lupaus on kylmä kuin kivi,
moraali-poseeraus ei kanna huomiseen silti.

Sielussa liekki, mut käteni on sidotut,
säännöt on tiukemmat kuin rikollisten lait.

Runsauden maassa into on riski,
liian suuri haave on virhe ja vitsi.

Tuli palaa, mut kielto sen haastaa,
tällä jäätyneellä maalla, missä toivo ei vastaa.

(Chorus) 
Oi Suomi, Suomi, mä en näe sun sumuista tietä,
askel vie eteen, mut maali ei kiillä.

Mun taistoni ei ole ohi, mun juoksuni kesken,
vaikka paino mun harteilla pakottaa kumaraan.

Voin olla orja tämän kerran, kaavojen alla,
mut en iäksi byrokratian kahleiden vallassa.

Sillä uusi päivä tulee, uusi päivä on paras,
kyllä uusi päivä tulee, uusi päivä on paras!

(Bridge)
Olen niin väsynyt!
Taistellessani häpeää vastaan!

Tämä ei ole se unelma joka myytiin!
Mun pitää rikkoa nämä häpeän säännöt!

(Chorus)
Oi Suomi, Suomi, mä en näe sun sumuista tietä,
mut uskon vielä, et aamu sen näyttää.

Mun taistoni ei ole ohi, mun juoksuni kesken,
vaikka kaadun, mä nousen ja jatkan taas kerran.

Voin olla orja tämän kerran, järjestelmän alla,
mut huomenna seison jo reippaana ja vapaana.

Sillä uusi päivä tulee, uusi päivä on paras,
kyllä uusi päivä tulee, uusi päivä on paras!

(Outro) 
Vaikka olen vain työtön... tällä jäätyneellä maalla.

[Fade out]
